name: Net-Bid Carry: hotkey-optimised nominator-yield carry, screened by a protocol sell-load model, with a gate-aware forward chain-buy model and structural-event overlay
thesis:
0. WHAT IS TRADED
A long-only book of staked alpha. Each position sits on a chosen validator hotkey. Total return in TAO over a hold is R = (P1/P0)*(I1/I0) - swap fees - slippage - tx fees, where I = TotalHotkeyAlpha/TotalHotkeyShares of the hotkey. The engine forecasts mu_n = E[ln P1/P0] + E[ln I1/I0] per subnet per day from protocol state, holds only subnets whose lower-bound mu exceeds the round-trip cost over the hold, picks the best near-zero-take dividend hotkey, and exits on the structural events that destroy a micro-cap position (prune, emission switch-off, owner exit, hotkey loss). No shorting exists, so the only levers are selection, timing and cash (free TAO). "Dilution from alpha_out is already in P"; it is never subtracted twice.

1. PRICE IS A SUM OF FLOWS (first order, exact for the AMM)
Pool: p = (w_base/w_quote)*y/x with y=SubnetTAO, x=SubnetAlphaIn, weights from Swap.SwapBalancer (never hard-code 0.5). A TAO inflow dy moves spot by (1+dy/y)^(1/w_base), which is squared at 0.5/0.5. So per day d ln p ~= k_w*(CB + F)/y, with k_w = 1/w_base (2.0 today), CB = chain-buy TAO/day (7200*SubnetExcessTao/1e9) and F = net user TAO flow/day (delta SubnetTaoFlow; negative when holders or emission recipients sell). Injection (tao_in + alpha_in at spot) is price-neutral by construction. CB is the only protocol bid.

2. THE PART OF F THAT IS COMPUTABLE EX ANTE: EMISSION-RECIPIENT SELL LOAD
Every started subnet mints AE = 7,200 alpha/day (SubnetAlphaOutEmission, read live) whatever its TAO share. Split: owner 18% (liquid unless OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled; auto-lock is on for only 13 subnets), miners 41% x (1 - MinerBurned), validators/nominators 41% x (1 - rp) (compounds into I, not sold), root 41% x rp (accrues in validator baskets, released to the pool by claim sales at about 2%/day of the escrow stock E_b). Define the sell load
S_n = p_n * [ phi_o*c_o*ol_n*AE + phi_m*0.5*(1-c_o)*(1-burn_n)*AE + kappa_b*E_b,n ]  (TAO/day)
with c_o=SubnetOwnerCut/65535, ol=1 unless auto-lock, kappa_b about 0.02/day. Its price push is -k_w*S/y per day. Only the phi's (fractions actually sold) and the common demand level are unknown; both are estimated from data (falsification tests T2, T3).

3. YIELD IS THE OTHER SIDE, AND SCALES THE SAME WAY
Gross nominator yield per staked alpha per day = AE*(1-c_o)*0.5*(1-rp)/A_earn = 2952*(1-rp)/A_earn (verified on SN70/SN92/SN64 to 3 decimals), A_earn = sum of TotalHotkeyAlpha over keys of AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,.). Net = x (1-take). Realised yield is read per hotkey from delta ln I. Yield falls with 1/A_earn; the sell push falls with 1/x. Their ratio, not the headline APY, decides whether holding is profitable. Illustration (derived, assumed inputs: young micro cap y=1,500 TAO, p=0.002, rp=0.40, A_earn=350k alpha, escrow E_b/x=5%; total = yield + chain-buy push - sell push, %/day):
 - plain, phi=0.3/0.5/0.8: -0.04 / -0.26 / -0.60
 - same with MinerBurned=1: +0.20 / +0.13 / +0.03
 - burned miners plus owner auto-lock: +0.30 for all phi
 - SN51-like large old subnet (y=170k, rp=0.14, CB=372 TAO/day): +0.36 / +0.26 / +0.11
 - gate-boundary old subnet (y=3,000, p=0.007, rp=0.25, CB=4): -0.22 / -0.62 / -1.21
These rows are not predictions of level (J, the common demand term, absorbs the level); the claim is only that the cross-sectional dispersion of (yield + k_w*(CB-S)/y) is about 1%/day, larger than the 0.2-0.5%/day yield spread that is the whole of the brief's unresolved total-return question. If the dispersion is not real, the strategy collapses to plain yield carry and is probably killed (T2-T4).

4. THE GATE, WHAT IT DOES FOR MICRO CAPS (derived; recompute live)
E_n = 3600*f_n with f from b=EMA(1-burn)/S_adj, G(b)=1/(1+(theta/b)^3). Empirically E_n = c_E*EMA_n*(1-burn_n)*G(b_n), c_E about 4,718 TAO/day per unit EMA (calibrated on SN51: EMA 0.0999 -> 13.09%; check SN90: EMA 0.0212 -> 96.5 vs brief ~96 TAO/day; at the bar EMA about 0.0070 and E about 16.6 TAO/day). Elasticity of E to the burn-adjusted share, eps = 1 + 3u/(1+u), u=(theta/b)^3: 3.67 at 0.5*theta, 2.98 at 0.8*theta, 2.50 at theta, 1.69 at 1.5*theta, 1.33 at 2*theta, 1.11 at 3*theta (consistent with the official 'rank 36, +10% demand -> +26% emission').
KEY DERIVED FACT: emission is injected at spot only up to cap = 7200*rp*alpha_emission*p TAO/day; only the excess is a chain buy. CB>0 requires G(b) >= 1.526*rp*(p/EMA)/(1-burn). With EMA=spot and no burn that needs b >= 0.63*theta (rp 0.13), 0.76*theta (rp 0.20), 0.95*theta (0.30), 1.16*theta (0.40), 1.48*theta (0.50), 4.97*theta (0.65), and is impossible for rp >= 0.655 (about <515k alpha issued, roughly the first 70 days). So the 'chain-buy support above theta' exists only for older, low-rp subnets; young micro caps at ranks 25-40 receive neutral injection and keep the full sell load. Corollary: after a spot drop the cap falls with spot while E (via EMA) lags, so CB rises (a stabilising bid); after a spot rise CB shrinks.

5. EXPLICIT REFLEXIVE LOOP (price -> EMA -> share -> chain buys -> price)
State u=ln p, v=ln EMA. Per day: dv/dt = a*(e^(u-v) - 1) with a = 7200*SubnetMovingAlpha*b/(b+EMAPriceHalvingBlocks) (mature: 2.16/day, time constant 11.1 h, half-life 7.7 h). E = c_E*EMA*(1-burn)*G. CB = max(0, E - 7200*rp*alpha_blk*p). du/dt = k_w*(CB - S + J)/y.
Linearise where CB>0: du/dt = k*v - kappa_c*u with k = k_w*E*eps/y (EMA channel) and kappa_c = k_w*cap/y (spot-dependent injection cap, instantaneous negative feedback). Net positive-feedback rate k_eff = k - kappa_c = (k_w/y)*[CB + E*(eps-1)]. Characteristic equation lambda^2 + a*lambda - a*k_eff = 0, growth rate lambda+ = (-a + sqrt(a^2 + 4*a*k_eff))/2. Extra drift after a +x log jump over T days = x*k_eff*[T - (1-exp(-a*T))/a] (about 1.54*x*k_eff at T=2 days).
Numbers (derived): SN51-like k_eff 0.44%/day (extra 0.07% over 2 d after a +10% jump); gate-boundary old subnet, y=3,000: 1.9%/day (0.29%); SN90-like (y=4,050, E=96, CB about 2): 0.64%/day (0.10%); nano pool 330 TAO at the bar: about 18%/day (2.7%). Verdict: the loop is real, positive and slow; it is only material when E/y is above about 2%/day with CB>0, which is rare. It is therefore implemented as a deterministic forward emission simulator and used as a TILT feature (up to 1.5x size) plus an entry/exit sanity check, not as a standalone trade. A second, destructive loop exists at the bottom of the EMA ladder: falling price -> lower EMA -> higher prune probability -> informed exits -> lower price. It is handled by the prune guard.

6. WHERE EACH CANDIDATE IDEA LANDS
- Total-return yield carry: CORE, but only after netting the sell load and the market intercept.
- Validator-hotkey choice: CORE and near-certain. Take 0 vs the 18% default is +0.054%/day at 0.3% gross yield and +0.09%/day at 0.5% (SN70: +22.7% vs +21.2% in 30 d for 0% vs 6% take). Realised delta ln I selects among take-~0 members of AlphaDividendsPerSubnet.
- Chain-buy floor (SubnetExcessTao) vs owner/miner sell flow: CORE score term; coverage C_n = CB_n/S_n is about 0 for young micro caps and 0.9-1.4 only for the largest old subnets.
- Net user flow (delta SubnetTaoFlow, StakeAdded/Removed): OVERLAY with small coefficients (entry gate, owner-dump and flow-crash exits). 1-day continuation exists (gate-era 1d spread +0.77%/day, IC +0.026) but costs at 0.25-0.5% of pool make 1-day holds uneconomic.
- Gate-boundary trading (ranks 25-40): DEMOTED to a tilt (section 4-5). Not a standalone edge for young micro caps.
- SubnetEmissionEnabledSet: re-enable is an EVENT module that ships OFF until test T7 passes; disable is a hard exit (and a prune leading indicator: 10 of the June switch-offs were pruned within 1-15 weeks).

7. WHY AN EDGE MIGHT EXIST AT ALL
(a) Inputs are public but need synthesis across SubnetTAO/AlphaIn, EMA, MinerBurned, RootProp, OwnerCut flags, hotkey storage and baskets; headline APY shows yield but not sell load. (b) Hotkey take is a free, mechanical gain most stakers leave at the 18% default. (c) Prune, switch-off and owner events are rule-based and partly forecastable (52/52 prune victims matched the rule), so avoiding them has positive value vs an unscreened micro-cap holder. (d) Emission paths are deterministic given spots, so the bid ramp is forecastable hours ahead. (e) Costs are low in TAO per trade but the edge is thin and capacity tiny, which is why larger players do not compete for it. The honest prior is that the edge is small and possibly zero; the design is built so that components can be falsified cheaply (section on tests).
evidence_for:
[P] Yield mechanics are verified on chain: closed form 2952*(1-rp)/A_earn matched SN70 0.557, SN92 0.448, SN64 0.092 %/day to 3 decimals; micro-cap net yield 0.3-0.6%/day vs 0.08-0.11 on large caps; SN70 take-0 hotkey I 1.3297 -> 1.6314 (+22.7%) in 30 d vs +21.2% with 6% take.
[P] Emission replica: get_shares reproduces live per-subnet emission to ~2e-7 TAO; the EMA formula was checked per block either side of 2026-01-15; my calibration (c_E about 4,718) reproduces SN90 at 96.5 TAO/day (brief: 96) and the official 'rank 36 +10% demand -> +26% emission' (eps 2.6-3.0).
[P] Chain-buy accounting: injection capped at rp*alpha_emission*spot; network split 1,131 TAO/day injection vs 2,468 chain buys; rp median 0.157 (old) up to 0.88 (young). Gives the derived CB-threshold table in section 4.
[P] Sell-side supply is mechanical and large for micro caps: SN92 7,200 alpha/day = about 9.7 TAO/day = 1.65% of its pool/day; baskets hold E/x median 5.3% (bottom third) and release about 2%/day; owner auto-lock only on 13 subnets.
[R] Gate-era price-only small tercile -0.57 to -0.67%/day, EW index about -0.46%/day (-0.334 log over 73 d), big tercile -0.01 to -0.12%/day: the cross-section already shows large size/sell-load dispersion, and the brief itself says total-return SMB (price x yield) was never computed and 'its sign is uncertain' because the +0.2 to +0.5%/day yield spread is the same order as the reversal.
[R] 1-day continuation and 7-day momentum are positive gross (WML7 +0.43-0.45%/day t 2.4-2.8; 1d spread +0.77%/day t 4.6): supports a small flow-persistence term and exit-on-outflow.
[P] 52/52 prune victims matched the (min SubnetMovingPrice, non-immune) rule; 23% had been rank 1 for <24 h, but only 3/52 for <8 h: a guard with a rank/EMA-ratio trigger would have flagged almost all.
[Derived, not independently verified] With phi in 0.5-0.8 the sell-load model gives micro-cap structural pushes of -0.8 to -1.1%/day and large-cap pushes of about 0 to +0.3%/day, the right order of magnitude and sign pattern vs the observed SMB reversal; this is a plausibility check with one free parameter, not a test.
evidence_against:
[R] Price-only micro-cap longs lost money in the gate era (t about -2 to -2.6, but only 66-109 days, 128 subnets). A carry of 0.3-0.6%/day only breaks even against -0.5 to -0.67%/day price drift; the screen has to find names whose structural drift is 0.3-0.5 points better than the universe mean, and that is unproven.
Derived: for young micro caps (rp >= 0.655 never; most below the bar) the TAO emission is neutral injection, so there is no protocol bid, and the full 59% owner+miner supply plus basket claims are potential sells. The structural sign for the typical micro cap is negative to about zero for phi >= 0.5.
Derived: the reflexive loop is weak (k_eff 0.4-1.9%/day for realistic pools; +0.07% to +0.3% extra drift over 2 days after a +10% jump) versus a 0.6% round-trip at 0.25% of pool. It cannot carry a trade by itself.
Costs and capacity: with the conservative temporary-impact assumption, round trip = 2*0.0504% + 2V/(T+V) + 0.00186 TAO/V. At V=1% of pool the round trip is 2.06% (break-even hold 5 days at 0.4%/day, 10 days at 0.2%/day); at 2% it is 3.9%. Profit-maximising size is only 0.1-0.7% of the pool. Net/gross is about 50% at the optimum.
Yield decay and crowding: SN70's yield fell from 0.86% to 0.57%/day in 30 days (-1.4%/day relative) as stake arrived; Taostats shows APY publicly, so yield is chased. Take can jump 0 -> 18% once per 30 days; permits can be lost; Null consensus (spec 475) and 'precise emissions' (spec 475/476) may change dividend logic.
Statistical power is low: about 66-107 post-regime days; a 10-name book has daily SD of roughly 3-4%, so the standard error of a mean over 70 days is about 0.4%/day, far above the +0.05-0.1%/day central edge. Only cross-sectional and component tests have power. Emission rules changed about 6 times in 11 months; the owner/miner phi's are behavioural and can shift.
Log vs simple returns: micro-cap daily vol of 5-7% means sigma^2/2 is 0.12-0.25%/day, the same size as the edge. All evidence quoted as log drifts overstates the negative drift in simple-return terms; the backtest must be run in simple TAO returns.
Prune/dissolution (0.35-0.65x spot recovery), root switch-offs, SafeMode (no exits possible) and owner dumps (-40-50% in hours) are fat-tail events that a thin carry cannot absorb unless the guard works. 6 of the last 10 prunes were MEV-shielded, so there is no mempool warning.
The 'chain-buy support' premise of gate-boundary trading is contradicted for young micro caps by the cap rule (section 4); the official release notes' elasticity applies to emission, not to price.
Unverified inputs: phi_o, phi_m, kappa_b (claim rate +-30%), whether root-basket claim sales continue at 2%/day, whether owner cuts are auto-locked beyond the 13 known, and exact storage-item names for OwnerCutEnabled, OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled and last take-change block.
universe_filter:
All rules use live reads, never hard-coded constants. Asset key is (netuid, NetworkRegisteredAt); every rolling feature resets on a new generation.
U1 Non-root, in NetworksAdded, FirstEmissionBlockNumber set, SubtokenEnabled = true, NetworkRegistrationAllowed = true, SubnetEmissionEnabled = true (absent key = true).
U2 Age since start_call: now - (FirstEmissionBlockNumber - 1) >= min_age_days*7200 (default 45 d). Younger subnets have EMA warm-up (EMA/spot about 4% at 1 d, 80% at 7 d), tiny emission, and belong to the new-launch family.
U3 Pool depth band: T_min <= y <= T_max with y in TAO (default 500 to 8,000; micro-cap-only mode: y < 3,000). Require planned V/y <= v_cap, where V is at least V_min (1 TAO).
U4 Prune guard (non-immune subnets; immune = now < NetworkRegisteredAt + NetworkImmunityPeriod, which has zero prune hazard until expiry): rank_from_bottom among non-immune by SubnetMovingPrice >= rank_in (8) AND rho = EMA_n/EMA_min_nonimmune >= rho_in (2.0). For immune subnets expiring within H_eval + 3 days require the projected rho at expiry to meet the same rule. Never hold the current get_subnet_to_prune() target.
U5 MinerBurned < burn_max (default 0.2). Burn >= 0.9 subnets get zero TAO and are root-purge and prune candidates; they enter only in research mode (flag allow_burn_bucket) at 0.5x size.
U6 Hotkey exists: at least one hotkey in keys(AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,.)) with take <= take_max (5%), member in >= 90% of the last 20 epochs, positive realised delta ln I in >= 90% of the last 20 epochs, and mean realised daily yield >= 0.10%/day.
U7 Owner not distributing: no net unstake by SubnetOwner coldkey above owner_exit_frac*y in the last 24 h; no perpetual->decaying lock switch in the last 7 d; not in a conviction ownership-change window.
U8 Chain health: SafeMode.EnteredUntil in the past, block time and finality normal, spec_version unchanged for spec_pause_blocks (12 h), emission model health OK (T2 check: |E_model - E_obs|/max(E_obs,0.5) < 5% for >= 90% of enabled subnets with E>1).
U9 Cooldown: not risk-exited in the last 3 days.
U10 Flows (entry only): 1-day net-flow z-score >= -1.0 (robust, vs trailing 30 d of that subnet).
U11 Dissolution/cleanup not queued; subnet not in NetworkRegistrationQueued state.
A subnet that fails U1-U5 or U7 while held triggers the corresponding hard exit (see exit rules).

signals.name: pool_state
signals.formula: y=SubnetTAO[n]/1e9; x=SubnetAlphaIn[n]/1e9; w2=Swap.SwapBalancer[n].quote/1e18; w1=1-w2; f=Swap.FeeRate[n] (absent -> 33)/65535; spot p=(w1/w2)*y/x; k_w=1/w1; post-buy spot=p*(1+dy/y)^(1/w1) with dy=V*(1-f); exit-slippage cap V_max(s)=y*s/(1-s) (w=0.5); conservative round-trip cost c_RT(V)=2*f+2*V/(y+V)+(tx_buy+tx_sell)/V
signals.inputs: SubtensorModule.SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn (Identity u16 -> u64 rao); Swap.SwapBalancer (Twox64Concat, Perquintill), Swap.FeeRate; cross-check SwapRuntimeApi_current_alpha_price, SwapRuntimeApi_sim_swap_tao_for_alpha and sim_swap_alpha_for_tao (all-zero result = failure)
signals.update_trigger: every block for held and watchlist subnets; every 60 blocks for the rest; re-read immediately before any order (weights are re-solved on every injection)

signals.name: gate_state
signals.formula: eligible = FirstEmissionBlockNumber set & SubtokenEnabled & NetworkRegistrationAllowed; s_i=EMA_i/sum(EMA); b_i=s_i*(1-min(MinerBurned_i,1))/sum(s*(1-min(MB,1))) (fallback s); theta=EmissionGateBar, live recompute = N-th largest positive b at block%360==0 (N=EmissionBarRank default 32); G_i=1/(1+(theta/b_i)^h) (h=EmissionGateExponent default 3); u=(theta/b)^h; eps_i=1+h*u/(1+u); f_i=g_i/sum(g); E_i=3600*f_i/sum_enabled(f) TAO/day (3600=7200*block_emission, read live); rank_b_i; c_E_i=E_i/(EMA_i*(1-burn_i)*G_i) (sanity about 4,718 today)
signals.inputs: SubnetMovingPrice (I96F32, /2^32), MinerBurned (U96F32), SubnetEmissionEnabled, SubtokenEnabled, NetworkRegistrationAllowed, FirstEmissionBlockNumber, EmissionGateBar (U64F64), EmissionBarRank, EmissionGateExponent, runtime get_block_emission
signals.update_trigger: every block (cheap, one vector op); full rank/theta recompute at block%360==0

signals.name: emission_observed_and_model_health
signals.formula: E_obs=7200*(SubnetTaoInEmission+SubnetExcessTao)/1e9; CB_obs=7200*SubnetExcessTao/1e9; inj_obs=7200*SubnetTaoInEmission/1e9; cap=7200*rp*(SubnetAlphaOutEmission/1e9)*p; CB_model=max(0,E_model-cap); health_err=|E_model-E_obs|/max(E_obs,0.5); model_ok = share of subnets with health_err<5% >= 90%
signals.inputs: SubnetTaoInEmission, SubnetExcessTao (per-block values, spec>=411), SubnetAlphaOutEmission, RootProp (U96F32; compute (SubnetTAO[0]*TaoWeight)/(SubnetTAO[0]*TaoWeight+issuance) before block 7,135,420), TaoWeight
signals.update_trigger: every block for held; every 60 blocks all; immediately on spec_version change

signals.name: forward_chain_buy
signals.formula: Simulate K=14,400 blocks in steps of 60 with spots frozen at the current min(spot,1): EMA_j(t+s)=spot_j+(EMA_j(t)-spot_j)*(1-a_j)^s, a_j=SubnetMovingAlpha*b_j/(b_j+EMAPriceHalvingBlocks_j), b_j=now-(FirstEmissionBlockNumber_j-1); recompute E vector with emission_vector at each step (refresh theta when block%360==0); CB_j(t)=max(0,E_j-7200*rp_j*alpha_blk_j*spot_j); fwd_CB_j=mean_t CB_j; ramp_j=k_w*(fwd_CB_j-CB_obs_j)/y_j (price push change per day); also E_enable_jump_j = E_model with j forced enabled minus current
signals.inputs: All gate_state inputs plus rp, spot, SubnetMovingAlpha (I96F32), EMAPriceHalvingBlocks
signals.update_trigger: every 300 blocks, plus on SubnetEmissionEnabledSet, at block%360==0 when theta changes by >2%, and after any |ln(spot/EMA)|>10% move in a held subnet

signals.name: sell_load
signals.formula: AE=7200*SubnetAlphaOutEmission/1e9; c_o=SubnetOwnerCut/65535 if OwnerCutEnabled else 0; ol=0 if OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled[n] else 1; burn=min(MinerBurned,1); S_n (TAO/day)=p*[phi_o*c_o*ol*AE + phi_m*0.5*(1-c_o)*(1-burn)*AE + kappa_b*E_b]; sell_push=k_w*S_n/y_n; coverage C_n=CB_n/S_n (CB_n=fwd_CB)
signals.inputs: SubnetOwnerCut, OwnerCutEnabled, OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled (names per brief; verify in metadata), MinerBurned, SubnetAlphaOutEmission, E_b (see basket_overhang)
signals.update_trigger: every 300 blocks; recompute on any flag change

signals.name: basket_overhang
signals.formula: E_b,n = sum over validator baskets of escrow alpha deposited from origin subnet n; overhang=E_b,n/x_n; claim_sell_push=k_w*kappa_b*E_b,n*p/y_n; dissolution_haircut=E_b/(x+E_b); root_flag = (sum_eligible SubnetMovingPrice > 1.0) (if false root alpha is recycled, inflow to E_b stops and E_b decays at kappa_b)
signals.inputs: BetaBasketRuntimeApi_get_all_validator_baskets (state_call, decode SCALE) or escrow-account alpha positions; BasketRedeemedTao; SubnetMovingPrice
signals.update_trigger: every 7,200 blocks (daily); on SwapBasket events

signals.name: net_flow
signals.formula: F_w,n=(SubnetTaoFlow_n(t)-SubnetTaoFlow_n(t-w))/1e9 in TAO (i64 rao), valid only within one generation; flow fractions f_w=F_w/y; phi_flow_w=k_w*f_w; z_flow=(F_1d-median_30d)/(1.4826*MAD_30d); owner_flow=signed TAO of StakeRemoved/StakeAdded with coldkey=SubnetOwner[n] (research fallback: Taostats stake-events); big_trade flag: |delta SubnetTaoFlow| in one block > 0.5%*y; drop registration-collateral outliers (Taostats registration_collateral field, spec>=435)
signals.inputs: SubtensorModule.SubnetTaoFlow (i64); events StakeAdded/StakeRemoved(cold,hot,tao,alpha,netuid,fee) with within-subnet transfer pairs (fee=0, same netuid, same extrinsic) removed; SubnetOwner; do NOT use SubnetEmaTaoFlow or sdk subnet_tao_flows() (frozen since block 8,466,530)
signals.update_trigger: every block for held (storage diff), every 60 blocks for the universe; events when an event reader is available

signals.name: A_earn_and_closed_form_yield
signals.formula: A_earn=sum_{h in keys(AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,.))} TotalHotkeyAlpha(h,n)/1e9; Y_cf_gross (per alpha per day)=AE*(1-c_o)*0.5*(1-rp)/A_earn (=2952*(1-rp)/A_earn); Y_cf_net_h=Y_cf_gross*(1-take_h)*(1-childkey_take_h); anomaly if realised/closed-form outside [0.65,1.35] (flags Null consensus, no-miner epochs, permit changes); gA_n = clip(14-day log growth of A_earn per day, 0, 0.03)
signals.inputs: AlphaDividendsPerSubnet (Identity u16 netuid ++ Blake2_128Concat hotkey -> u64 post-take nominator alpha of last epoch), TotalHotkeyAlpha (Blake2_128Concat hotkey ++ Identity netuid), Delegates, ChildkeyTake, RootProp
signals.update_trigger: at each subnet epoch drain (LastEpochBlock[n] change); daily full scan of AlphaDividendsPerSubnet key prefix

signals.name: hotkey_realised_yield
signals.formula: I_h=TotalHotkeyAlpha(h,n)/TotalHotkeySharesV2(h,n) (SafeFloat mantissa*10^exponent per brief; verify decode at build time against I~1 at genesis); r_h(epoch)=ln(I_h(B)/I_h(B-1)) at drain block B; r_day_h=EWMA over last K=40 epochs (half-life 20 epochs) times epochs_per_day (7200/Tempo, 20 for tempo 360); membership_frac=share of last 20 epochs with AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,h)>0; take_h=Delegates[h]/65535 (absent -> 11796/65535); take_lock_days=max(0,216000-(now-last_take_change_block))/7200; hotkey_score=r_day_h*(1+0.5*[take_lock_days>=7])
signals.inputs: TotalHotkeyAlpha, TotalHotkeySharesV2 (legacy TotalHotkeyShares for old blocks), AlphaDividendsPerSubnet, Delegates, last take-change block (storage item name not in brief: check metadata, else DelegateTakeIncreased/Decreased events), ChildkeyTake, ParentKeys/ChildKeys
signals.update_trigger: every epoch drain of the subnet; on any Delegates[h] change for held or candidate hotkeys

signals.name: yield_forecast
signals.formula: Y_fcst_n = r_day_best * exp(-gA_n*H_eval/2) * (1-yield_haircut) per day (log units), using the hotkey chosen by choose_hotkey; if no realised history use Y_cf_net_h*0.75
signals.inputs: hotkey_realised_yield, A_earn_and_closed_form_yield
signals.update_trigger: every epoch of the subnet and every rebalance

signals.name: market_intercept
signals.formula: res_n(t)= dlnP_n(1d) - k_w*(CB_n - S_n)/y_n - a1*phi_flow_1d_n(t-1d) - a2*phi_flow_2to7d_n ; alpha0_t = EWMA_halflife 7d of cross-sectional median over the universe of res_n; m_mkt=clip(1+alpha0_t/|alpha_lo|,0,1) with alpha_lo=-0.5%/day; crash flag if alpha0_t(1d) < 1.0%/day below its 14-day mean
signals.inputs: Daily snapshots of SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, weights, CB, S, SubnetTaoFlow for the whole universe
signals.update_trigger: every 7,200 blocks (daily) with a 300-block intraday refresh of the 1-day window

signals.name: prune_guard
signals.formula: immune_until=NetworkRegisteredAt+NetworkImmunityPeriod; ladder=non-immune subnets sorted by (SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt); rank_from_bottom; rho=EMA_n/EMA_ladder_min; target=SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune(); window_open = now >= LastRateLimitedBlock(NetworkLastRegistered)+NetworkRateLimit; reg_prob(H)=(CDF(d+H)-CDF(d))/(1-CDF(d)) with d=blocks since last registration and CDF from the 32-sample empirical table (14.4k:0, 31k:0.09, 43k:0.19, 50k:0.31, 55k:0.50, 60k:0.72, 65k:0.84, 71k:0.94, 99.9k:1.0), scaled by 1 if current lock cost <= 1.2*NetworkLastLockCost else 0.5; P_bottom=exp(-kappa_p*(rho-1)); lambda_prune (per day)=reg_prob(H_eval)*P_bottom/H_eval; expected prune loss per day = lambda_prune*(1-rec) with rec=0.5; t*_n (worst case)=ln((EMA_n-s)/(EMA_1-s))/a_n, with s=0 gives half_life*log2(EMA_n/EMA_1)
signals.inputs: SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt, NetworkImmunityPeriod, NetworkRateLimit, LastRateLimitedBlock (key suffix 0x02), NetworkLastLockCost, SubnetRegistrationRuntimeApi_get_network_registration_cost, SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune
signals.update_trigger: every block for held; every 60 blocks all

signals.name: mu_net_score
signals.formula: mu_gross_n = Y_fcst_n + k_w*(fwd_CB_n - S_n)/y_n + a1*phi_flow_1d_n + a2*phi_flow_2to7d_n + alpha0_t - lambda_prune_n*(1-rec); mu_lcb = mu_gross - unc_z*sigma_model (sigma_model = rolling 30-day robust SD of realised-minus-predicted 5-day return, pooled by pool-size tercile); V*=y*max(mu_lcb*H_eval-2f,0)/4 (profit-max under 2V/(y+V) cost); mu_net = mu_lcb - c_RT(V)/H_eval; tilt_gate = 1+0.5*clip(ramp_n/ramp_min,-1,1) if rank_b in [22,45] and rp<=rp_max else 1
signals.inputs: All signals above
signals.update_trigger: every 300 blocks (rebalance), on epoch drain of the subnet and on any hard-event

signals.name: event_flags
signals.formula: emission_enabled_flip (SubnetEmissionEnabled changes, or event SubnetEmissionEnabledSet{netuid,enabled}); spec_version change; NetworkAdded/NetworkRemoved/NetworkRegistrationQueued; Delegates[h] increase for a held hotkey; AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,h) absent for 2 consecutive epochs; StakeLocked/Unlocked perpetual->decaying by the owner; SubnetOwnerChanged; SafeMode.EnteredUntil > now; block-time stall (>36 s) or finality lag
signals.inputs: Storage polling of SubnetEmissionEnabled for all netuids each block (one state_queryStorageAt, flips detected within one block), System.Events when an event decoder is available (scalecodec with runtime metadata), runtime spec_version, SafeMode.EnteredUntil
signals.update_trigger: every block

signals.name: drain_timing
signals.formula: next_drain_block=LastEpochBlock[n]+Tempo[n] (or SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_next_epoch_start_block); blocks_to_drain=next_drain_block-now. Stake included at <=B-1 earns the full drain at B; stake added in B does not; unstake in B keeps credit. A shielded order submitted at N lands at N+2. Non-urgent exit rule: if blocks_to_drain-2 in (0,drain_wait_blocks] delay submit so landing block >= B. Yield per drain at 0.3%/day is 0.015% (below one swap fee), so no drain-capture trades. drain_overhang=(PendingOwnerCut*ol+PendingServerEmission*(1-burn))/x_n is logged for test T11
signals.inputs: LastEpochBlock, Tempo, PendingOwnerCut, PendingServerEmission, PendingValidatorEmission, PendingRootAlphaDivs
signals.update_trigger: every block for held subnets

entry_rules:
ENTER subnet n with a shielded add_stake_limit through the Staking proxy when ALL hold at a rebalance (every 300 blocks):
1. n passes universe U1-U11 and the market gate (m_mkt > 0, not crash flag, not spec-paused, model_ok).
2. mu_net_n >= mu_in (0.10%/day) where mu_net already includes the shrinkage (unc_z), expected prune loss and amortised conservative round-trip cost at the chosen V.
3. Planned V >= V_min (1 TAO) and V/y <= v_cap, V <= y*s_max/(1-s_max).
4. n ranks within the top N_max (12) by mu_net/sigma_daily among qualifiers (sigma from 14-day realised daily SD of ln P, floor 3%).
5. Hotkey chosen by choose_hotkey: best hotkey_score among AlphaDividendsPerSubnet members with take <= take_max, membership >= 90%, realised delta ln I positive in >= 90% of last 20 epochs, preferring longer take_lock_days; realised vs closed-form ratio in [0.65,1.35].
6. Order construction: re-quote with sim_swap just before submit; gross V; limit_price_rao = floor(1e9 * p * (1 + V*(1-f)/y)^(1/w_base) * (1+m)) with margin m = 0.5% for the N+2 landing; allow_partial = False; shield via submit_shielded (era 8). Skip shielding only for orders < 1 TAO (not applicable at V_min = 1). Check ProxyExecuted result and reconcile with post-state balances, never from StakeAdded.
7. Event-module entries (only if enable_event_module = true after T7 passes): on SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(true), wait enable_wait_blocks (360) and one full epoch, require E_obs > 0 and a normal mu_net, then size at enable_size_mult (0.5x).
8. Gate-boundary tilt: if rank_b in [22,45], rp <= rp_max (0.35), burn < 0.3 and ramp_n >= ramp_min (0.15%/day) multiply V by tilt_gate (max 1.5x), still subject to v_cap; if ramp_n <= -ramp_min multiply by 0.5. This only reweights qualified names; it never admits a name that fails rule 2 on the non-tilt score.
9. Cash (free TAO on the coldkey) is the default; no root staking assumed because root yield is not verified in the brief.
exit_rules:
HARD EXITS (immediate full exit by shielded remove_stake_limit through the proxy, limit = floor(1e9 * p / (1 + alpha/x)^(1/w_quote) * (1 - m_exit)) with m_exit = 3%, tranche by V_max(s) = y*s/(1-s) with s = 3% if the full size does not fit; treat 'allow_partial=True' remainder as still held and retry next block):
H1 SubnetEmissionEnabled flips to false (event SubnetEmissionEnabledSet false); ban the generation for 14 days.
H2 Removed from the emit set: SubtokenEnabled false or NetworkRegistrationAllowed false.
H3 Prune danger: get_subnet_to_prune() == n; or non-immune and rank_from_bottom <= rank_exit (3); or rho <= rho_exit (1.3) while the registration window is open or opens within 1,800 blocks (6 h); or t*_n < unwind_time + 600 blocks while the window is open. Never wait for confirmation (same-block removal, recovery 0.35-0.65x spot).
H4 Owner distribution: owner coldkey net unstake over 6 h > owner_exit_frac*y (0.5%), or a perpetual->decaying lock switch by the owner, or SubnetOwnerChanged.
H5 Flow crash: 6-hour net flow < -2% of y and robust z <= -3.5, or a single-block outflow above 2% of y (big_trade).
H6 Hotkey loss with no replacement: AlphaDividendsPerSubnet membership lost for 2 consecutive epochs on every eligible hotkey, or all candidates exceed take_max.
H7 Thesis stop: position total return since entry (price x I) <= -dd_stop (20%).
H8 Chain stress: spec_version change AND model_ok false, SafeMode entered (cannot exit; freeze), finality stall (freeze and alert).
SOFT EXITS (limit exit within the s_max budget; respect min_hold 2 days unless a hard exit fires; hysteresis):
S1 mu_net (remaining-horizon, exit cost only) < mu_out (-0.05%/day) at two consecutive 300-block evaluations.
S2 Dropped out of the top N_max + 3 by mu_net/sigma for 2 consecutive evaluations and mu_net < mu_in.
S3 Max hold: after max_hold_days (21) force re-evaluation; re-entry allowed only through the normal entry path (no churn if still top).
S4 Concentration: scale down any name above w_max*capital or above v_cap*y after pool shrinkage.
HOTKEY MANAGEMENT (not an exit): at each epoch drain of a held subnet, if best candidate's hotkey_score exceeds the current hotkey's by more than hotkey_switch_min_gain (0.02%/day) or take rose above take_max or membership/realised yield failed, send move_stake(current -> best, same netuid, full alpha via u64::MAX semantics) through the Staking proxy (no swap fee, about 0.001 TAO tx fee). Take-increase on a held hotkey triggers the switch within the same block that the change is visible.
EXIT TIMING: for non-urgent exits, if blocks_to_drain - 2 <= drain_wait_blocks (30) delay submission so the order lands at block >= the drain block (unstake in block B keeps the credit). Hard exits ignore this.
Full exits are exempt from the 0.002 TAO partial-unstake rule; for partial reductions keep the remaining nominator position >= 0.02 TAO equivalent and the sold part >= 0.002 TAO output.
event_triggers:
Each trigger is detected by storage polling (one state_queryStorageAt per block over all netuids) and, where an event decoder is available, by System.Events. Latency floor for any order is N+2 (24 s) because of MEV shielding.
1. SubnetEmissionEnabledSet{netuid, enabled=false}: if held -> hard exit H1; if not held -> ban 14 d; recompute forward emission for everyone (their shares renormalise upward).
2. SubnetEmissionEnabledSet{netuid, enabled=true}: recompute E_enable_jump and the change in all other subnets' E (they shrink by the newly enabled group's gate share; a bulk re-enable like 47 subnets on 2026-09-09 cuts incumbents' CB by 15-20%); if enable_event_module is on and the subnet qualifies -> wait one epoch then enter at 0.5x. Log every event for T7 regardless of the flag.
3. NetworkRegistrationQueued / NetworkRemoved(netuid) (a prune or dissolve): reconcile positions (a held subnet is already dissolved: record payout as free TAO), reset all state for that netuid, key the new generation by NetworkRegisteredAt, update the ladder, set the registration clock (hazard 0 for 14,400 blocks).
4. Registration-window open (now >= LastRateLimitedBlock + NetworkRateLimit): raise prune-guard strictness (rank_exit 3 -> 4, rho_exit 1.3 -> 1.5) while the lock cost is within 1.2x of NetworkLastLockCost.
5. Subnet epoch drain (LastEpochBlock[n] changes): update A_earn, Delta ln I per hotkey, AlphaDividendsPerSubnet membership, Delegates; run hotkey switch check; log the drain's realised yield vs predicted for T6.
6. block % 360 == 0: EmissionGateBar may be recomputed; re-run forward emission if theta moved by more than 2% or any held subnet crossed the bar.
7. Large trade (single-block |delta SubnetTaoFlow| > 0.5% of y): outflow in a held subnet -> evaluate H5; inflow -> record only (no chasing).
8. Owner signals: owner-coldkey StakeRemoved above threshold, StakeLocked/Unlocked perpetual->decaying, SubnetOwnerChanged, OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled flip (changes S) -> H4 or re-score.
9. Delegates[h] increase or ChildkeyTake change on a held or best-alternative hotkey -> immediate switch evaluation.
10. spec_version change: pause new entries for spec_pause_blocks (3,600 blocks default 12 h; range 720-14,400), run model health check (T2), keep exits allowed. If spec in {475,476 'precise emissions', PoW registration} changes dividend or registration logic, auto-disable the yield and prune modules until T2/T6 re-pass.
11. SafeMode.EnteredUntil > now, finality stall, or block-time stall > 36 s: freeze all order submission (exits are impossible under SafeMode), alert.
12. Basket events (SwapBasket, large claim_root bursts seen as simultaneous multi-subnet outflows): log; if E_b/x > 25% and sell_push rises above its cap, re-score.
13. TaoWeight, SubnetMovingAlpha, EmissionBarRank, EmissionGateExponent, FeeRate, SubnetOwnerCut changes: parameter reload; any change outside the expected set halts entries until T2 re-passes.
sizing:
Capital is configurable; sizing is pool-relative. For each qualifying subnet:
V_n = min( V*_n, v_cap*y_n, y_n*s_max/(1-s_max), w_max*capital ) * m_mkt * m_burn * m_age
- V*_n = y_n * max(mu_lcb_n*H_eval - 2f - (tx_buy+tx_sell)/V, 0) / 4: the profit-maximising size under the conservative temporary-impact cost model (entry premium and exit discount both counted, 2V/(y+V), plus 2f = 0.1008%, plus fixed tx fees about 0.00186 TAO). Because an AMM is path-independent, splitting a buy into tranches does not reduce impact; use one order with a limit, and tranche only exits that exceed V_max(s) or when flows are expected to refill.
- v_cap = 1.0% of the TAO reserve (user range 1-2% is an UPPER bound, not a target). Worked numbers at y=3,000: round trip incl. tx = 0.62% at V=0.25% of pool, 1.10% at 0.5%, 2.06% at 1%, 3.94% at 2%; break-even hold at 0.4%/day gross is 1.6 d, 2.8 d, 5.2 d, 9.9 d respectively.
- Profit-max sizes (y=3,000): mu_gross 0.3%/d with H=7 d -> V*=15 TAO (0.51% of pool), net 0.14%/d on deployed capital; mu 0.2%/d, H=7 -> 10 TAO, net 0.089%/d; mu 0.1%/d, H=14 -> 10 TAO, 0.045%/d; mu 0.5%/d, H=7 -> 26 TAO, 0.24%/d. At the optimum net is about half of gross.
- s_max = 1.0% exit slippage budget: V <= 1.01% of y; w_max = 12% of capital per name (a failed prune guard loses about 50-65% of V, so at most about 7% of capital in the worst single failure); N_max = 12; V_min = 1 TAO (below that the 0.00186 TAO round-trip fees exceed 0.19% of V).
- m_mkt in [0,1] from the market intercept; m_burn = 1 for burn < 0.2, 0.5 in research bucket, else 0; m_age = 1 (reserved for the new-launch family).
- Total gross exposure <= capital*m_mkt; the remainder is free TAO on the coldkey. Keep a TAO fee buffer on the delegate (at least 40 order-fees) to avoid the alpha-fee trap.
- Rebalance bands: trade only if |target - held| >= max(V_min, 25% of target); order sizes below that are skipped.
- Re-size each rebalance because y changes (injection deepens pools, exits shrink them).
- Capacity: with the qualifying set typically 5-15 names and y of 1,000-8,000, deployable capital before marginal return reaches zero is about 60-250 TAO (micro-cap-only mode: 40-120 TAO). Cost grows with V^2/y; capital above that is better held as TAO.

parameters.name: H_eval
parameters.rationale: Evaluation and cost-amortisation horizon; break-even holds at 0.25-0.5% of pool are 1.6-2.8 days, so shorter than 2 is uneconomic.

parameters.name: phi_o
parameters.rationale: Fraction of liquid owner cut sold; owners fund operations in TAO; estimated in T3 (fit, shrunk to prior).

parameters.name: phi_m
parameters.rationale: Fraction of miner emission sold; miners have TAO costs; estimated in T3.

parameters.name: kappa_b
parameters.rationale: Observed basket release c about 0.02/day +-30% via claim_root.

parameters.name: a1_flow_persistence
parameters.rationale: Share of yesterday's flow-driven price push assumed to continue (1-day continuation, IC +0.026); starts small and is fit in T3.

parameters.name: a2_flow_reversal
parameters.rationale: 2-7 day reversal of flow-driven moves (micro 7d->7d IC -0.083 in Taoflow era, SubnetEdge '2 days then corrects').

parameters.name: alpha_lo
parameters.rationale: Market intercept at which exposure goes to zero; m_mkt = clip(1 + alpha0/|alpha_lo|, 0, 1).

parameters.name: alpha0_halflife
parameters.rationale: Memory of the common demand level; regime persistence is weeks (Taoflow -> price -> gate).

parameters.name: K_yield_epochs
parameters.rationale: Epochs (about 2 days at tempo 360) of delta ln I used for realised hotkey yield; EWMA half-life 20 epochs.

parameters.name: take_max
parameters.rationale: 18% default take costs 0.054-0.09%/day; zero-take hotkeys can raise to 18% in one tx, so we only need to react quickly.

parameters.name: yield_haircut
parameters.rationale: Uncertainty in realised-to-forward yield.

parameters.name: gA_max
parameters.rationale: Cap on trailing A_earn growth used for the yield decay factor exp(-gA*H/2); SN70 decayed 1.4%/day relative.

parameters.name: unc_z
parameters.rationale: Shrinkage of mu by model error SD; guards the winner's curse.

parameters.name: mu_in
parameters.rationale: Net-of-cost entry hurdle; central edge is only about 0.08%/day so the hurdle must be low but positive.

parameters.name: mu_out
parameters.rationale: Hysteresis below mu_in to limit churn costs.

parameters.name: min_hold_days
parameters.rationale: Amortise 0.6-1.1% round trip.

parameters.name: max_hold_days
parameters.rationale: Force re-evaluation; yields and sell loads drift.

parameters.name: T_min
parameters.rationale: Below this V is under 5 TAO, fixed fees and prune risk dominate.

parameters.name: T_max
parameters.rationale: Deeper pools give capacity but yields fall to 0.1-0.2%/day; 3,000 for micro-cap-only mode.

parameters.name: min_age_days
parameters.rationale: EMA warm-up and the new-launch family's -68% to -74% day-90 path.

parameters.name: v_cap
parameters.rationale: Hard pool-relative cap; sizes above 1% cost over 2% round trip.

parameters.name: s_max
parameters.rationale: Exit slippage budget; V_max = y*s/(1-s).

parameters.name: w_max
parameters.rationale: Single-name loss budget given 0.35-0.65x prune recovery and 2%-ish guard failure.

parameters.name: N_max
parameters.rationale: Qualifier count is the binding constraint; diversification of idiosyncratic owner/prune risk.

parameters.name: V_min
parameters.rationale: Fixed fees 0.00186 TAO round trip.

parameters.name: rank_in / rho_in
parameters.rationale: Entry distance from the prune ladder bottom; ranks 4-15 sit at 1.53-1.70x the target's EMA.

parameters.name: rank_exit / rho_exit
parameters.rationale: Hard-exit distance; 23% of victims were rank 1 for <24 h, 3/52 for <8 h.

parameters.name: kappa_p
parameters.rationale: P_bottom=exp(-kappa_p*(rho-1)); fit by logistic on the 52-prune log (T10).

parameters.name: rec
parameters.rationale: Dissolution recovery relative to spot (basket sales included).

parameters.name: burn_max
parameters.rationale: High MinerBurned means zero TAO and root-purge risk; research bucket only.

parameters.name: gate_band
parameters.rationale: CB>0 requires rp below about 0.35 near the bar; loop k_eff small, so tilt only.

parameters.name: owner_exit_frac
parameters.rationale: Owner exits dump -40-50% within hours (ORO, Covenant).

parameters.name: flow_exit
parameters.rationale: Continuation evidence implies outflows persist; keep rarely triggered.

parameters.name: dd_stop
parameters.rationale: Thesis stop; below the typical daily-vol-implied band to avoid noise exits but caps tail.

parameters.name: limit_margin_m
parameters.rationale: Covers N+2 landing drift; failed limits still pay the fee.

parameters.name: m_exit
parameters.rationale: Hard-exit price tolerance.

parameters.name: rebalance_blocks
parameters.rationale: 1 hour; faster adds cost, not information (inputs move at EMA speed).

parameters.name: drain_wait_blocks
parameters.rationale: Waiting for the drain adds +0.01-0.025% per epoch skipped, small but free for non-urgent exits.

parameters.name: hotkey_switch_min_gain
parameters.rationale: move_stake costs about 0.001 TAO and no swap fee.

parameters.name: spec_pause_blocks
parameters.rationale: Revalidation window after runtime upgrades (about 30 in 3 months).

parameters.name: enable_event_module
parameters.rationale: Ships off until T7 passes.

parameters.name: impact_persistence (backtest only)
parameters.rationale: 0 is the conservative fill model (entry and exit both pay own impact); 1 means own impact persists and round trip costs only fees; report both.

parameters.name: free_parameter_budget
parameters.default: tune at most 6: phi_o/phi_m (jointly), a1, a2, mu_in, H_eval
parameters.search_range: others fixed by protocol or risk preference
parameters.rationale: Only about 66-107 post-regime days of data; avoid overfitting.

expected_edge:
HONEST STATEMENT: the net edge is UNKNOWN, small if it exists, and the sign is uncertain until tests T2-T4 and paper trading are run. All figures below are priors from the brief plus my derivations, in %/day on deployed capital in TAO terms, simple returns, conservative temporary-impact cost model, TAO/USD irrelevant.
Component (low / central / high), basis:
- Nominator yield of a take<=5% hotkey on screened names, after decay haircut: 0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45 [P]: measured micro-cap net yield 0.3-0.6%/day, SN70 0.557, SN92 0.448; minus about 15% for decay (-1.4%/day relative at SN70) and haircut.
- Structural plus flow price drift of the screened book: -0.55 / -0.20 / 0.00. Universe average is -0.46 (EW) to -0.67 (small tercile) [R]; the screen is assumed to shift the book 0.25-0.55 points better by sorting on sell load, burn/auto-lock, basket overhang, flow gate and prune distance. THIS IS THE UNVERIFIED KEY ASSUMPTION.
- Gate-ramp tilt: 0 / +0.03 / +0.05 [derived: k_eff 0.4-1.9%/day].
- Gross total return: -0.30 / +0.18 / +0.50.
- Costs at profit-max sizes (0.15-0.7% of pool, hold 5-14 d, 2*0.0504% + 2V/(T+V) + tx 0.00186 TAO): -0.06 / -0.10 / -0.15.
- NET: -0.36 / +0.08 / +0.35 %/day.
Subjective scenario probabilities before testing: bear 45% (selection fails; net -0.10 to -0.25%/day, killed by T3-T4), base 35% (net +0.03 to +0.10), bull 20% (net +0.20 to +0.35). Unconditional expected net about +0.01%/day. Conditional on passing T2-T5 and 30+ days of paper trading, after a 40-50% winner's-curse haircut, the central expectation is about +0.04 to +0.06%/day net, 90% interval roughly -0.20 to +0.30.
Risk-free-ish sub-component: hotkey choice alone is worth +0.054%/day (at 0.3% yield) to +0.09%/day (at 0.5%) vs the 18%-take default, +0.01 to +0.03 vs a typical take-0 pick.
Capacity: deployable capital 60-250 TAO (micro-cap-only 40-120 TAO) before marginal net return reaches zero; central daily profit 0.05-0.2 TAO at 100-250 TAO deployed (about 15-70 TAO/year, roughly $4k-19k at TAO $268), explicitly assuming the base scenario holds. Expanding T_max to 20,000 raises capacity about 4x at yields of 0.1-0.2%/day and less negative drift, with correspondingly smaller per-TAO edge.
Sensitivities: each 0.1 point of phi-weighted sell load difference moves a young micro cap by about 0.15-0.3%/day; each 10% error in A_earn moves yield by 0.03-0.05%/day; fees x2 cost about 0.05-0.1%/day more at 5-day holds; persistent impact (impact_persistence=1) would add back about 0.05-0.15%/day.
failure_modes:
1. Sell-load model wrong or unstable: phi's near zero (no cross-sectional information) or time-varying with owner behaviour/auto-lock adoption. Detection: rolling T3 coefficients and OOS IC; action: fall back to yield-only mode or stop.
2. Yield mirage: A_earn rises as capital chases APY (yield -1.4%/day relative), take hikes 0 -> 18%, permit/bond loss, Null consensus (spec 475) altering dividends, no-miner epochs. Mitigation: realised-yield tracking, closed-form cross-check [0.65,1.35], fast move_stake, take_max, decay factor.
3. Prune or dissolution not caught (shielded registration, rank 2 -> 1 in <1 h): 0.35-0.65x recovery on 12% of capital worst case. Mitigation: ladder entry/exit rules, window-aware exits, never hold the target, w_max.
4. Root emission switch-off or purge, with price crashing before our N+2 order lands; MinerBurned-high names are the likeliest candidates (excluded by default).
5. Owner dump or key compromise (ORO, Covenant): -40-50% in hours; H4/H5 only partly protect. Size down where owner cut is liquid via S.
6. Regime changes (about 6 emission rules in 11 months, spec 475/476 'precise emissions', PoW registration, possible shorts/256 cap): model_ok check, spec pause, auto-disable of modules whose invariants fail.
7. Cost underestimation: pool shallower than modelled after owner dumps, shield misses (about 1% non-decrypt, never-included unmeasured), PriceLimitExceeded/SlippageTooHigh still paying fees, nonce lockout; tune limit margin; rotate delegates.
8. Backtest bias: T/A mismeasures v3-era micro-cap prices (use Balancer-era formula), netuid splicing, survivorship (must include dissolved subnets at actual payout), log vs simple return, forgetting I (yield), SubnetTaoFlow invalid across generations and includes registration collateral, SafeFloat decode errors.
9. Statistical weakness: 66-107 days; level tests cannot detect the central edge; overfitting through many thresholds (budget: 6 tuned parameters).
10. Common-factor drawdown: long-only micro caps lose 30-70% when the system turns net sell; cash is the only hedge; alpha0 filter reacts with a lag (days). No shorting.
11. Capacity and crowding: if others copy the screen, yield and sell-load advantages vanish; the edge is thin.
12. Execution and key safety: Staking proxy cannot transfer funds, but a leaked key can force bad round trips; the live adapter stays gated and is not part of this design's logic.
13. Tail events: SafeMode blocks exits for up to 10 days; chain freeze; alpha-fee trap if the delegate lacks TAO.
14. Data/infra: public RPC throttling (1 req/s), per-block queries must be batched (one state_queryStorageAt), event decoding needs runtime metadata per spec version; mis-decoded I96F32/U64F64/SafeFloat would corrupt every signal.
falsification_tests:
All tests use generation-keyed assets (netuid, NetworkRegisteredAt), era-correct prices (Balancer-era ((1-q)/q)*T/A from block 8,486,594), simple TAO returns, total return = price x I, dissolution payouts included at actual pot formula, regime splits at setCode block+1 (8,466,531 price-EMA; 8,713,794 gate q-mass; 8,765,684 rank-32 gate), and the conservative cost model (and the persistent-impact bound).
T1 Data identity (kills the pipeline, not the idea). On 60-block snapshots over the gate era, check d ln p = k_w*(CB + F)/y within tolerance: regress 1-day delta ln p on k_w*CB/y and k_w*dSubnetTaoFlow/y with subnet and day fixed effects. PASS: both coefficients in [0.7,1.3] and R^2 >= 0.7 on subnet-days with |flow|>0.2% of y. FAIL: fix data or model (reservoirs, weight drift, collateral buys) before anything else.
T2 Emission model validity. (a) E_model vs E_obs on all snapshots after block 8,765,684: median abs relative error < 1% for E>1 TAO/day. (b) 24-hour-ahead forecast of E with spots frozen: Spearman >= 0.95 vs realised, and R^2 >= 0.30 of realised vs forecast delta ln E for subnets with |delta ln E| > 10%. PASS both. KILL the forward-chain-buy tilt if R^2 < 0.10; HALT everything if (a) fails after spec 475/476 until the model is repaired.
T3 Structural sell load (the main economic hypothesis, high power: about 100 subnets x 66-107 days). Step B regression: k_w*dSubnetTaoFlow_{n,d}/y = day FE + sum_j beta_j*[k_w*S_j/y] + a1*phi_flow_{d-1} + a2*phi_flow_{d-7..d-2} + e, with S_j split into owner, miner and basket components, errors clustered by subnet and by day. PASS: owner and miner betas negative, each in [-1.5,-0.3], basket beta in [-1.0,0], combined |beta| t >= 2.0, signs stable in both halves of the gate era and in the 2026-06-23..07-27 sub-sample (using observed CB). KILL the sell-load term (set phi=0, i.e. pure yield carry) if the 90% CI of the combined beta includes zero. Also require cross-sectional SD of k_w*S/y among eligible subnets >= 0.3%/day, otherwise the screen has nothing to sort on.
T4 Selection engine, ex-ante, walk-forward (fit on trailing 45 days, trade next 14, slide 7). (a) HIGH-POWER spread test: top vs bottom quintile of mu_hat; 3-day and 5-day forward total returns; block bootstrap by 5-day blocks (10,000 draws). PASS: spread >= +0.25%/day with t >= 2.0, monotone quintiles (Spearman >= 0.8), mean daily Spearman IC >= 0.04 with t >= 2. KILL if spread <= 0 or t < 1. (b) LEVEL test: top-quintile net-of-cost mean (V sized by rules) with conservative impact. PASS: point estimate >= +0.05%/day and 90% bootstrap lower bound > -0.15%/day; KILL (hold TAO) if the 90% upper bound < 0 in the gate era. Note the minimum detectable level effect is only about 0.4%/day with this sample, so (b) can only reject disasters; it cannot confirm.
T5 Cost and execution robustness. Re-run T4(b) with swap fee x2, slippage x1.5, tx fee x2, an adverse 0.2% fill drift at N+2, 1% of orders failing with fees paid, and holding periods cut to min_hold. PASS: net >= 0 at all of these on the top quintile at v_cap = 0.5%; if it passes only at half size, halve v_cap and capacity; KILL if negative at base costs x1.5.
T6 Hotkey selection. For every (subnet, day) compare the ex-ante best hotkey (rules above) with the median take-<=18% dividend member over the next 5 days: PASS if paired excess delta ln I >= +0.03%/day with t >= 2 and switching losses (take hikes, permit loss) average < 0.02%/day. KILL dynamic switching (keep static best-take hotkey) if excess < +0.01%/day. Also verify nd/(TA-nd) approximation against exact delta ln I (< 1% relative).
T7 Event studies. (a) Re-enable events (n >= 47 on 2026-09-09, plus June-Aug trickle), CAR vs the EW eligible universe, entry at event+2 blocks and +1 epoch (feasible latencies), horizons 1 d and 7 d, net of costs. PASS to enable the module: mean 7-day net CAR >= +1.0% with 90% lower bound > 0 in both the 09-09 batch and the trickle subsample. (b) Disable events: CAR from event+2 blocks; the exit rule earns its keep only if mean 7-day CAR from the feasible exit is <= -1.0% (so exiting saves). Otherwise keep H1 only as a no-new-entry ban.
T8 Market-intercept filter ablation. With vs without m_mkt: PASS if OOS net return improves >= +0.03%/day or max drawdown falls >= 25%, without turning off > 40% of days in the gate era. Otherwise remove.
T9 Module ablation and regime stability. Compare nested models: yield-only (take-0 hotkey) < +sell load < +flow terms < +gate tilt < +event module. Each added module must add >= +0.03%/day net OOS (t >= 1.5) and keep its sign in at least 2 of 3 sub-periods (2026-06-23..07-27, 07-28..08-31, 09-01..10-08). Drop any module that fails.
T10 Prune and hazard accounting. Replay all 52 prunes with reconstructed ladder state: PASS if the guard would have flagged >= 90% of victims at least 30 minutes before P (shielded ones included), and flagged-but-not-pruned-within-7-days <= 40%; fit kappa_p by logistic regression on ladder states; verify that holding through prune at 0.5x recovery is correctly included in the unguarded benchmark. KILL entry rho_in/rank_in thresholds that cut more than 60% of the otherwise eligible universe without lowering realised prune losses.
T11 Optional drain-window microstructure. Average return in the 60 blocks after a subnet's drain vs other windows, regressed on drain_overhang. PASS to add an entry-timing rule: effect >= 0.15% of price with t >= 3; otherwise ignore.
T12 Paper-trading acceptance (the only real out-of-sample level test). At least 30 consecutive days, same code path as live, full cost model: PASS if net P&L >= 0, 80% of position cycles show positive realised delta ln I, realised-vs-predicted mu error (bias) within +-0.15%/day, and no un-guarded prune or disable loss; KILL/halt if rolling 30-day net < -3% of deployed capital, drawdown > 10%, or model_ok fails for > 24 h. Never go live because a backtest looks good; live remains a user-run, gated adapter.
