pseudocode:
# ================= constants and helpers =================
FEE = 33 / 65535                                   # read Swap.FeeRate[n] live
TX  = {"buy": 0.00103, "sell": 0.00083, "rot": 0.00125}      # TAO, Staking proxy + submit_shielded
def alpha_days(H): return min(H, 1.0) + P.alpha_tail * max(H - 1.0, 0.0)
# Pool, simulate_buy, simulate_sell as in brief sec. 2.7 (integer rao, weights from Swap.SwapBalancer)
# book[n] = Pos(gen, hotkey, alpha, entry_blk, fill_exec, peak_exec, weak=0, out_cycles=0, requal=0, min_hold)

# ================= handlers =================
def on_block(b, st):
    if st.safe_mode or st.stalled: return halt_all("safe_mode/stall")
    if st.spec_changed: freeze_entries("spec_version change")          # exits still allowed
    for n, pos in list(book.items()):                                   # (1) every block: hard risk exits
        why = hard_exit_reason(n, pos, st, b)
        if why: emit(Sell(n, pos.alpha, kind="HARD", reason=why, allow_partial=True, limit_frac=0.6)); blacklist(n, why)
    if b % P.scan_blocks == 0:  on_scan(b, st)                          # (2) 12-minute impulse path
    if b % P.rebal_blocks == 0: on_rebalance(b, st)                     # (3) hourly cycle

def hard_exit_reason(n, pos, st, b):
    if n not in st.networks or st.reg_at(n) != pos.gen: return "REMOVED_OR_REGEN"
    if not st.emission_enabled(n):                       return "EMISSION_OFF"
    if prune_exit(n, st):                                return "PRUNE_RISK"
    ev = st.exec_value(n, pos.alpha)                     # sim_swap_alpha_for_tao on full balance
    pos.peak_exec = max(pos.peak_exec, ev)
    stop = clip(P.k_stop * st.sigma_d(n), P.stop_floor, P.stop_cap)
    if ev <= (1 - stop) * pos.peak_exec:                 return "STOP"
    if st.nf(n, 300) <= -P.flow_rev_1h or st.nf(n, 1200) <= -2 * P.flow_rev_1h: return "FLOW_REVERSAL"
    if st.owner_event(n):                                return "OWNER"
    return None

def prune_exit(n, st):
    r = st.prune_rank(n)                                 # None if still immune
    if r is None: return False
    if r == 1 or st.prune_target == n: return True
    win   = st.window_open_in()                          # blocks until a registration is allowed
    cheap = st.reg_cost_now <= 1.2 * st.last_lock_cost
    tstar = st.t_star(n, stress_price=0.5 * st.pbar(n))
    return (r <= 3 and win <= 7200 and cheap) or (tstar < 3600 and win <= 3600)

def on_scan(b, st):                                      # P1: impulse path
    if frozen or st.entries_frozen(): return
    U = eligible(st, b); F, ctx = features(st, U)
    new = []
    for n in U:
        if n in book or not allowed(n, b): continue
        if F[n].impulse and F[n].S >= P.S_imp:
            c = candidate(n, F[n], ctx, st, "P1")
            if c: new.append(c)
    new.sort(key=lambda c: c.net_edge, reverse=True)
    commit([Buy(c) for c in new[:P.max_new_per_scan]], st)

def on_rebalance(b, st):                                 # P2: hourly cycle
    U = eligible(st, b); F, ctx = features(st, U)
    rank = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(sorted(U, key=lambda n: -F[n].S))}
    soft = [n for n, pos in book.items() if soft_exit(n, pos, F.get(n), rank.get(n), st, b)]
    cands = []
    for n in sorted(U, key=lambda n: -F[n].S)[:P.K + P.K_buf]:
        if n in book or not allowed(n, b) or F[n].S < ctx.S_in: continue
        c = candidate(n, F[n], ctx, st, "P2")
        if c: cands.append(c)
    cands.sort(key=lambda c: c.net_edge, reverse=True)
    plan = []
    for n_out in sorted(soft, key=lambda n: F[n].S if n in F else -9):          # weakest first
        pos = book[n_out]
        if cands:                                         # atomic rotation: one fee, no cash gap
            c = cands.pop(0)
            cost_rot, legs = rotation_cost(st.pool(n_out), pos.alpha, st.pool(c.n))
            if c.V <= st.exec_value(n_out, pos.alpha) * 1.02:
                plan.append(Rotate(n_out, c, limit=rot_limit(legs, P.limit_eps))); continue
            cands.insert(0, c)
        plan.append(Sell(n_out, pos.alpha, kind="SOFT", limit_frac=1 - P.limit_eps))
    for c in cands:                                       # fill free slots
        if len(book) - len(soft) + count_buys(plan) >= ctx.K_eff: break
        plan.append(Buy(c))
    plan += voluntary_rotations(book, F, cands, ctx, st)  # rare: needs EH gap >= RT_cand - savings + rot_margin
    plan += resize_orders(book, F, ctx, st)               # bands: act only if V_cur/V_tgt outside [0.6, 1.8]
    commit(apply_turnover_cap(plan, st), st)

# ================= universe, features, candidate =================
def eligible(st, b):
    U, nonimm = [], [j for j in st.networks if j and b >= st.reg_at(j) + st.immunity]
    asc = {j: i + 1 for i, j in enumerate(sorted(nonimm, key=lambda j: (st.ema(j), st.reg_at(j))))}
    desc = st.ema_desc_rank()
    for n in st.networks:
        if n == 0 or not st.subtoken(n) or st.first_emission_blk(n) is None: continue
        T = st.T(n) / 1e9; age_reg = b - st.reg_at(n)
        if b - st.first_emission_blk(n) < P.age_start_min: continue
        if not st.emission_enabled(n) or n in st.blacklist: continue
        if age_reg < P.age_reg_min or (age_reg < P.age_reg_full and desc[n] > P.young_rank_cut): continue
        if not (P.T_min <= T <= P.T_max) or st.miner_burned(n) > P.mb_max: continue
        if P.psi_s * st.dp(n) - st.cb_frac(n) > P.net_dil_max: continue
        if (n in asc and asc[n] <= P.prune_rank_excl) or st.prune_target == n: continue
        if n not in asc and st.imm_end(n) - b <= P.prune_imm_horizon and st.would_rank_asc(n) <= 8: continue
        if not (0.45 <= st.quote_weight(n) <= 0.55) or not st.has_hotkey(n, P.take_max) or not st.hist_ok(n, 7): continue
        U.append(n)
    return U

def features(st, U):
    f = {}
    for n in U:
        p = st.pbar(n); h = lambda k: st.pbar(n, lag=k)
        nf = lambda k: st.flow_delta(n, k) / st.T(n)
        pers, conc = st.flow_quality(n, 1200)
        f[n] = Feat(r4=ln(p/h(1200)), r24=ln(p/h(7200)), r7=ln(p/h(50400)),
                    nf1=nf(300), nf4=nf(1200), nf24=nf(7200), gap=ln(min(p, 1.0)/st.ema(n)),
                    pers=pers, conc=conc, zown=robust_z(nf(1200), st.hist_nf4(n, 14), floor=0.0025),
                    sl=st.struct_level(n), lag=st.struct_lag(n))
    z = {k: rank_gauss({n: getattr(f[n], k) for n in U}) for k in ("r24", "r7", "nf24", "gap")}
    S = rank_gauss({n: P.w_r24*z["r24"][n] + P.w_r7*z["r7"][n] + P.w_nf24*z["nf24"][n] + P.w_gap*z["gap"][n] for n in U})
    for n in U:
        x = f[n]; x.S = S[n]
        x.impulse = (x.zown >= P.z_imp and x.nf1 > 0 and x.r4 > 0 and x.pers >= P.pers_min
                     and x.conc <= P.conc_max and P.gap_min <= x.gap <= P.gap_max)
    ctx = Ctx(m_u=st.m_u(U), mean_struct=mean(f[n].sl for n in U), breadth=mean(f[n].r7 > 0 for n in U))
    ctx.K_eff  = P.K if ctx.breadth >= P.B_min else ceil(P.K / 2)
    ctx.S_in   = P.S_in if ctx.breadth >= P.B_min else P.S_in + 0.5
    ctx.turnover_left = P.turnover_cap * st.nav - st.buys_last_24h
    return f, ctx

def candidate(n, x, ctx, st, path):
    if st.pool_class(n) == "micro" and x.r7 > min(P.rev_cap, st.quantile_r7(P.rev_q)): return None   # weekly-reversal guard
    if x.r24 <= 0: return None
    hk = pick_hotkey(n, st)
    if hk is None: return None
    EH = P.H_e * (ctx.m_u + hk.y + P.kappa_s*(x.sl - ctx.mean_struct) + P.kappa_l*x.lag) + P.b_S * x.S * alpha_days(P.H_e)
    pool = st.pool(n); T = pool.tao / 1e9
    rho  = P.rho_micro if T < P.micro_cut else P.rho_near
    phi  = 2*FEE + 2*P.lat
    V = min(T*max(0.0, EH - phi)/(4*P.lam), rho*T, T*P.s_exit/(1 - P.s_exit),
            P.w_max*st.nav, st.free_tao - P.fee_buffer, ctx.turnover_left)
    if V < P.v_min: return None
    buy  = simulate_buy(pool, rao(V))                                   # exact pool math
    sell = simulate_sell(buy.new_pool, buy.alpha_out)                   # round trip on own impact
    RT   = (V - sell.tao_out/1e9)/V + (TX["buy"] + TX["sell"])/V
    net  = EH - RT - 2*P.lat
    if net < P.net_margin: return None
    return Cand(n=n, hk=hk, V=V, EH=EH, net_edge=net, RT=RT, path=path,
                min_hold=int(clip(RT/max(EH/P.H_e, 5e-4), 1.0, 4.0) * 7200),
                limit=ceil(buy.new_pool.spot()*1e9*(1 + P.limit_eps)))

def pick_hotkey(n, st):
    ks = [h for h in st.alpha_div_keys(n) if st.take(h) <= P.take_max and st.childkey_take(h) == 0]
    if not ks: return None
    h = max(ks, key=lambda k: st.dln_I(k, n, 50400))                    # ex-ante trailing realised yield
    y = min(st.y_closed(n, h), st.dln_I(h, n, 50400) / 7)
    return Hk(h, y) if y >= 0 else None

def soft_exit(n, pos, x, rk, st, b):
    age = b - pos.entry_blk
    if age < pos.min_hold: return None                                  # hard exits already handled every block
    if x is None:
        pos.out_cycles += 1; return "UNIVERSE" if pos.out_cycles >= 2 else None
    pos.out_cycles = 0
    pos.weak = pos.weak + 1 if x.S < P.S_out else 0
    if pos.weak >= 2 or rk > P.K + P.K_buf: return "DECAY"
    cap = P.max_hold_micro if st.pool_class(n) == "micro" else P.max_hold_near
    if age >= cap:
        if x.S >= P.S_in and pos.requal < P.requalify_max: pos.requal += 1; pos.entry_blk = b; return None
        return "TIMEOUT"
    if x.gap > P.gap_trim and not pos.trimmed: pos.trimmed = True; emit(Sell(n, pos.alpha // 2, kind="TRIM"))
    return None

# ================= costs, rotation, limits =================
def rotation_cost(pool_o, alpha_in, pool_d):
    # move/swap_stake_limit across subnets: fee charged once on the origin leg, destination leg fee-free
    sell = simulate_sell(pool_o, alpha_in)                              # fee on origin
    buy  = simulate_buy(replace(pool_d, fee_rate=0), sell.tao_out)      # destination leg without fee
    cost = alpha_in/1e9*pool_o.spot() - buy.alpha_out/1e9*pool_d.spot() + TX["rot"]
    return cost, (sell.new_pool, buy.new_pool, buy.alpha_out)

def rot_limit(legs, eps):                                               # min destination alpha per origin alpha, x1e9
    po, pd, _ = legs
    return int((po.spot() / pd.spot()) * (1 - eps) * 1e9)

def commit(plan, st):
    for o in plan:
        o = requote(o, st)                                              # fresh sim at head; entries re-run the cost gate
        if not o.valid: continue
        if MODE == "backtest":  fill_at_decision_state(o, lat=P.lat)    # + stress variants lat=0.003, +12 min delay
        elif MODE == "paper":   shadow_fill(o, block=st.head + 3)       # exact pool math at the N+2/N+3 state
        else:                   submit_shielded(o)                      # gated live adapter (user-run only)

name: Flow-Shock Dip Reversion with Prune/Emission Guards and a Self-Disabling Edge Gate (FSDR)
thesis:
PREMISE CHECK. A subnet pool is the only market for its alpha (SN8 on Kraken is the lone exception), so there is no arbitrage leg that pulls spot back to a fair value. In the weighted pool (w about 0.5) a user trade of signed pool-relative size phi (TAO side, sells negative) moves ln(spot) by exactly 2*ln(1+phi), and nothing in the AMM reverses it. 'Impact decays as arbitrage refills' is therefore false here. Reversion needs opposing flow, and only four sources exist:

M1 Protocol bid that does not react to the shock. SubnetExcessTao (chain buys, TAO per block) is set by the EMA share, and the EMA is a low-pass filter (a = 0.0003/block, about 8 h half-life). A one-block 10% dump moves SubnetMovingPrice by only a*D = 0.003%, so the bid keeps flowing through the dump and partly refills the pool. Size: a micro cap with 20 TAO/day emission and half of it chain-bought on T = 1,500 gives bid_day/T = 0.67%/day, which is +0.056%/h of price, or about 0.7% in 12 h. That is at most 10% of an 8% shock, and it is exactly zero on the bottom-tercile subnets that receive nothing (tercile median is 0 TAO/day). It is a sweetener, not the thesis.
M2 Bounded window. Emission feedback (price -> EMA -> share -> bid) is continuation, but it acts on SUSTAINED displacement: 50% of a persistent gap is in the EMA after 8 h and 88% after 24 h. So for roughly 12 h a transient dump is not yet punished by lower emission; after that the sign flips to continuation. Hence a hard 12 h hold cap and an early 'no recovery by 6 h' exit.
M3 Forced, price-insensitive, non-informational sellers: claim_root (fee-free, no price limit), UnstakeAll / UnstakeAllAlpha (no price limit), nominator-dust force-sells, a thief draining a wallet (ORO SN15, about 147k alpha over about 10 h). When such a seller finishes, part of the displacement is a pure liquidity premium.
M4 Behavioural fade: 'a handful of traders' dominate volume in thin pools (FalconX), so many block-sized moves are discrete orders by round-trippers or noise traders, and EMA-reversion DCA bots exist (tududes/btt-subnet-dca).
Only M3 and M4 can supply the roughly 25% recovery needed to break even (see expected_edge). M1 supplies about 5-10% at most and only above the gate.

WHERE REVERSION IS NOT EXPECTED (design consequences): (a) the daily cross-section (REV -0.53 to -0.57%/day, t about -3: yesterday's losers keep losing); (b) basket claim bursts: claim_root moves alpha from escrow into the pool and the TAO leaves to root, a PERMANENT float transfer. Impact is D = 2*c*E/x, so even a 5% burst on the worst overhang (E/x = 43%, SN58) is only 4.3%, below the 8% shock threshold and below break-even. Bursts are a drift/AVOID filter, not an entry; (c) epoch-drain sawtooth: about 212 liquid alpha per 360-block epoch against x of about 435k (SN92) is 0.10% of price, below the fee; (d) owner/insider dumps: informational, so ban and exit; (e) slow spot-vs-EMA dips with no discrete event: the slow EMA DRIVES emission, so spot below EMA predicts a lower future bid. That is continuation, so Arm C is shadow-only and meant to be falsified.

LONG-ONLY CONSEQUENCE. Only negative displacements can be bought. Positive displacements are used to refuse entries and, on held inventory, as sell-into-spike exits. The bot cannot short (ShortsEnabled = false).

STRATEGY. A narrow, event-conditioned, small-size dip buyer. Detect a single-burst dump of 8-30% (log) that the pool-delta identity attributes to flow. Require an eligible, non-dying subnet. Wait about 2 minutes for the selling to stop and a first bid to appear. Buy at most 0.5% of the pool TAO. Exit at 60% recovery, at 12 h, or on thesis failure. Hard-gate everything against prune, emission-off, owner dump, escrow overhang and dilution. An empirical edge gate, calibrated on shadow data that includes untraded events and shrunk to a conservative prior (rho0 = 0.15), disables the strategy whenever the lower confidence bound of expected net edge is below break-even.
evidence_for:
All weak or indirect. The brief contains no study of block-level impact decay in dTAO pools.
1. Mechanics [P]: no external anchor, but (i) the chain-buy bid is EMA-based and does not react to a one-block shock (a = 0.0003/block), (ii) price-insensitive fee-free/no-limit sellers exist (claim_root, UnstakeAll, dust force-sells), (iii) fills are exact CPMM, so costs are computable and small orders are cheap (round trip about 2*alpha + 0.10% + 0.00186 TAO).
2. Market structure [S, FalconX]: over a third of subnets have volume driven by their top 20 holders; single traders move even large subnets 10% or more. That means discrete block-size orders, the raw material for shock events.
3. Taoflow-era micro-tercile 7d->7d IC -0.083 (t -1.9), weekly reversal driven by flows [R]. This is a DEAD regime (Taoflow was replaced on 2026-06-22), so it is suggestive only.
4. SubnetEdge (2026-01-29): large inflows such as SN56 +1,521 TAO held about 2 days, then corrected [S, Taoflow regime, single anecdote]. It supports only the sell-into-spike exit.
5. Maymin REV sub-sample moved from -1.40 to -0.31%/day (continuation fading) [A].
6. Carry: nominator yield of 0.3-0.6%/day on micro caps [P] offsets part of the drift while holding. It is small over a 12 h cap, so it is not load-bearing.
7. Risk-structure facts that make filtering feasible [P]: the prune rule matched 52 of 52 events; the prune-free window of 14,400 blocks after each registration; emission-off is strongly associated with later pruning; E/x and MinerBurned are readable on chain.
evidence_against:
1. The strongest evidence is against. The 1-day REV factor is -0.53 to -0.57%/day (t -2.8 to -3.5) in the gate era and 1d->1d IC is +0.026 (t 3.8). Daily losers continue, and a dip buyer is long daily losers. [R]
2. Gate-era small-tercile price drift is -0.57 to -0.67%/day (72-81% of subnets with negative cumulative log return) [R]. Seeded launches fall a median 68-74% by day 90 (0 of 11 positive) and are still drifting about -1%/day between day 60 and day 90. Dips cluster in dying, diluted subnets (adverse selection).
3. The reflexive loop (price -> 8 h EMA -> emission share -> chain buys; 'rank 36 +10% demand -> +26% emission') makes SUSTAINED displacement self-reinforcing. Reversion can live only inside the roughly 12 h window before the EMA absorbs the move.
4. No restoring force in the AMM. The mechanical refill (protocol bid) is about 0.05-0.1 of an 8% shock in 12 h and is zero below the gate. Claim bursts are permanent float transfers (max impact 4.3% at E/x = 43%).
5. Costs and capacity: break-even recovery is about 25% of the shock; per-event profit is about T*(g-c)^2/8, roughly 0.05-0.25 TAO per event at T of 1,000-1,500, so useful sleeve size is about 10-50 TAO.
6. Sample size and non-stationarity: the rank-32-gate regime has only about 66 days (since block 8,765,683); there were about 6 emission regimes in 11 months; no block-level reversion study exists. The Taoflow-era reversal evidence is from a dead regime.
7. Informational vs liquidity shocks cannot be separated reliably on chain. Owner exits, Quasar-style allegations and Covenant-style exits are informational and look identical to liquidity dumps in pool data, so the label taxonomy is a heuristic.
8. Prune (0.35-0.65x spot recovery), emission-off waves (54 subnets in one block), SafeMode (no exits) and the absence of mempool warning are tail risks that a stop cannot cover in a thin pool.
9. Execution latency: shielded orders land at N+2 (24 s) and about 1% do not decrypt, and 'never included' is unmeasured. Any edge concentrated in the first minute is unreachable.
universe_filter:
Evaluate every block; a subnet is eligible for NEW entries only if ALL of the following hold (point-in-time values). Keys are (netuid, NetworkRegisteredAt); any change of NetworkRegisteredAt resets all state for that netuid.
U1 n != 0, n in NetworksAdded.
U2 SubtokenEnabled[n] = true AND FirstEmissionBlockNumber[n] set AND SubnetEmissionEnabled[n] = true (explicit or default true) AND no SubnetEmissionEnabledSet event for n in the last 100,800 blocks (14 days). This excludes every new launch (they start disabled).
U3 Pool band 400 <= T <= 3,500 TAO (T = SubnetTAO/1e9). Micro-cap definition is < 3,000; the band below 400 is excluded because a single 5-TAO order moves it more than 3%.
U4 Age: now - NetworkRegisteredAt >= 648,000 blocks (90 d) AND b = now - (FirstEmissionBlockNumber - 1) >= 432,000 (60 d). This leaves the launch-decay phase (day 30-90 median -57% to -68%) to the new-launch family.
U5 MinerBurned[n] <= 0.30. This is the on-chain proxy for the root switch-off criterion 'no active miner distribution'; 26-27 subnets with MinerBurned >= 0.99 receive zero emission.
U6 Prune guard (prune_gate below): not the current prune target, and either inside a prune-free window long enough for the planned hold, or cushion >= 0.30 above the prune-target EMA with ladder rank >= 6, a stress prune clock longer than the hold, and a registration-hazard cap.
   Candidate set L = non-immune subnets (now >= NetworkRegisteredAt + NetworkImmunityPeriod) UNION immune subnets whose immunity ends within H_plan + 7,200 blocks. Rank L ascending by (SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt); rank 1 is the target. A subnet not in L (immune for longer than the hold plus a day) passes U6.
U7 Overhang: escrow ratio E/x <= 0.20 (E = beta-basket escrow alpha on n, x = SubnetAlphaIn), and dilution load <= 1.5% of X per day (definition under signal dilution_load). The brief's snapshot would remove SN70 (26%), SN103 (22.5%), SN76 (35%), SN58 (43%) and SN90 (30%).
U8 Insider: n not on the owner/insider ban list (owner-set net sells of >= 0.25% of X in one trade or >= 1.0% of X in 7 d => 14 d ban); OwnerSet and owner-cut flags known.
U9 get_subnet_to_prune() != n (cross-check every 25 blocks against the local ladder).
U10 Global gates: spec_version equals the last validated spec (else halt entries); SafeMode.EnteredUntil = 0; head block age < 30 s and finalized lag < 20 blocks; breadth (share of eligible-or-near subnets down >= 3% over 25 blocks) < 0.30; no emission wave (>= 3 SubnetEmissionEnabledSet=false in one block) in 7 d; both RPC sources agree on T within 0.01%.
U11 At least 14 days of same-generation block-level history in the buffers (for the quiet-before, ECDF and drawdown checks).
Carry is optional: a take-0 hotkey in AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n, .) is preferred (YieldRouter). If none exists the carry term is set to 0; it is not an exclusion.
Expected size of the eligible set: roughly 6-20 subnets at any time (planning estimate, UNVERIFIED). Existing positions are managed even if a subnet drops out of the universe.

signals.name: spot_and_depth
signals.formula: T = SubnetTAO[n]/1e9; X = SubnetAlphaIn[n]/1e9; wq = Swap.SwapBalancer[n].quote/1e18 (Perquintill, first 8 bytes u64/1e18); P = ((1 - wq)/wq) * T / X (TAO per alpha). Do not hard-code wq = 0.5. Fee f = Swap.FeeRate[n] (absent -> 33)/65535. Cross-check P against SwapRuntimeApi_current_alpha_price(n)/1e9 every 300 blocks (tolerance 1e-6 relative).
signals.inputs: SubtensorModule.SubnetTAO (Identity u16 LE -> u64), SubtensorModule.SubnetAlphaIn, Swap.SwapBalancer (Twox64Concat), Swap.FeeRate, runtime API SwapRuntimeApi_current_alpha_price; Era C only (block >= 8,486,594) for exact math
signals.update_trigger: every new head block

signals.name: flow_phi_and_identity_check
signals.formula: inj_t = SubnetTaoInEmission[n]@t + SubnetExcessTao[n]@t (per-block values, /1e9); phi_t = (T_t - T_{t-1} - inj_t)/T_{t-1} (signed pool-relative user flow, TAO side; sells negative). Expected log move r_exp_t = 2*ln(1 + phi_t); observed r_obs_t = ln(P_t/P_{t-1}); resid_t = r_obs_t - r_exp_t. Flag the block as 'unexplained' if |resid_t| > 0.01 (reservoir release, migration, weight artefact) and exclude it from shock detection. Alpha-side equivalent: sell of psi = alpha_in/X has |phi| = psi/(1+psi).
signals.inputs: SubnetTAO, SubnetTaoInEmission, SubnetExcessTao (UNVERIFIED that these are overwritten per block rather than accumulated; verify in the research phase), Swap.SwapBalancer; for tail subnets with zero emission inj is 0 and phi is exact
signals.update_trigger: every new head block

signals.name: shock_displacement
signals.formula: For w in {1,5,25}: D_w(t) = ln(P_t/P_{t-w}); r_j = ln(P_{t-j}/P_{t-j-1}) for j = 0..w-1; conc = max_j|r_j| / sum_j|r_j|; phi_sum = sum_j phi_{t-j}. A shock requires -D_max <= D_w <= -D_min (default 0.08..0.30), conc >= 0.60, |D_w - 2*ln(1+phi_sum)| <= 0.01. Record P_pre = P_{t-w}, P_low = min P over the window, t0 = t. Shock log-size maps to pool fractions: D = -0.08 <=> alpha sold psi = 4.08% of X <=> phi = -3.92% of T. Recovery state R_t = ln(P_t/P_low)/ln(P_pre/P_low). Quiet-before: at most 1 prior single-block drop >= 4% in the previous 300 blocks, pre_24h = ln(P_pre/P_{pre-7200}) >= -0.25, pre_7d = ln(P_pre/P_{pre-50400}) >= -0.45.
signals.inputs: buffers of spot_and_depth and flow_phi_and_identity_check (60,000 blocks per subnet)
signals.update_trigger: every new head block, for eligible subnets

signals.name: ema_gap_and_trend
signals.formula: S = SubnetMovingPrice[n] (I96F32/2^32); F = SubnetFastMovingPrice[n] (U64F64/2^64, Option; absent -> S). gap_s = ln(P/S); gap_f = ln(P/F); q_f = ECDF over the trailing 14 d of gap_f at its current value. trend = ln(F/S) evaluated at block t0-1 (pre-shock, so the shock does not contaminate F). Entry condition: trend >= -0.005 (the slow EMA is not already falling, so the emission bid is not decaying). Closed form for noise scale: std(ln P - ln F) about sigma_blk*sqrt(433) and std(ln P - ln S) about sigma_blk*sqrt(1667) for a random walk. The ECDF is used because the series is jumpy. gap_s on its own is NOT an entry signal (Arm C is shadow only).
signals.inputs: SubtensorModule.SubnetMovingPrice, SubtensorModule.SubnetFastMovingPrice (both Identity u16)
signals.update_trigger: every new head block (S updates in block_step after run_coinbase)

signals.name: structural_bid_and_dilution
signals.formula: bid_blk = trailing-300-block mean of SubnetExcessTao[n]/1e9; bid_day = 7200*bid_blk/T; beta_hr = 300*bid_blk/T; drift_bid_hr = 2*beta_hr (price). dilution_load (fraction of X per day) = 7200*(0.18*owner_liquid + 0.41*(1 - min(MinerBurned,1)))/X where owner_liquid = OwnerCutEnabled && !OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled. NSF_day = 2*(bid_day - dilution_load) (net structural price pressure per day if all liquid alpha is sold). Bid bucket for calibration: B0 beta_hr = 0, B1 < 0.0003, B2 >= 0.0003. Example: SN92 dilution_load about 0.98%/day of X with a near-zero bid.
signals.inputs: SubnetExcessTao, MinerBurned (Identity, U96F32/2^32), OwnerCutEnabled, OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled (item names UNVERIFIED), SubnetAlphaIn
signals.update_trigger: every 50 blocks and at each epoch drain

signals.name: prune_clock
signals.formula: imm_end_k = NetworkRegisteredAt[k] + NetworkImmunityPeriod (864,000). L = candidate set (see universe_filter U6). rank_k = position of k in L sorted by (SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt) ascending (this rule matched 52 of 52 prunes); E1 = SubnetMovingPrice of rank 1. cushion_k = P_k/E1 - 1. a_k = SubnetMovingAlpha*b_k/(b_k + EMAPriceHalvingBlocks) with b_k = now - (FirstEmissionBlockNumber_k - 1). Stress prune clock with spot falling to s = 0.5*P_k: t_star_k = ln((S_k - s)/(E1 - s))/a_k if s < E1 < S_k, 0 if S_k <= E1, +inf if s >= E1. prune_free = max(0, LastRateLimitedBlock[NetworkLastRegistered] + NetworkRateLimit - now). Registration hazard from the inter-registration gap CDF F (seed table: gap 14,401 -> 0; 31k -> 0.09; 43k -> 0.19; 50k -> 0.31; 55k -> 0.50; 60k -> 0.72; 65k -> 0.84; 71k -> 0.94; 99,900 -> 1.0; linear interpolation, updated online): p_reg(H | g0) = (F(g0+H) - F(g0))/(1 - F(g0)), g0 = now - last_reg. Also lock-cost covariate: registrants typically wait until lock cost <= about the previous lock (about 8 days), so if prune_free = 0 and cost <= 1.2*NetworkLastLockCost treat p_reg as at least 0.5 for H >= 3,600.
signals.inputs: SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt, NetworkImmunityPeriod, NetworkRateLimit, LastRateLimitedBlock(RateLimitKey::NetworkLastRegistered, key suffix 0x02), NetworkLastLockCost, SubnetMovingAlpha, EMAPriceHalvingBlocks, FirstEmissionBlockNumber; SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune (cross-check); SubnetRegistrationRuntimeApi_get_network_registration_cost
signals.update_trigger: every block for the ladder (one pass over about 128 subnets); registration events reset g0; hazard table updated at each NetworkRegistrationQueued

signals.name: emission_state_and_gate
signals.formula: en_k = SubnetEmissionEnabled[k] (absent -> true). b_k = SubnetMovingPrice_k*(1 - min(MinerBurned_k,1)) normalised over eligible subnets; theta = EmissionGateBar (U64F64/2^64); h = EmissionGateExponent (unset -> 3); keep_k = 1/(1 + (theta/b_k)^h) (fraction of share kept after the Hill gate); gate_rank_k = rank of b_k (bar is the rank-32 value, recomputed when block % 360 == 0). flips14_k = count of SubnetEmissionEnabledSet events for k in 100,800 blocks. wave = number of enabled->disabled flips in a single block.
signals.inputs: SubnetEmissionEnabled, MinerBurned, SubnetMovingPrice, EmissionGateBar, EmissionBarRank, EmissionGateExponent, event SubnetEmissionEnabledSet{netuid, enabled}
signals.update_trigger: on SubnetEmissionEnabledSet; every 360 blocks for theta and ranks

signals.name: escrow_overhang
signals.formula: E_n = sum of alpha on netuid n over all positions of the beta-basket escrow account (AccountId32 bytes 'modl' ++ 'subtensr' ++ 'beta/esc', zero padded to 32); ratio = E_n/X; dissolution haircut = E_n/(X + E_n); one-shot sale price drop = 1 - 1/(1 + E_n/X)^2; claim_burst_day = max(0, 1 - E_t/E_{t-7200}) (a lower bound, since deposits offset it); expected claim drag per day = 2*0.02*E_n/X (about 0.2%/day at E/x = 5.3%, 1.0% at 26%). Entry requires ratio <= 0.20.
signals.inputs: StakeInfoRuntimeApi_get_stake_info_for_coldkey(escrow account); BetaBasketRuntimeApi_get_all_validator_baskets / get_validator_basket_nav; SubnetAlphaIn
signals.update_trigger: every 300 blocks and on Basket* events

signals.name: owner_flow
signals.formula: OwnerSet_n = {coldkey of SubnetOwner[n], coldkey that owns the owner hotkey}. own_sold_7d = sum of alpha removed by OwnerSet on n over 50,400 blocks, divided by X; own_single_max = largest single removal divided by X. Ban n for 100,800 blocks if own_single_max >= 0.0025 or own_sold_7d >= 0.01. Also ban on SubnetOwnerChanged and on StakeLocked/Unlocked events that switch a lock from perpetual to decaying.
signals.inputs: System.Events StakeRemoved(cold, hot, tao, alpha, netuid, fee); SubnetOwner and owner hotkey items (names UNVERIFIED); fallback poll StakeInfoRuntimeApi_get_stake_info_for_coldkey(owner coldkeys) every 50 blocks; events SubnetOwnerChanged, StakeLocked/Unlocked
signals.update_trigger: every block (events) or every 50 blocks (poll fallback)

signals.name: flow_label
signals.formula: From the events of the shock window grouped by extrinsic (phase = ApplyExtrinsic(i)): sold_alpha_by_cold. whale_share = max_cold(sold)/sum(sold). Labels: OWNER if the top seller is in OwnerSet (never trade, ban); FORCED if the top seller's extrinsic has fee = 0 sells on >= 2 netuids plus a netuid-0 StakeAdded (claim_root signature; validate against the claim_root call name in decoded extrinsics), or is a multi-netuid UnstakeAll (fee > 0, >= 3 netuids); WHALE if whale_share >= 0.6 otherwise; DIFFUSE if no seller has >= 0.6 (reduce confidence, calibrate separately); UNKNOWN in Tier-0 (no events). Calibration groups for the edge gate are {FORCED}, {WHALE, UNKNOWN}, {DIFFUSE}; OWNER is never traded. ROUND_TRIP flag if the seller coldkey bought n within the previous 48 h (needs an event ledger, backfilled from Taostats stake-events).
signals.inputs: System.Events decoded with scalecodec and the runtime metadata for that spec version (EventRecord phase, event, topics); positional StakeAdded/StakeRemoved(cold, hot, tao, alpha, netuid, fee); optional Taostats /v1/subnets/stake-events?netuid&coldkey&action for backfill
signals.update_trigger: on each shock candidate, using the events of blocks t-w+1..t

signals.name: systemic_breadth
signals.formula: breadth_t = (number of subnets in the universe-or-near set with D_25 <= -0.03) / (size of that set). If breadth >= 0.30, all idiosyncratic entry logic is suspended for 7,200 blocks (a market-wide or protocol shock such as a root purge or a TAO crash is not a liquidity dump of one holder). Shadow-evaluate these separately.
signals.inputs: shock_displacement buffers for all non-root subnets
signals.update_trigger: every block

signals.name: edge_gate
signals.formula: cell = (label_group, size_bucket(D_rem), bid_bucket). D_rem = ln(P_pre/P_t) at decision time. CAL[cell] holds n, rho_mean, se estimated from the SHADOW log of all shocks (traded or not) at the matching horizon H, with rho_H = ln(P_{t0+H}/P_low)/ln(P_pre/P_low) measured at a FIXED horizon on mid prices. Shrinkage rho = (n*rho_mean + 20*0.15)/(n + 20); rho_lcb = rho - 0.84*se_shrunk. eps = mean recovery already realised at the entry block (estimated from shadow data, default 0.10). g = (rho_lcb - eps)*D_rem. Cost c(alpha) = 2*alpha/(1+alpha) + 2*f + (TX_BUY + TX_SELL)/(alpha*T) + (drift_prior - y_net)*H/7200, with f = FeeRate/65535 about 0.000504, TX_BUY = 0.00103, TX_SELL = 0.00083, drift_prior = 0.006/day (gate-era small tercile), y_net from YieldRouter (0 if no earning hotkey). Break-even rho*(D_rem, alpha) = eps + c(alpha)/D_rem. alpha* = clip((g - c0)/4, 0, alpha_max) with c0 = 2f + (drift_prior - y_net)*H/7200; expected net = g - c(alpha*). Trade only if expected net >= 0.004 (absolute) and rho_lcb >= rho* + 0.05. Self-disable a cell if its realised rolling-20 mean net < -0.005.
signals.inputs: shadow log (SQLite/DuckDB table shock_log with forward mid-price path at horizons 10, 25, 60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600, 7200, 14400 blocks), CAL tables, YieldRouter.best_hotkey, FeeRate
signals.update_trigger: on each setup that passes stabilization; CAL refreshed when a shadow shock's longest horizon completes

signals.name: chain_health
signals.formula: stall = (now_ts - Timestamp.Now of head) > 30 s or finalized_lag > 20 blocks; spec_changed = state_getRuntimeVersion.specVersion != validated_spec; safemode = SafeMode.EnteredUntil != 0; rpc_disagree = |T_a - T_b|/T_a > 1e-4 between two independent endpoints for the same block hash. Any true => no new entries; safemode => freeze (exits impossible).
signals.inputs: chain_subscribeNewHeads, Timestamp.Now, state_getRuntimeVersion, SafeMode.EnteredUntil, two RPC endpoints (own lite node preferred; OnFinality as secondary)
signals.update_trigger: every block; spec every 25 blocks

entry_rules:
Arm A (the only arm that can trade; MODE must be PAPER or LIVE_GATED). All checks use point-in-time data. Order of evaluation matters because the cheap checks run on every block.
STEP 1 Shock detection (every block, eligible subnets only): see signal shock_displacement. Create a SETUP (not a trade) when: D_w in [-0.30, -0.08] for some w in {1,5,25}; concentration >= 0.60; identity residual <= 0.01; quiet-before conditions hold; pre-shock trend ln(F/S) >= -0.005; flow_label != OWNER; breadth < 0.30; at most 1 live setup per subnet.
STEP 2 Stabilization (no falling knives). Let t_imp be the last block with phi <= -0.0025 (a further 0.25% of T sold). Enter the decision stage only when: now - t_imp >= W_stab (10 blocks = 2 min); net flow since the shock >= -0.0025 (selling has stopped); no new low below P_low*(1 - 0.01) after the shock (two new lows => cascade, drop the setup); at least one buy block with phi >= +0.001 since the shock (a bid exists); recovered fraction R_now <= 0.35 (else the edge has gone); now - t0 <= 600 blocks (setup expiry).
STEP 3 Risk gates (all must pass at the decision block, using H_plan = H_max = 3,600 blocks): universe_filter U1-U11 (prune_gate with H_plan; escrow overhang; dilution; owner ban; claim guard: no entry on a subnet with a claim-labelled sell of >= 0.3% of X in the last 3,600 blocks while Arm B is off). Record exit_by_block if the entry relies on the prune-free waiver.
STEP 4 Edge gate: compute cell, rho_lcb, g, alpha*, expected net as defined. Require expected net >= 0.4% and rho_lcb >= rho* + 0.05. If the cell has n < 15 shadow events, rho collapses to the prior 0.15, which is below the break-even for almost all sizes, so the strategy does not trade until the shadow log has earned the right (this is intentional).
STEP 5 Sizing, then order: buy v TAO (see sizing) as AddStakeLimit with limit = spot*(1 + max(1.5%, 2*alpha + 0.5%)), allow_partial = false, shielded (submit_shielded), through the Staking proxy, to the YieldRouter hotkey (take 0, in AlphaDividendsPerSubnet; otherwise any valid hotkey). Re-quote with sim_swap immediately before submission; abort if the quote's alpha out is 0 or the post-trade marginal price exceeds the limit. One position per subnet; at most 3 concurrent; no averaging down, no second tranche.
Arm B (FORCED label, claim_root/UnstakeAll): identical to Arm A but only enabled when the calibration cell FORCED has n >= 20 events and rho_lcb >= rho* + 0.05 (falsification test F12). Default OFF; claim-labelled flows are otherwise an AVOID flag.
Arm C (slow spot-below-EMA dip, q_f <= 0.05 and gap_s <= -0.05 with no discrete shock): SHADOW ONLY. It exists to be falsified; it never submits orders.
Arm O (owner/insider dump): never enters; only produces bans and exits; the post-dump rebound (24 h-7 d) is shadow-logged.
Arm D (pump fade): not an entry; see exit rule X6.
exit_rules:
Priority order; the first rule that fires wins. Always exit a position FULLY (never leave a remainder under 0.02 TAO-equivalent: nominator-dust force-sale at no limit). Never use UnstakeAll; use RemoveStakeLimit per position. Re-read the position from chain after any exit; never size from StakeAdded events.
X0 Risk exits (immediate, high urgency, allow_partial = true, limit = spot*(1 - 10%), repeat each block until flat): SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(n, false); get_subnet_to_prune() == n or rank 1 on the local ladder; NetworkRemoved(n) (position already liquidated at about 0.35-0.65x spot: book the loss, add 1 to prune_hits); prune cushion < 0.15 when not inside a prune-free waiver; owner/insider ban triggered; escrow E/x rises above 0.30 or a claim burst >= 3.5% in 7,200 blocks; MinerBurned crosses 0.60; SubtokenEnabled false (sells still work); rpc/finality stall resolved with an adverse price gap; waiver window ending (now >= exit_by_block).
X1 Target: R_now >= 0.60 (60% of the log shock recovered from P_low) AND simulated exit net P&L (sim_swap alpha->TAO, after the 0.0504% fee and TX_SELL) >= +0.3% => sell all with limit = spot*(1 - 3%), allow_partial = false.
X2 Soft time stop at 1,800 blocks (6 h): if R_now < 0.20, exit (the transient thesis has failed and the EMA drag is starting).
X3 Hard time stop at 3,600 blocks (12 h): exit regardless of P&L (one half-life of EMA drag, carry is irrelevant at this horizon).
X4 Thesis stop: spot <= max(P_low_at_entry*(1 - 0.03), P_entry_exec*(1 - 0.12)) => exit. Honest caveat: a bot-level stop in a thin pool is porous (N+2 latency, about 2-3% exit slippage); the real protection is the 0.5%-of-pool position size and the filters.
X5 Sleeve circuit breakers stop new entries only (open positions follow X0-X4, no panic liquidation into thin pools): daily loss > 3% of sleeve NAV => halt 24 h; weekly > 8% => halt 7 d; peak-to-trough > 15% or rolling-20-trade mean net < -0.5% or hit rate < 35% => disable until manual review.
X6 Sell-into-spike (Arm D, applies to held inventory): if spot >= F*exp(0.06) (spot more than 6% above the fast EMA) AND net P&L > 0, exit; and for the SubnetEdge anecdote, if net inflow >= 8% of T within 7,200 blocks with price up >= 15%, trim to zero and bar re-entry for 4 days. Both are tested as hypotheses in the shadow log before they are trusted.
X7 Retry policy: a failed exit (PriceLimitExceeded, SlippageTooHigh) re-quotes next block, widening the limit tolerance 3% -> 6% -> 10% over three attempts; a shield miss at N+2 is final for that order, so resubmit with a rotated delegate (2-3 funded Staking-proxy delegates) to avoid the nonce lockout.
event_triggers:
Everything runs off new heads (chain_subscribeNewHeads, best head; finalized head used for accounting). Per head: one state_queryStorageAt over universe keys plus globals, and System.Events decoded for that block hash.
1. New head: update buffers, flow_phi/identity check, ladder, breadth; detect shocks; step setups; manage positions; log shadow shocks.
2. Shock candidate (D_w <= -8%, concentrated): create a SETUP only; no order. Entry is decided W_stab blocks later after stabilization, so an order is never placed on the shock block itself.
3. StakeRemoved by an OwnerSet coldkey (>= 0.25% of X single, or >= 1.0% of X over 7 d): ban n for 14 days, exit any open position in n (X0), log the dump for the Arm O rebound study.
4. StakeRemoved with the claim signature (fee 0, >= 2 netuids in one extrinsic, netuid-0 StakeAdded): set claim_recent[n] for 3,600 blocks (entry avoid) and feed the FORCED calibration cell. Multi-subnet burst (>= 5 subnets) => treat as a basket claim wave and log E/x changes.
5. SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(n, false): exit n immediately, quarantine n for 14 days. SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(n, true): quarantine n for 14 days (do not chase re-enables; the 2026-09-09 batch of 47 is a regime event). >= 3 disables in one block => global entry halt for 7 days and re-run the ladder; positions in non-disabled subnets follow normal exits.
6. NetworkRegistrationQueued / NetworkRemoved / NetworkAdded: last_reg = this block, g0 = 0, prune_free = NetworkRateLimit (14,400). Recompute the ladder and hazard. If a held n was removed, book the dissolution loss; prune_hits += 1; two prune hits in 60 days => raise cushion_min by 0.10 and rank_min by 2. During a fresh prune-free window the waiver may admit lower-ranked subnets for a hold that ends before last_reg + 14,400 - 600.
7. Epoch drain (block == LastEpochBlock + Tempo): refresh YieldRouter membership (AlphaDividendsPerSubnet keys, Delegates take, ChildkeyTake), MinerBurned, E/x. Entry timing prefers stake included at or before B-1 of a drain (earns that epoch's full dividends); this is secondary to the stabilization rule.
8. block % 360 == 0: recompute EmissionGateBar, gate ranks, keep_k.
9. specVersion change (state_getRuntimeVersion every 25 blocks): halt NEW entries, keep managing exits, require manual re-validation (smoke tests: reads, quotes, plan()).
10. SafeMode.EnteredUntil != 0 or a block-time stall > 30 s or finality lag > 20: freeze entries; exits are attempted only when the chain accepts staking calls (SafeMode whitelist contains no staking calls).
11. Immunity expiry schedule: at (NetworkRegisteredAt + 864,000 - 7,200 - H_plan) a subnet moves into the prune candidate set L; re-run U6 on all positions in it.
12. Basket events (BasketTradingEnabled flips, deposits/redemptions): refresh E for affected subnets.
13. Every 25 blocks: cross-check get_subnet_to_prune() with the local ladder; a mismatch halts entries until explained.
sizing:
All sizing is pool-relative; capital is configurable (SLEEVE_NAV in TAO) and never an input to signal logic.
Per-order size v (TAO) = min( alpha* * T, alpha_max * T, f_pos * SLEEVE_NAV, ABS_CAP_TAO ), with alpha_max = 0.5% of the pool TAO reserve and alpha* from the quadratic optimum alpha* = (g - c0)/4. Derivation: profit(alpha) = T*alpha*(g - c0 - 2*alpha), maximised at alpha* with profit T*(g - c0)^2/8, so profit scales with the square of the expected gross edge and linearly with pool depth.
Skip if v < v_min = 1.0 TAO (fixed fees TX_BUY + TX_SELL = 0.00186 TAO must stay under about 0.19% of notional) or if v < 0.002 TAO plus fee (AmountTooLow).
Slippage budget: entry slippage about alpha (0.5% of T gives 0.5%); exit slippage budget s_exit = 3%, so the position value must satisfy V <= T_now*s/(1 - s) = 3.09% of the CURRENT pool; at 0.5% of T there is 6x headroom. If T has shrunk so that V > 3.09% T_now, exit in tranches via allow_partial = true over successive blocks.
Limit price: buy limit = spot*(1 + max(0.015, 2*alpha + 0.005)); sell limit = spot*(1 - 0.03). The limit bounds the marginal price after the fill, not the average. Post-buy marginal price is spot*(1 + alpha)^2, so 0.5% of T consumes about 1% of the 1.5% limit. A crossed limit fails with PriceLimitExceeded and still pays the fee.
Concurrency: at most 3 positions, one per subnet, f_pos <= 35% of SLEEVE_NAV per position. Positions are correlated through root-level events (purges, spec changes), so treat the three as one risk bucket for the loss limits.
Fee handling: keep a TAO fee buffer on the Staking-proxy delegate of at least 0.05 TAO (alpha-fee trap). Never use 'all' for buys. Exits are full-position.
Useful size: because profit per event is about 1e-4 of T, only about 10-50 TAO of working capital can be used. Extra capital adds nothing and should go to other sleeves.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.rationale: Staged promotion; LIVE_GATED only writes orders to the user-run, gated adapter (Staking proxy, off by default). Nothing in this process executes live trades.

parameters.name: D_min
parameters.rationale: TUNED. Must exceed break-even cost (about 1.2%) divided by plausible (rho - eps); 8% gives rho* about 0.25.

parameters.name: D_max
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Larger single-event drops look like rugs, owner exits or news (Quasar -75%), i.e. informational.

parameters.name: shock_windows
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Covers one order, a split order and a short burst; 25 blocks = 5 min.

parameters.name: conc_min
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Single-burst concentration separates a discrete order from gradual distribution (informational).

parameters.name: resid_max
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Rejects reservoir releases, migration jumps (2026-06-25 Balancer migration) and weight artefacts.

parameters.name: pre_24h_floor / pre_7d_floor
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Excludes dips that are already part of a slide (falling-knife guard).

parameters.name: cascade_max
parameters.default: 1 prior single-block drop >= 4% in the last 300 blocks
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Repeated drops mean distribution or a cascade, not a one-off.

parameters.name: W_stab
parameters.rationale: TUNED. Wait for selling to stop; shorter than N+2 plus a minute is pointless because of 24 s shielded latency.

parameters.name: stab_flow / bid_confirm_phi / setup_expiry
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Requires selling has stopped and at least one buy has appeared; expire stale setups.

parameters.name: R_max_recovered
parameters.rationale: Frozen. If more than a third of the shock has already come back, the remaining edge is below cost.

parameters.name: trend_min (ln F/S pre-shock)
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Avoid falling-EMA regimes where the emission bid is decaying.

parameters.name: breadth_max
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Market-wide moves are not single-holder liquidity events.

parameters.name: T_band
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Micro-cap definition < 3,000; lower bound removes pools where a 5-TAO order moves price over 3%.

parameters.name: age_min
parameters.default: 90 d since NetworkRegisteredAt; 60 d since start_call
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Launch cohort decays median -57% by day 60 and -68% by day 90; leave to the launch family.

parameters.name: miner_burned_max
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Proxy for 'no active miner distribution', the stated root switch-off criterion.

parameters.name: escrow_ratio_cap (E/x)
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Persistent claim drag and dissolution haircut; excludes SN58/76/70/90/103 on the brief's snapshot.

parameters.name: dilution_cap
parameters.rationale: Frozen. Dilution load above this overwhelms any reversion over 12 h.

parameters.name: cushion_min (P/E1 - 1)

expected_edge:
STATUS: UNKNOWN. No block-level reversion measurement exists in the corpus, so everything below is a conditional model, not a forecast. My subjective prior that FSDR passes falsification tests F1-F8 is about 15-25%.
MODEL (log-return units). Position fraction alpha = v/T. Shock log-size D, recovery fraction rho measured at a fixed horizon from P_low, fraction eps already recovered at entry (assume 0.10).
Gross edge g = (rho - eps)*D.
Costs: entry slippage about alpha/(1+alpha), exit slippage about alpha/(1+alpha) (selling V at spot realises V*T/(T+V)); swap fee 2*0.0504% = 0.101%; fixed fees 0.00186 TAO / v (buy 0.00103 + sell 0.00083, proxy + shield path); holding cost over 12 h of (drift_prior 0.6%/day - yield 0.3-0.6%/day)*0.5 = 0 to 0.15%/day*0.5, assume 0.075%.
Example T = 1,500, alpha = 0.5% (v = 7.5 TAO): c = 0.995% + 0.101% + 0.025% + 0.075% = about 1.20%.
Break-even rho* = eps + c/D: D = 5% -> 0.34; D = 8% -> 0.25; D = 15% -> 0.18. Target for the edge gate: rho_lcb >= rho* + 0.05.
Net per trade (alpha = 0.5%, T = 1,500): D = 8%: rho = 0.10 -> -1.2%; 0.25 -> 0.0%; 0.40 -> +1.2%. D = 15%: rho = 0.25 -> +1.05%; 0.40 -> +3.3%. Per event in TAO: +1.2% = 0.09 TAO; +3.3% = 0.25 TAO. A losing stop is about -3% to -12% of v (0.2-0.9 TAO) plus 2-3% exit slippage.
Optimal size and profit: alpha* = (g - c0)/4, pi* = T*(g - c0)^2/8, about 6e-5*T (0.09 TAO at T = 1,500) for D = 8%, rho = 0.40, and 2.2e-4*T for D = 15%, rho = 0.40.
Mechanical component: the protocol-bid refill is at most about 0.05-0.1 of D in 12 h and only in the 5-10 micro caps above the gate; the rest of rho must be behavioural (M3/M4).
Event frequency: UNKNOWN. Planning prior 4-10 qualifying events per month across the filtered universe (range 1-15); to be measured in the research phase.
Monthly P&L under those priors: rho 0.40, D 8-15%: about +0.4 to +2.5 TAO per month; rho 0.25: about 0; rho 0.10: about -0.5 to -1 TAO per month plus knife tail until the circuit breaker trips. Capacity: 3 positions * alpha*T about 7-16 TAO each, so useful sleeve size is about 10-50 TAO (about $2.7k-$13k at TAO = $268); above this additional capital earns nothing.
Honest summary: even if the thesis is right, this is a small-capacity probe and a risk/timing overlay rather than a return engine. Its main value is (1) a measured answer to whether reversion exists at all in thin pools and (2) execution-timing and avoid-buying-into-spikes logic for other sleeves.
ASSUMPTIONS: weights about 0.5; shielded fills land at N+2 with worst-of-two-state fills; 2% order miss; no other participant front-runs the dip; no dissolution during the hold (guarded by filters; a prune hit would book 0.35-0.65x spot recovery, a loss of 35-65% of v); yield and drift priors from the brief; gross numbers exclude tax and the cost of running the node.
failure_modes:
1. The premise is wrong: shocks are informational and continue (REV t about -3). Mitigation: calibrated edge gate, shadow log, circuit breakers; the strategy simply does not trade until rho_lcb exceeds break-even.
2. Falling knife into dissolution: dips concentrate in low-EMA subnets. Mitigation: prune_gate (cushion >= 30%, ladder rank >= 6, stress prune clock, registration hazard, prune-free waiver, never the get_subnet_to_prune() target). Residual: 6 of the last 10 pruning registrations were MEV-shielded, so there is no mempool warning; 23% of victims had been rank 1 for under 24 h; a fast slide (SN67 went from rank 49 to 1 in a day) can outrun any filter.
3. Root emission switch-off wave (54 subnets in one block) or spec change. Mitigation: MinerBurned, flips and wave logic; exits on the event; but the bid is gone before we can react.
4. Owner/insider dump or compromised wallet that is not recognised as an owner flow (new wallet, split across coldkeys). Mitigation: shock-size cap 30%, quiet-before checks, owner polling.
5. Claim-wave drift mislabelled as a transient shock. Mitigation: claim-signature label, avoid window, E/x cap.
6. Event misclassification: event decoding fails or the label heuristic is wrong. Mitigation: Tier-0 fallback (pool deltas only, group UNKNOWN), separate calibration, event decoder validated on 100 random blocks against Taostats stake-events.
7. Data artefacts create fake shocks: reservoir releases, Balancer migration jump (2026-06-25), weight drift, reused netuid splicing, per-block SubnetTaoInEmission semantics. Mitigation: identity residual check, generation keys, mask migration blocks, verify per-block semantics.
8. Execution: shield miss/nonce lockout, PriceLimitExceeded, SlippageTooHigh, failed inner call paying full fee, alpha-fee trap, proxy error hidden under ExtrinsicSuccess (check Proxy.ProxyExecuted). Mitigation: delegates rotation, TAO buffer, reconcile on post-state balances.
9. Exit illiquidity: T shrinks after entry (TAO withdrawn), stops slip 2-3%+. Mitigation: 0.5% sizing, tranche exits, risk exits with widened limits.
10. SafeMode or halt: no exits possible. Mitigation: small size only.
11. Overfitting: 4 tuned parameters but the sample is tiny and the regime is young. Mitigation: pre-registered thresholds, 2/3-1/3 split, plateau test, forward paper phase, minimum event counts.
12. Regime change (gate parameters, EmissionBarRank, SubnetMovingAlpha, fee rate, subnet cap 256, shorts enabled, superellipse pools): the reflexive loop and the 12 h window both depend on them. Mitigation: read all parameters live and halt on spec change.
13. Edge exists only in the first minute (unreachable at N+2). Mitigation: latency decay test F7; entry delay is built in.
14. Correlation of all positions to a single root-level or TAO shock. Mitigation: breadth halt, one risk bucket, sleeve loss limits.
15. Windows host: native bittensor SDK not installable; the whole signal pipeline uses the custom reader (events via scalecodec, pure Python, UNVERIFIED on this host); only the gated live adapter needs WSL/Linux.
falsification_tests:
All thresholds are pre-registered. Sample windows are keyed on regime boundaries (use block+1 after each setCode). Regimes: A price-EMA (4,920,351 to about 2025-11), B Taoflow (2025-11-04 to 8,466,530), C price-EMA without gate (8,466,531 to 8,713,792), D+E gate (8,713,793 onward; rank-32 mode from 8,765,683). Only Era C onward has exact Balancer math at block level; earlier eras use the v3 virtual-reserve fill model and are used only for mechanism-agnostic tests.
F1 Power and effect. Gate era (>= 8,713,793) event study on the eligible-by-risk-filter universe, run first with NO strategy logic: require N >= 80 shocks passing shock/quiet filters and N >= 40 passing everything; otherwise the verdict is 'insufficient power, stay SHADOW' (not a pass). With N sufficient, mean recovery rho_H at pre-registered horizons {1 h, 6 h, 12 h} (Bonferroni over 3), cluster bootstrap by subnet-day, 90% lower bound must be >= rho* + 0.05 (about 0.30 at D = 8%) at >= 2 of 3 horizons. Kill if not.
F2 Net P&L on the frozen parameters, held-out final third of the sample: exact CPMM fills (simulate_buy/simulate_sell with the live weights), entry at decision block + 2 using worst-of-two-states, 2% order miss, fixed fees, no look-ahead in the universe, ladder, flags or E/x. Pass: mean net per trade >= +0.6%, clustered t >= 2.0, median >= 0, profit factor >= 1.3, and at least 25 trades. Kill if mean net < 0.
F3 Cost stress: slippage x2, swap fee x1.5, fixed fee x2, W_stab + 10 blocks. Pass: mean net >= 0.
F4 Placebo control: for each event draw 20 matched control blocks in the same subnet (matched on 24 h volatility decile, pool-size bucket, and time since last registration) and apply the same entry/exit rules; permutation test (10,000 draws). Pass: event minus control mean net at 12 h >= +1.0% with p < 0.05.
F5 Regime consistency: sign of (rho_hat - rho*) positive in >= 3 of 4 regimes (n >= 15 each) AND not strongly negative (rho_hat <= -0.10 means continuation) in the gate era. If reversion appears only in Taoflow (B) it is marked 'regime-dead' and the strategy is killed.
F6 Mechanism test: regress rho_H on [2*beta_hr*H/|D|, label dummies, E/x, ln(F/S) pre-shock, bid bucket]. Expect the bid coefficient in [0.5, 1.5]. If it is below 0.2 the mechanical-refill part of the thesis fails; the strategy is allowed to continue only if F1/F2 pass on the behavioural intercept alone, and then at half size.
F7 Latency decay: net edge at entry delays {0, 2, 10, 25, 50, 150} blocks. Pass: net at 12 blocks >= 0 and >= 50% of the net at 2 blocks. Kill if the edge is mostly in the first 10 blocks.
F8 Falling-knife audit: P(trade return <= -10%) <= 8%, 5th percentile of trade return >= -15%, worst trade >= -25%. Zero entries (point-in-time) into subnets that were pruned or emission-disabled within 72 h after entry; if one or more appear, find the filter leak or fail. Ablation: removing the prune/emission/overhang filters must make results WORSE (if not, the filters are costing edge and need re-justification).
F9 Pump symmetry (informational for exit design): reversal after + shocks of the same size. If rho_pump >= rho_dump, enable Arm D with confidence; if pumps continue, drop X6.
F10 Overfitting controls: tune only {D_min, W_stab, R_star, H_max}; deflated Sharpe or White Reality Check over the 256 grid cells; plateau test (each neighbouring grid cell must keep >= 50% of the optimum net edge); report CSCV probability of backtest overfitting, require < 0.3. Strategy-level t >= 3.0 given the multiple-testing burden.
F11 Forward paper trading (MODE = PAPER): minimum 60 days AND 40 completed trades, priced at actual N+2 block states with the shield-miss model. Pass: mean net > 0 with 80% bootstrap lower bound > 0, realised rho within 0.15 of the backtest, and no circuit-breaker trip. Only then may LIVE_GATED orders be generated for the user (who runs them).
F12 Arm B (FORCED/claim): separate gate. rho_lcb_FORCED >= rho* + 0.05 with n >= 20; otherwise claim-labelled flows remain an avoid flag only.
F13 Arm C (EMA-gap dips, no shock): shadow-evaluated; expected to fail. Reject if net edge at 12 h and 24 h is <= 0 in the gate era (continuation).
F14 Arm O (owner dumps): never traded; if rebound after the dump ends (24 h-7 d) is consistently positive net of costs in >= 20 events, report as a research lead only.
F15 Data validation before any of the above: fill model vs state_call SwapRuntimeApi_sim_swap_* at 50 random shock blocks (error < 1e-4 relative); event decoder vs Taostats stake-events on 100 random blocks; identity residual |r_obs - 2 ln(1+phi)| < 0.01 on >= 98% of non-migration blocks.
Kill-order summary: stop at the first failure among F1, F2, F3, F4, F7, F8. F5, F6, F10 failures downgrade to SHADOW only.
