pseudocode:
# flow_shock_reversion.py  (pseudocode; amounts as floats in TAO/alpha; rao ints at the adapter)
# Runs on the custom JSON-RPC reader. Emits Order objects. PAPER executor = exact CPMM sim;
# LIVE_GATED only writes orders for the user-run adapter (Staking proxy + submit_shielded). Never executes live here.

CFG = load_params()                # defaults from the parameter table
BPH, BPD = 300, 7200
FEE_RATE = lambda n: feerate(n) / 65535          # about 0.000504
TX_BUY, TX_SELL = 0.00103, 0.00083               # TAO, proxy+shield path

def on_new_block(blk):
    snap = chain.snapshot(blk.hash)              # 1x state_queryStorageAt: universe keys + globals
    ev   = chain.events(blk.hash)                # decoded System.Events, or None (Tier-0, labels = UNKNOWN)
    G.ingest(snap, ev, blk)                      # spec, SafeMode, stall, gate bar, flags, registrations, flips, waves
    for n in G.all_subnets():
        BUF[n].push(row(snap, n, blk))           # T,X,wq,P=((1-wq)/wq)*T/X, S, F, tao_in, excess, phi, resid
    LAD = prune_ladder(G, snap, blk, H_plan=CFG.H_max)    # rank/cushion/t_star per candidate in L
    G.breadth = frac(n for n in G.near_universe if BUF[n].D(25) <= -0.03)
    refresh_slow_state_if_due(blk, snap)         # E/x (300 blk), owner poll (50 blk), yield router (epoch), theta (360 blk)
    handle_events(ev, blk, LAD)                  # owner / claim / emission / registration / removal triggers (section event_triggers)

    halt_entries = G.halt_all or G.spec_changed or G.safemode or G.stall or G.breadth >= CFG.breadth_max or G.wave_recent(7*BPD)
    for n in G.universe_candidates():            # cheap filters first
        s = detect_shock(n, blk, ev)             # shadow-logs every shock, traded or not
        if s and not halt_entries and eligible(n, blk, snap, LAD, CFG.H_max)[0] and s.label != 'OWNER':
            SETUPS.setdefault(n, s)
    for n, s in list(SETUPS.items()):
        step_setup(n, s, blk, snap, LAD, halt_entries)
    for pos in list(OPEN):
        manage_position(pos, blk, snap, LAD, ev)
    SHADOW.step(blk)                             # fills forward-path horizons for every logged shock; updates CAL cells

def detect_shock(n, blk, ev):
    b, best = BUF[n], None
    for w in (1, 5, 25):
        D = ln(b.P[0] / b.P[w])                  # P[j] = price j blocks ago (end of block)
        if not (-CFG.D_max <= D <= -CFG.D_min): continue
        rets = [abs(ln(b.P[j] / b.P[j+1])) for j in range(w)]
        conc = max(rets) / max(1e-12, sum(rets))
        phi_sum = sum(b.phi[j] for j in range(w))
        if conc < CFG.conc_min or abs(D - 2*ln(1 + phi_sum)) > CFG.resid_max: continue
        if best is None or D < best.D:
            best = Shock(n=n, reg_at=G.reg_at[n], t0=blk.num, w=w, D=D, P_pre=b.P[w], P_low=min(b.P[:w+1]),
                         conc=conc, phi_sum=phi_sum, t_imp=blk.num, n_buy=0, flow_since=0.0, new_lows=0)
    if not best: return None
    pre24 = ln(best.P_pre / b.P[best.w + BPD]);  pre7 = ln(best.P_pre / b.P[best.w + 7*BPD])
    prior_drops = sum(1 for j in range(best.w + 1, best.w + 300) if ln(b.P[j] / b.P[j+1]) <= -0.04)
    trend = ln(b.F[best.w + 1] / b.S[best.w + 1])               # pre-shock fast/slow EMA
    best.label = flow_label(n, ev_window(n, blk, best.w), G.owner_set[n])   # OWNER|FORCED|WHALE|DIFFUSE|UNKNOWN
    best.pass_shape = (pre24 >= CFG.pre_24h_floor and pre7 >= CFG.pre_7d_floor and
                       prior_drops <= CFG.cascade_max and trend >= CFG.trend_min)
    SHADOW.log(best)                                             # always log, even when filters reject
    return best if best.pass_shape else None

def eligible(n, blk, snap, LAD, H):
    if not (G.subtoken[n] and G.first_emission[n] and G.emission_on[n]): return False, 'emission', None
    if blk.num - G.last_flip[n] < 100_800: return False, 'flip_quarantine', None
    T = BUF[n].T[0]
    if not (400 <= T <= 3500): return False, 'band', None
    if blk.num - G.reg_at[n] < 648_000 or blk.num - (G.first_emission[n] - 1) < 432_000: return False, 'age', None
    if G.miner_burned[n] > CFG.miner_burned_max: return False, 'miner_burned', None
    if G.escrow_ratio[n] > CFG.escrow_ratio_cap or dilution_load(n) > CFG.dilution_cap: return False, 'overhang', None
    if blk.num < G.ban_until.get(n, 0) or blk.num - G.claim_recent.get(n, -10**9) < CFG.claim_avoid_blocks: return False, 'ban/claim', None
    if G.prune_target == n: return False, 'target', None
    ok, exit_by = prune_gate(n, LAD, blk, H)
    if not ok: return False, 'prune', None
    return True, 'ok', exit_by

def prune_gate(n, LAD, blk, H):
    k = LAD.get(n)                                               # None => immune for longer than H + 7200
    if k is None: return True, None
    if k.rank == 1: return False, None
    free = max(0, G.last_reg + G.rate_limit - blk.num)
    if free >= H + 600: return True, G.last_reg + G.rate_limit - 600        # waiver; position must exit by this block
    if k.cushion < CFG.cushion_min or k.rank < CFG.rank_min: return False, None
    if k.t_star_stress < H + 3600: return False, None                       # stress clock: spot -> 0.5*P
    if k.rank < CFG.rank_hi and p_reg(blk.num - G.last_reg, H) > CFG.p_reg_tol: return False, None
    return True, None

def p_reg(g0, H):                                                # empirical gap CDF, linear interpolation
    d = 1 - F(g0);  return 1.0 if d <= 0 else (F(g0 + H) - F(g0)) / d

def step_setup(n, s, blk, snap, LAD, halt):
    b = BUF[n]
    s.P_low = min(s.P_low, b.P[0]);  s.flow_since += b.phi[0]
    if b.phi[0] <= -0.0025: s.t_imp = blk.num
    if b.phi[0] >= CFG.bid_confirm_phi: s.n_buy += 1
    if b.P[0] < s.P_low * (1 - 0.01) and blk.num > s.t0: s.new_lows += 1
    if halt or blk.num - s.t0 > CFG.setup_expiry or s.new_lows >= 2 or G.ban_until.get(n, 0) > blk.num: return drop(n)
    if blk.num - s.t_imp < CFG.W_stab or s.flow_since < CFG.stab_flow or s.n_buy < 1: return      # keep waiting
    R = ln(b.P[0] / s.P_low) / ln(s.P_pre / s.P_low)
    if R > CFG.R_max_recovered: return drop(n)
    ok, why, exit_by = eligible(n, blk, snap, LAD, CFG.H_max)
    if not ok or len(OPEN) >= CFG.n_pos_max or n in OPEN_BY_NET: return drop(n) if not ok else None
    D_rem = ln(s.P_pre / b.P[0]);  T = b.T[0];  H = CFG.H_max
    cell = cell_of(group(s.label), size_bucket(D_rem), bid_bucket(n))
    c = CAL[cell];  rho = (c.n * c.mean + CFG.pseudo_n * CFG.rho0) / (c.n + CFG.pseudo_n)
    rho_lcb = rho - CFG.lcb_z * c.se_shrunk
    y = YIELD.net_per_day(n);  c0 = 2*FEE_RATE(n) + (CFG.drift_prior - y) * H / BPD
    g = (rho_lcb - c.eps) * D_rem
    alpha = min(max((g - c0) / 4, 0.0), CFG.alpha_max)
    v = min(alpha * T, CFG.f_pos * SLEEVE_NAV, ABS_CAP_TAO)
    if v < CFG.v_min: return drop(n)
    a = v / T
    cost = 2*a/(1+a) + 2*FEE_RATE(n) + (TX_BUY + TX_SELL)/v + (CFG.drift_prior - y)*H/BPD
    net = g - cost;  rho_star = c.eps + cost / D_rem
    if net < CFG.edge_margin or rho_lcb < rho_star + CFG.rho_margin: return drop(n)
    submit_entry(n, s, v, exit_by)

def submit_entry(n, s, v, exit_by):
    b = BUF[n];  spot = b.P[0]
    q = EXEC.quote_buy(n, v)                                     # sim_swap (live) / CPMM sim (paper); zeros => abort
    if q.alpha_out <= 0: return drop(n)
    limit = spot * (1 + max(CFG.buy_lim_tol, 2*v/b.T[0] + 0.005))
    EXEC.submit(Order(kind='AddStakeLimit', netuid=n, hotkey=YIELD.best_hotkey(n), amount_tao=v,
                      limit_price=limit, allow_partial=False, shield=True, proxy='Staking', era=8, tag=s.id))
    # on confirmation (post-state balance read, not StakeAdded): OPEN[n] = Position(P_low0=s.P_low, P_pre=s.P_pre, P_entry=exec_px,
    #   cost_tao=v, t_entry=block, exit_by=exit_by); drop(n)

def manage_position(pos, blk, snap, LAD, ev):
    n, b = pos.netuid, BUF[pos.netuid]
    why = risk_exit_reason(pos, blk, snap, LAD)                  # emission off, removed, target/rank1, cushion<0.15 w/o waiver,
    if why: return EXEC.exit(pos, urgency='risk', limit_tol=0.10, allow_partial=True, why=why)   # owner ban, E/x>0.30, miner_burned>0.6, exit_by
    P = b.P[0];  R = ln(P / pos.P_low0) / ln(pos.P_pre / pos.P_low0);  age = blk.num - pos.t_entry
    pnl = EXEC.quote_exit(pos).tao_out / pos.cost_tao - 1 - TX_SELL / pos.cost_tao
    if R >= CFG.R_star and pnl >= 0.003:                         return EXEC.exit(pos, 'target', 0.03)
    if age >= CFG.H_soft and R < CFG.R_soft:                     return EXEC.exit(pos, 'soft_time', 0.03)
    if age >= CFG.H_max:                                         return EXEC.exit(pos, 'hard_time', 0.03)
    if P <= max(pos.P_low0 * (1 - CFG.stop_below_low), pos.P_entry * (1 - CFG.stop_abs)):
                                                                 return EXEC.exit(pos, 'thesis_stop', 0.05)
    if ln(P / b.F[0]) >= CFG.pump_exit_gap and pnl > 0:          return EXEC.exit(pos, 'pump_exit', 0.03)

def handle_events(ev, blk, LAD):
    for e in ev or []:
        if e.name == 'StakeRemoved' and e.cold in G.owner_set[e.netuid]:
            if owner_trigger(e): G.ban_until[e.netuid] = blk.num + 100_800; close_if_open(e.netuid, 'owner')
        if claim_signature(e, ev): G.claim_recent[e.netuid] = blk.num
        if e.name == 'SubnetEmissionEnabledSet':
            G.last_flip[e.netuid] = blk.num
            if not e.enabled: close_if_open(e.netuid, 'emission_off'); G.record_flip_block(blk.num)
        if e.name in ('NetworkRegistrationQueued', 'NetworkAdded'): G.last_reg = blk.num
        if e.name == 'NetworkRemoved': book_dissolution_if_held(e.netuid, blk); G.prune_hits += 1
    if G.flips_in_block(blk.num) >= 3: G.halt_until = blk.num + 7*BPD
    if spec_changed(): G.halt_entries_until_manual_unlock = True

# SHADOW study (drives CAL and the falsification tests): for every logged shock, record forward mid-price at
# 10, 25, 60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600, 7200, 14400 blocks after t0 plus eligibility flags and the label; compute
# rho_H = ln(P[t0+H]/P_low) / ln(P_pre/P_low); update CAL[cell] = (n, mean, se, eps) at completion of each horizon.
# Circuit breakers (X5) and mode promotion (SHADOW -> PAPER -> LIVE_GATED) require the pass criteria F1-F11.

family: New-subnet launches (with a cross-cutting Launch Gatekeeper that feeds the risk/portfolio layer)
name: Launch Gatekeeper plus Launch Carry Window (LCW): default no-trade and avoid-first, with one time-boxed, flow- and dividend-confirmed exception
thesis:
0. CONCLUSION (read first)
Default position in seeded launches is ZERO. We do not buy at start_call as a standing strategy, do not hold launches past ~14 days, do not trade the emission-enable event on launches, and do not run a model that tries to pick right-tail winners. Three things are built:
(A) Launch Gatekeeper: generation-keyed launch registry and recorder, registration/prune clock, and a negative filter consumed by every other strategy. Always on, no capital at risk, and most of the family's value.
(B) Launch Carry Window (LCW): the single exception ('X'). A time-boxed (<=14 days) position that may open only when realised net flow, dividend carry, owner behaviour, miner quality and structural checks ALL pass. Paper-first, live adapter gated, pre-registered kill criteria. It is a candidate, not a belief: if tests FT1-FT4 fail it is deleted and the family reduces to (A).
(C) Two research/shadow modules (start_call snipe replay, ignition + right-tail scorecard) that never reach the live allow-list unless they pass their tests.
Honest size of the prize: a good LCW trade earns ~0.1-0.8 TAO at pool sizes of 800-1,500 TAO (see expected_edge). This family is mainly an avoided-loss and data asset. All numbers describe model, back-test and paper results, not investment advice. Tags: [P] primary chain/code (from the brief), [R] replication from archive state, [A] academic, [S] secondary, [D] derived here from brief formulas, [U] assumption/unverified.

1. HOW A LAUNCH IS BORN [P]
1a. Registration at the 128 cap: register_network dissolves the lowest-SubnetMovingPrice non-immune subnet in the SAME block (NetworkRemoved(V)) and emits NetworkRegistrationQueued{coldkey, hotkey, mechid, identity, lock_amount, median_subnet_alpha_price, registration_block}. 17-25 blocks later the multi-block dissolve cleanup finishes and NetworkAdded(netuid, mechid) fires with netuid = V (lowest free id). Observed Queued->Added lags on the last ten: 22,23,24,20,17,20,18,21,25,23 blocks (mean 21.3); the new netuid equalled the pruned netuid in 10/10. NetworkRegisteredAt is written at the Added block; the registration rate-limit anchor (LastRateLimitedBlock suffix 0x02) is the Queued block (9,210,610 + 14,400 = 9,225,010). So ~4 minutes BEFORE the subnet exists the bot already knows the lock, the seed price, the owner keys, the identity blob and the netuid.
1b. Seed state: SubnetTAO = lock (cost path lock(t) = max(1, 2L - L*t/57,600); reproduces the 1,003.01 TAO lock of the 2026-07-14 registration: 2*842.35 - 842.35*46,614/57,600 = 1,003.0); SubnetAlphaIn = lock / median_subnet_alpha_price; SubnetAlphaOut = 0; no owner alpha (since 2026-05-08); EMA = 0; SubnetEmissionEnabled = false (since 2026-06-23); pool starts at the network-median price.
1c. Nothing is tradable until the owner calls start_call (StartCallDelay = 0; observed delay 610 blocks to >76 days; SN86/59/82 never started). Selling never needs SubtokenEnabled. At start_call: FirstEmissionBlockNumber = B+1, SubtokenEnabled = true, spot = seed price exactly, alpha mint starts at 1/block, first epoch drain ~360 blocks later.
1d. Immunity = NetworkImmunityPeriod 864,000 blocks (~120 d) from NetworkRegisteredAt: zero prune risk inside the LCW window. Never-started subnets keep EMA = 0 and are first in line at expiry.
1e. EMA warm-up (closed form checked against the exact per-block recursion): EMA/spot = 3.7% (d1), 13.7% (d2), 27.7% (d3), 57.8% (d5), 80.3% (d7), 95.6% (d10), 99.7% (d14). The EMA warms up from start_call whether or not emission is enabled.
1f. Gate retention g/b = 1/(1+(theta/b)^3): 0.2theta 0.8%, 0.3theta 2.6%, 0.4theta 6.0%, 0.5theta 11.1%, 0.8theta 33.9%, theta 50%, 1.5theta 77%, 2theta 89%. theta = EmissionGateBar = 0.0082624 in share space, i.e. EMA price ~theta*Z with Z = sum_j EMA_j(1-MinerBurned_j) in [0.85, 1.185], so the 50%-retention price is ~0.007-0.0098 TAO/alpha. The median-price seed (~0.004-0.006, [U]: read it from the event) sits at ~0.4-0.8 of the bar.

2. WHY THE MEDIAN LAUNCH DECAYS [D, cross-checked against [R]]
Constant-product algebra: with pool TAO T, price p, net user TAO inflow F per day and alpha sold S per day, d ln p/dt = 2(F - p*S)/T (a buy of F gives 2 ln(1+F/T); a sale of S gives -2 ln(1+S/x)). A started launch mints 7,200 alpha/day: 18% owner (liquid unless OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled; only 13 subnets), 41% miners (the (1-MinerBurned) part is liquid), 41% validators of which rp (0.80-0.90 at birth, ~0.55 by day 85) is credited in place to root-validator baskets (escrow, released by claims at ~2%/day of stock) and (1-rp) goes to alpha stakers. For lock 1,000 and seed 0.005 the liquid sell potential is ~21 TAO/day (2.1% of T/day => about -4%/day price drift with no inflow). Simulation (sell 100% of liquid mint + basket release c=0.02/day, no net demand): -25% d7, -43% d14, -67% d30, -85% d60, -92% d90. Net buying needed to hold price flat: ~150 TAO by d7, 315 by d14, 720 by d30, 1,560 by d60, 2,470 by d90. Cohort C pool growth at d30 (~+630-860 TAO) matches the 720 TAO needed to stay flat through d30 (observed median -4.7%); demand then stops (pool 1,860 -> 1,529 by d90) and price falls -58% (d60), -68% (d90). A schedule of 24 TAO/day of net buying for 30 days then zero reproduces the shape (flat/up to d30; -55% to -72% at d60; -79% to -87% at d90 for 60-100% sell fractions). This is a plausibility check, not a fit. Economic reading: the seed TAO is a pot that mint-sellers (owner, miners) extract while the subnet lives and that is partly recycled at dissolution (new-generation holders recover ~0.35-0.41x spot); late buyers are the exit liquidity. It also feeds the prune queue: -68% by d90 and ~-85% by d120 puts a median launch (0.005 -> ~0.0008-0.0016) at or below the bottom-of-ladder EMA (0.00095-0.0014) exactly when immunity ends.

3. WHY start_call AND THE ENABLE EVENT ARE WEAK MECHANICAL CATALYSTS [D]
- At start the EMA is 0, so b/theta ~ 1e-2 and retention ~ 1e-6; 28% warm at d3. Nothing 'pops' because of emission.
- For a young, high-rp subnet emission is mostly price-NEUTRAL injection: tao_in = min(E, rp*alpha_emission*spot per block); only the excess (SubnetExcessTao chain buys) is a price-moving bid. Cap per day = rp*7,200*spot (0.87*7,200*0.005 = 31 TAO/day). Matured emission at 0.5theta is ~2 TAO/day, at theta ~19 TAO/day (assuming sum of gated shares ~0.8, [U]), so chain buys start only near b ~ 1.8theta. Enabling a median-priced launch adds depth, not a bid.
- Formula check on the right-tail case SN90 (price 0.0212, EMA ~ spot, b ~ 2.8theta, retention 0.955): predicted ~85-100 TAO/day vs 96 observed, of which ~84 injection and ~12 chain buy at rp ~0.55.
- Enabling is root discretion with unknown timing: SN36 has been disabled ~48 days and SN35, SN108, SN82, SN116 (the four newest launches) are still disabled. The mechanical content of their enabling is a few TAO/day.
=> No enable-event trade on launches. The event is logged for an event study (re-enabled OLD subnets, low rp, chain-buy dominated, are the useful sample; hand that to the flow/emission family).

4. THE ONE MECHANISM THAT CAN PAY: EARLY-LIFE DIVIDEND CARRY PLUS FLOW PERSISTENCE INSIDE IMMUNITY [D, unverified for launches]
Nominator yield per alpha-day = 2952*(1-rp)/A_earn (the closed form that matched SN70, SN92, SN64 to three digits [P]). At birth rp = 981k/(981k + x0) with x0 = lock/p0 = 110k-330k alpha, i.e. rp 0.75-0.90, and A_earn (alpha staked in dividend-earning hotkeys) is tiny. For x0 = 150k (rp 0.867): gross %/day = 3.9 @A=10k, 2.0 @20k, 1.0 @40k, 0.49 @80k, 0.26 @150k. Dividends continue when emission is disabled and need no stake-age. The cohort-C median price change is 0% at d7 and d14 (60% positive) and there is no prune inside immunity, so days ~0.1-14 are where price drag is weakest and carry strongest. After ~d14-30 demand fades, A_earn grows (yield compresses), and basket release E(t) ramps toward inflow/c (~128k alpha at c = 0.02).
LCW therefore only opens when realised net flow shows demand at least covering dilution (price-drift identity above), takes the carry, and leaves by day 14. Tension to respect: strong inflows raise A_earn and cut yield; weak inflows let price fall. The sweet spot is moderate, persistent inflow, which is why the expected-return formula forecasts A_earn(t) from flow.

5. RIGHT TAIL
Confirmed ignitions: SN90 (re-registered 2026-07-14/15, now rank 14, 96 TAO/day, pool ~4,055, price 0.0212, OwnerCutAutoLock on) and SN107 (re-registered 2026-02-02/03, rank 5, 180 TAO/day). SN114 is reported top-10 in one source but not verified. That is 2 of ~51 cohort B+C launches = 4% (exact 95% CI 0.5%-13.5%). Break-even for 'buy every launch and hold to d90': if losers return 0.3-0.4x the winner multiple must be >=12-18x at a 4-5% hit rate (6-7x at 10%), far above anything observed. No early-signal classifier is statistically testable with 2-3 winners: even a perfect binary feature that selects 10 of 51 launches captures 3/3 winners by chance with p = 0.0058 and 2/2 with p = 0.035. So the design uses mechanical NECESSARY conditions (not a fitted winner-picker), keeps a pre-registered 7-feature scorecard in research mode, and grows the sample by forward recording (~1 launch per week; the next is expected 2026-10-10 to 10-13 replacing SN92, which should be the first fully instrumented forward observation).

6. EVIDENCE-BASE CAVEATS THAT CHANGE THE READING
- The day-90 sample (n=11, 0 positive) is made of launches registered <= 2026-07-08, all born BEFORE the gate (and mostly before price-EMA emission); SN90 (day 85) is right-censored out. Only ~9-11 launches were born under the gate regime and none has reached day 90 (first: SN103 on ~2026-11-02).
- Cohort members share calendar shocks (2026-06-22 purge, 07-27 gate, 08-03 rank-32 switch), so effective n is below the counts. About 9 of cohort C were Era-B (pre-Balancer, emission enabled by default, Taoflow rules), ~13 Era-C. Test strata: P1 (Era B, 04-25..06-23), P2 (Era C pre-gate, 06-24..07-26), P3 (gate-born >= 07-27).
- All launch evidence is PRICE-ONLY. Total return = (P1/P0)*(I1/I0) - costs; early-life yield could shift the median materially (FT1/FT2).

7. NEGATIVE-FILTER USE (the main deliverable)
Young generations (age since NetworkRegisteredAt < immunity), never-started subnets, EMA-warming subnets (age since start_call < 10 d) and 'diluted' subnets (structural support ratio < 0.10 and net flow <= 0) are excluded or down-weighted in every other family, signals are never computed across a generation boundary, and the registration clock tells the risk layer when prune hazard is zero (first 14,400 blocks after a registration) and when it is rising. See universe_filter and signal launch_risk_flags.

8. FORWARD-LOOKING NOTE
If ShortsEnabled ever goes live (PR #2764), the same Gatekeeper score becomes a candidate short signal for the d20-d90 decay phase; the test harness is built so FT1 can be re-run on the short side.
evidence_for:
- [R] Cohort C (full-lock seeding since ~2026-04-25, n~21): median price change 0% at d7 and d14 with 60% positive and only -4.7% at d30 (50% positive); the collapse is d30->d60 (-57.7%) and d90 (-68.3%). The early window is therefore not systematically negative on price alone, and it is where carry is strongest.
- [P] Immunity of 864,000 blocks from NetworkRegisteredAt: no prune can hit a launch for ~120 days, and dissolution recovery (0.35-0.41x spot) is irrelevant inside the LCW window.
- [P] Nominator-yield closed form 2952*(1-rp)/A_earn matched SN70 0.557, SN92 0.448, SN64 0.092 %/day to three digits; young subnets have the highest rp (so a smaller nominator pie, 0.75-0.9) but the smallest A_earn, so per-alpha yield is predicted to be ~1-4 %/day early [D]. Dividends do not require emission to be enabled and have no stake-age gate (stake at block <= B-1 earns the drain at B) [P].
- [P] Price-drift identity d ln p = 2(F - pS)/T is exact for constant-product pools at w = 0.5 and was the basis of the verified slippage formulas; net flow is observable via ΔSubnetTaoFlow (valid within one generation).
- [R] Momentum/continuation exists at short horizons in the micro-cap universe: WML7 +0.43-0.45 %/day (t 2.4-2.8) and REV -0.53 to -0.57 %/day (continuation) in the gate era; [S, not re-run] 1d->1d IC +0.026 (t 3.8). This is the only support for flow persistence (LCW's lambda parameter).
- [D] The structural decay model (sells of owner + miner + basket release against the seed pot) reproduces the sign and rough shape of the cohort-C path when fed ~24 TAO/day of early net buying, and its required-demand figure (720 TAO by d30) matches observed pool growth (+630-860 TAO).
- [P] Mechanics of the gate, EMA and injection split reproduce live per-subnet emission to ~2e-7 TAO and SN90 to within ~12%, so structural projections (E_proj, tao_in vs chain buys) are exact math, not fitted.
- [P] Right tail exists: SN90 (OwnerCutAutoLock on) and SN107 prove launches can ignite; 13 of 128 subnets have auto-lock and they include the two largest emitters (SN51, SN64) and SN90, a weak but cheap observable.
- [R/P] 10 of the June emission-off subnets were pruned 1-15 weeks later and 7 of the last ~10 prunes were emission-off or young cohort members: launch-state flags (disabled, unstarted, bottom EMA) are valid negative filters.
- [P] The Queued->Added lag (17-25 blocks, 10/10) and netuid reuse (10/10) are deterministic enough to build a registry that knows lock, p0 and owner before NetworkAdded.
evidence_against:
- [R] Seeded launches fall a median -68% by day 90 (0/11 positive); original computation -74%; cohort A -83% d90; cohort B -28% d90, -58% d180 [U for A/B]. Day-60 positivity 29%.
- [R] Median 14-day max run-up is only +6.2% (verifier) / +9% (original), measured at daily resolution from the first-move price. Round trip at 0.5% of pool is ~1.1%, at 1% of pool ~2.1%, so a snipe-and-flip has at most a few percent of gross edge to share with latency and competition.
- [R] Price-only small-minus-big reversed to about -0.5 %/day in the gate era; the bottom tercile lost -0.57 to -0.67 %/day; median bottom-tercile 365-day cumulative log return -0.563.
- [D] Structural headwind: 7,200 alpha/day of mint with no meaningful TAO bid for young high-rp subnets (emission is mostly neutral injection, chain buys appear only near 1.8x the bar). New subnets also start emission-disabled and root enabling is slow/unpredictable (4 of the last 5 launches and SN36 still disabled).
- [P] Prune/dissolution: new-generation holders recover only ~0.35-0.41x spot; one prune per ~7 days; the launch cohort feeds the prune queue at ~day 120.
- [U] Early-life dividend yield on launches is UNMEASURED. It requires a hotkey with a validator permit and positive realised dividends, take is 18% by default, Yuma bond-EMA lag delays new stake into a permit holder, and yield compresses exactly when flows are strong. The 1-4 %/day figures are closed-form extrapolations to small A_earn.
- [U] No quantitative study of first-block sniping exists; sniper products exist (FlowSniper is marketed) and our shielded order lands at N+2..N+4 (24-48 s) after the start_call block, so we are structurally late versus unshielded bots; unshielded orders can be sandwiched.
- [S] FalconX (May 2026): over a third of subnets had volume driven mainly by their top-20 holders and only 9 had >1,000 traders; flows can be concentrated or reflexive, so flow persistence may be weaker than the whole-universe IC suggests.
- Sample: cohort C n~21 (day-90 n=11), non-independent (common calendar shocks), mixed regimes, right-censored (SN90 excluded), ~10 gate-born launches; right tail 2 confirmed events. No classifier or small-sample backtest can reach conventional significance; every positive result will be fragile.
- Capacity: pools are ~800-1,900 TAO in the first month; the cost-optimal position is ~0.7-2% of pool (7-20 TAO), expected profit per trade <1 TAO. At ~8 qualifying launches per year the family cannot move a portfolio.
- [S] Owner/insider events: ORO SN15 wallet drain (~147k alpha over ~10 h), Covenant exit (tokens -40-50% within hours), Quasar -75% in hours show tail risk that LCW's stops can only partly cap.
- Regime risk: ~6 emission regimes in 11 months; spec 475 just changed dividend/consensus logic (Null consensus, 'precise emissions') and spec 476 is pending, so every formula must be re-verified before use.
universe_filter:
KEY: every asset is a GENERATION g = (netuid, NetworkRegisteredAt). Never join features across a generation boundary (lookbacks are truncated at NetworkRegisteredAt; SubnetTaoFlow/EMA/RootProp reset on dissolve; Taostats pool history splices generations).

GATEKEEPER UNIVERSE (all netuids except root). States derived each block:
- QUEUED (Queued seen, Added not yet), WAIT_START (Added, FirstEmissionBlockNumber = None), WATCH (started, age_start <= 100,800 blocks = 14 d), MATURE (otherwise). age_start = head - (FirstEmissionBlockNumber - 1); age_reg = head - NetworkRegisteredAt; immune = age_reg < NetworkImmunityPeriod (read live; 864,000).
- Flags: UNSTARTED, YOUNG_IMMUNE (age_reg < immunity), EMA_WARMING (age_start < 72,000 blocks = 10 d), GATE_STARVED (bar_ratio < 0.4), DILUTED (svs_struct < 0.10 and phi_7d <= 0), OWNER_LIQUID (OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled false), BURNING (MinerBurned > 0.60), EMISSION_OFF (SubnetEmissionEnabled false), SEED_ANOMALY, NEAR_IMMUNITY_EXIT (age_reg > immunity - 30 d and EMA in bottom quartile of non-immune), REG_CLOCK_HOT (prune hazard raised).

LCW (Mode C) ELIGIBILITY, evaluated at epoch boundaries and on triggering events:
1. Generation in WATCH, 720 <= age_start <= 72,000 blocks (needs >=2 epoch drains, ends by d10), age_reg <= 100 d.
2. Pool TAO T in [600, 6,000] (below 600 exit slippage dominates; above 6,000 the launch has outgrown the family and belongs to the momentum/flow families).
3. spot/spot0 in [0.8, 1.6] (do not chase a pop; spot0 from the registry).
4. MinerBurned (mean of last 2 epochs) <= 0.35; >=8 miner UIDs (incentive > 0, no validator permit) from >=5 distinct coldkeys; top-1 coldkey share of miner incentive <= 0.5; >=2 distinct coldkeys with validator permits.
5. Owner: OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled true, OR (owner net alpha sold over 7 d <= 50% of owner accrual AND owner TAO out in last 24 h <= 0.5% of T). No SubnetOwnerChanged and no perpetual->decaying lock switch by the owner.
6. A dividend-earning hotkey exists: h in keys(AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(netuid, .)) with positive realised dI/I in >=2 consecutive epochs and ex-ante marginal net yield >= 0.6 %/day.
7. Realised net flow: phi_ewma >= +0.4%/day of T and phi_6h >= 0.
8. Expected return gate mu_hat >= 0.8 %/day and net-of-cost G >= 3% (signal expected_hold_return).
9. spec_version == validated spec; SafeMode.EnteredUntil == 0; no block-time or finality stall; no SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(false) after a true on this generation.
10. Concurrency <= 2 launch positions; launch sleeve <= 5% of NAV.
HARD EXCLUDES (never a position): UNSTARTED; SEED_ANOMALY; age_start < 720; BURNING; any generation whose owner coldkey sold >= 3x accrual in 24 h; pool < 600 TAO; ownership changed in the last 7 d.
Mode I (ignition, shadow/paper only): same as above except age_start <= 30 d, spot/spot0 > 1.6, T <= 12,000 and the ignition test in entry_rules.
L2 snipe (shadow only): any WAIT_START generation with SEED_ANOMALY absent and T0 >= 600.

signals.name: launch_registry_and_seed
signals.formula: gen_key=(netuid,A) where A=NetworkAdded block=NetworkRegisteredAt[netuid]. At NetworkRegistrationQueued (block Q): T0=lock_amount; p0=median_subnet_alpha_price; x0=floor(lock_amount/p0) (units per runtime metadata); netuid=id of the NetworkRemoved victim in block Q. Asserts at Added: 17<=A-Q<=25; SubnetTAO[netuid]@A==T0 (rel 1e-6); SubnetAlphaIn@A==x0 (rel 1e-4); q0=Swap.SwapBalancer[netuid].quote/1e18 (expect 0.5, else SEED_ANOMALY); spot0=((1-q0)/q0)*T0/x0. immunity_end=A+NetworkImmunityPeriod. start_blk=FirstEmissionBlockNumber[netuid]-1; start_lag=start_blk-A; reg_gap=Q-previous_Q; lock_ratio=T0/NetworkLastLockCost_prev (=2-reg_gap/57600 while above the 1 TAO floor, a deterministic urgency proxy). Also store owner coldkey/hotkey, identity JSON (name, github, url, discord) and the Queued-block identity of the registrant (serial registrant check).
signals.inputs: Events: SubtensorModule.NetworkRegistrationQueued, NetworkRemoved, NetworkAdded (decode via that block's runtime metadata). Storage: NetworkRegisteredAt, FirstEmissionBlockNumber (Option<u64>), SubtokenEnabled, SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, SubnetAlphaOut, Swap.SwapBalancer, NetworkImmunityPeriod, NetworkLastLockCost, SubnetOwner, SubnetOwnerHotkey (name to confirm in metadata). Archive System.Events at block Q for backfills.
signals.update_trigger: On Queued/Removed/Added events; per block while WAIT_START (poll FirstEmissionBlockNumber and SubtokenEnabled, 2 reads per waiting generation).

signals.name: registration_clock
signals.formula: t=head-anchor, anchor=LastRateLimitedBlock(NetworkLastRegistered, key suffix 0x02) (~Queued block). cost(t)=max(NetworkMinLockCost, 2L - L*t/I_eff), L=NetworkLastLockCost, I_eff=NetworkLockReductionInterval*block_emission/1e9=57,600. hazard: h(t)=0 for t<NetworkRateLimit(14,400); empirical CDF of blocks between registrations (n=32, Feb-Oct 2026), piecewise linear through (14.4k,0),(31k,0.09),(43k,0.19),(50k,0.31),(55k,0.50),(60k,0.72),(65k,0.84),(71k,0.94),(100k,1.0). p24(t)=(F(t+7200)-F(t))/(1-F(t)). watch_level=HIGH if p24>0.25 or t within [55k,71k]. Prune victim now: get_subnet_to_prune() and the 52/52 rule min(SubnetMovingPrice, then oldest NetworkRegisteredAt) among non-immune.
signals.inputs: Storage: LastRateLimitedBlock(0x02), NetworkLastLockCost, NetworkMinLockCost, NetworkLockReductionInterval, NetworkRateLimit, SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt; runtime APIs SubnetRegistrationRuntimeApi_get_network_registration_cost, SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune.
signals.update_trigger: Every block (cheap); hard reset on NetworkRegistrationQueued.

signals.name: ema_forecast_and_bar_ratio
signals.formula: b0=head-(FirstEmissionBlockNumber-1); E0=SubnetMovingPrice (I96F32/2^32); alpha=SubnetMovingAlpha (0.0003); H=EMAPriceHalvingBlocks[netuid] (201,600). Flat-spot forecast over dn blocks: EMA(b0+dn)=S-(S-E0)*exp(-alpha*(dn-H*ln((H+b0+dn)/(H+b0)))), S=min(spot,1.0). (Unit test vs exact recursion a_n=alpha*n/(n+H), EMA'=a_n*S+(1-a_n)*EMA; must agree to 1e-4.) Share space: w_j=EMA_j*(1-min(MinerBurned_j,1)) over eligible subnets (get_subnets_to_emit_to), Z=sum w_j, b_j=w_j/Z, theta=EmissionGateBar, h=EmissionGateExponent (3). bar_ratio_i=b_i/theta; retention_i=1/(1+(theta/b_i)^h). Forecast uses EMA_i(b0+dn) in place of E0 and re-normalises Z.
signals.inputs: SubnetMovingPrice, SubnetMovingAlpha, EMAPriceHalvingBlocks, FirstEmissionBlockNumber, MinerBurned (all eligible subnets), SubnetEmissionEnabled, NetworkRegistrationAllowed, SubtokenEnabled, EmissionGateBar, EmissionGateExponent, EmissionBarRank, current spot from SwapRuntimeApi_current_alpha_price_all.
signals.update_trigger: Every block for WATCH generations (state_queryStorageAt batch); full vector recompute at block%360==0 (theta refresh) and on any SubnetMovingAlpha/EmissionGate* change.

signals.name: projected_emission_split
signals.formula: For subnet i with share-space b_i: g_j=b_j/(1+(theta/b_j)^h); final_i=g_i/sum_all g_j; if enabled: E_day=0.5*7200*final_i/sum_enabled final_j (else 0; E_shadow_day computed as if enabled, with i added to the enabled sum). Per block E_blk=E_day/7200. alpha_em=floor(1e9*2^(-floor(log2(1/(1-I/21e15)))))/1e9 with I=alpha_issuance=SubnetAlphaIn+SubnetAlphaOut+protocol reservoir (=1.0 now). rp=RootProp[i] (or SubnetTAO[0]*TaoWeight/(SubnetTAO[0]*TaoWeight+I), TaoWeight=raw/u64::MAX=0.18). tao_in_blk=min(E_blk, rp*alpha_em*spot); chain_buy_blk=E_blk-tao_in_blk (this is SubnetExcessTao, the only price-moving bid). Daily: tao_in_day=7200*tao_in_blk, chain_buy_day=7200*chain_buy_blk. Reconcile weekly vs observed SubnetTaoInEmission/SubnetExcessTao (tolerance 1e-6 TAO/block).
signals.inputs: Same as ema_forecast_and_bar_ratio plus RootProp, SubnetTAO[0], TaoWeight, SubnetProtocolAlpha, SubnetAlphaOut, SubnetTaoInEmission, SubnetExcessTao, TotalIssuance-free alpha curve.
signals.update_trigger: Every epoch for WATCH generations and on SubnetEmissionEnabledSet; at block%360==0 for the gate vector.

signals.name: sell_overhang
signals.formula: mint_day=7200*alpha_em. owner_liq=(SubnetOwnerCut/65535)*(1-AL)*mint_day, AL=OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled[i] (and OwnerCutEnabled). miner_liq=0.5*(1-SubnetOwnerCut/65535)*(1-min(MinerBurned_i,1))*mint_day. basket_rel=c_claim*E_i where E_i=sum over validator baskets of escrow alpha in i (BetaBasketRuntimeApi.get_all_validator_baskets), c_claim=0.02/day; if no basket data use the ODE E(t)=(0.41*rp*mint_day/c_claim)*(1-exp(-c_claim*t_days)). S_alpha_day=f_o*owner_liq+f_m*miner_liq+basket_rel (f_o=f_m=0.8 defaults, calibratable from owner/miner coldkey StakeRemoved flows). S_tao_day=S_alpha_day*sellside_price where sellside_price=SwapRuntimeApi_sim_swap_alpha_for_tao(netuid,S_alpha_day*1e9)/S_alpha_day. Root-dividend overhang only exists if sum SubnetMovingPrice over eligible subnets >1 (live 1.185).
signals.inputs: SubnetOwnerCut, OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled, MinerBurned, RootProp, alpha issuance items, BetaBasketRuntimeApi_get_all_validator_baskets, StakeRemoved events by owner and miner coldkeys.
signals.update_trigger: Per epoch; owner/miner flow calibration daily.

signals.name: svs_struct (structural support ratio)
signals.formula: SVS=(chain_buy_day + kappa_d*tao_in_day)/S_tao_day, kappa_d=0.25 (depth credit: injection is price-neutral but cuts impact of sells). Classes: <0.10 DILUTED, 0.10-0.50 MARGINAL, >=0.50 SUPPORTED. For a disabled subnet also SVS_shadow using E_shadow_day. Worked values: median launch (p=0.005, enabled, matured, 0.5theta): ~0.03; SN90-like (p=0.0212, E=96, rp=0.55, autolock on): (12+0.25*84)/50 = 0.66.
signals.inputs: Outputs of projected_emission_split and sell_overhang.
signals.update_trigger: Per epoch and on enable/disable events.

signals.name: net_flow_phi
signals.formula: F_day=(SubnetTaoFlow[t]-SubnetTaoFlow[t-7200])/1e9 within one generation (invalid across dissolve; includes registration-collateral buys from spec 435). Intraday: F_blk from StakeAdded/StakeRemoved TAO amounts on the netuid (drop fee=0 same-extrinsic pairs; do not size from StakeAdded). phi_ewma=EWMA(F per 7200 blocks, half-life 7,200 blocks)/T (clip +-5%/day); phi_6h=F over last 1,800 blocks *4/T. Reconciliation: dSubnetTAO ~= F + tao_in_emission_blocks - author fees (flag if |residual|>2% of T/day). Demand estimate D_day=F_day+S_tao_day (gross organic buying). Buyer breadth: n_buyers_7d distinct coldkeys, top3_share of gross buys (Taostats stake-events or chain events).
signals.inputs: SubnetTaoFlow, SubnetTAO, SubnetTaoInEmission, StakeAdded/StakeRemoved events (cold, hot, tao, alpha, netuid, fee), optional Taostats /v1/subnets/stake-events?netuid&action&trades_only=true.
signals.update_trigger: Every block (event tape); recompute at epochs and on any single flow >=2% of T.

signals.name: dividend_yield
signals.formula: For hotkey h in keys(AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,.)): I_h=TotalHotkeyAlpha[h,n]/shares_h with shares_h from TotalHotkeySharesV2 (SafeFloat m*10^e). Realised: y_real(h,k)=ln(I_h(now)/I_h(now-k*360))/(k*360/7200) per day, k>=2 epochs. Ex-ante gross: y_g=0.5*0.82*7200*alpha_em*(1-rp)/A_earn (=2952*(1-rp)/A_earn), A_earn=sum_{h in keys} TotalHotkeyAlpha[h,n]. Net: y_n=y_g*(1-Delegates[h]/65535)*(1-ChildkeyTake[h,n]). Marginal with own stake a_me and forecast inflow: y_hat(tau)=2952*(1-rp_tau)*(1-take)*(1-ck)/(A_earn + kappa_e*max(phi_ewma,0)*T*tau/p + a_me), kappa_e=0.7; y_avg=mean_{tau=1..h_hold} y_hat(tau), rp_tau from alpha issuance growth. Choose h*=argmax y_n(marginal) among hotkeys with y_real>0 for >=2 epochs, parent link stable (ChildKeys cooldown 7,200), take not recently raised (increases limited to once per 216,000 blocks). Realised-vs-ex-ante ratio is tracked per trade (kill K5).
signals.inputs: AlphaDividendsPerSubnet, TotalHotkeyAlpha, TotalHotkeySharesV2, Delegates, ChildkeyTake, ParentKeys/ChildKeys, RootProp, alpha issuance items; ValidatorPermit/Incentive via SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_selective_metagraph (low-level storage names not in the verified corpus).
signals.update_trigger: Per epoch (LastEpochBlock[n] changes) and at entry/exit decisions.

signals.name: owner_pressure
signals.formula: AL=OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled[n]; ck=SubnetOwner[n]. sold_alpha_24h=sum alpha of StakeRemoved(cold=ck, netuid=n) in last 7,200 blocks; accr_24h=(SubnetOwnerCut/65535)*(1-AL)*mint_day; owner_sell_ratio_7d=sold_7d/max(accr_7d,eps); owner_tao_out_24h/T. Events StakeLocked/StakeUnlocked/decaying-lock switch and SubnetOwnerChanged{netuid,old,new} by ck. Flags OWNER_DUMP if sold_24h>=3*accr_24h or owner_tao_out_24h>=1% of T.
signals.inputs: OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled, SubnetOwner, StakeRemoved, StakeLocked, StakeUnlocked, SubnetOwnerChanged events; AlphaV2 position of the owner coldkey.
signals.update_trigger: Per block via event tape; summary per epoch.

signals.name: miner_quality
signals.formula: MB=MinerBurned[n] (U96F32/2^32, mean of last 2 epochs); n_miners=#{uid: incentive_uid>0 and not ValidatorPermit[uid]}; miner_ck=#distinct coldkeys of those uids; miner_top1=max coldkey share of total miner incentive; n_permit_ck=#distinct coldkeys among permit holders with stake weight >= StakeThreshold. Hotkey-splitting (self-mining) is detected via miner_top1 and coldkey diversity, since MinerBurned only counts incentive sent to the owner's own hotkeys.
signals.inputs: MinerBurned, SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_selective_metagraph (incentive, validator_permit, coldkeys, stake), optionally Incentive/ValidatorPermit/Keys storage.
signals.update_trigger: Per epoch.

signals.name: expected_hold_return (mu_hat) and optimal size
signals.formula: mu_hat(per day)=2*lambda*phi_ewma + y_avg - 2*p*dS_alpha/T - c_rt/h_hold, lambda=0.5 (flow persistence shrink), h_hold=10 d, dS_alpha=basket_rel growth between now and h_hold/2 (from the E(t) ODE) in alpha, c_rt=2*d/(1+d)+2*33/65535+0.00186/size_tao with d=size/T (round trip: slippage both legs, swap fees, fixed tx fees). Gross G=h_hold*(mu_hat + c_rt/h_hold). Cost-optimal size d*=T*(G-f)/4 with f=2*33/65535 (maximises G*d - f*d - 2*d^2/T), max expected profit T*(G-f)^2/8. Executable value of a held position V_exec=SwapRuntimeApi_sim_swap_alpha_for_tao(n, position_alpha) (total-return mark, includes dividend alpha).
signals.inputs: Outputs of net_flow_phi, dividend_yield, sell_overhang; SwapRuntimeApi sims; Pool state for closed-form fallback (simulate_buy/simulate_sell from the brief).
signals.update_trigger: At each entry/exit evaluation (epoch boundaries and flow-triggered).

signals.name: snipe_pop_curve (research, shadow)
signals.formula: For each historical or live generation with start block B and latency k in {1,2,3,4,6,10} blocks: ask_k(D)=sim buy of D TAO at the pool state at end of block B+k-1 (fills at N+k); r_k(m)=V_exec(pool_{B+k+m}, alpha_bought)/D - 1 for exit lags m in {10,50,300,1800,3600,7200} blocks. Summary: median, mean, 25th percentile, share >0, bootstrap CI over generations. Also first_block_flow = net TAO bought in blocks B..B+10 / T0, and pop = spot_{B+k}/spot0 - 1.
signals.inputs: state_queryStorage change-sets for SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, Swap.SwapBalancer over [B, B+7200] (returns only blocks where values changed); Era-B launches use Swap.AlphaSqrtPrice/CurrentLiquidity virtual reserves (T/A is biased in small pools); Era C uses balancer formulas.
signals.update_trigger: Offline for history; live recorder in dense mode (every block for 600 blocks, every 10 blocks to 7,200) after start_call is detected.

signals.name: ignition_and_right_tail_scorecard (research)
signals.formula: ignite(g)=1 if within 60 d of start_call: bar_ratio(forecast 14 d, spot flat) >= 0.9 AND T >= 2*T0 AND MinerBurned <= 0.35 (label for research; Mode I paper entry requires it live). Scorecard features at d3 and d7 (all pre-registered binaries): F1 urgent registration (reg_gap<=30,000 blocks, lock_ratio>=1.5); F2 start_lag<=2 days; F3 OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled; F4 MB<=0.2 and >=8 external miners at d7; F5 owner_sell_ratio_7d<=0.3; F6 cumulative net inflow/T0 >= 0.4 by d7 with >=15 distinct buyers and top3_share<=0.5; F7 (optional enrichment) identity github+url present and repo created >=30 d before registration with commits in last 14 d. Hit = ignite or rank<=32 at d90. Test: Fisher exact per feature, Bonferroni alpha=0.05/7=0.0071.
signals.inputs: All above plus SubnetIdentitiesV3 (via DynamicInfo.subnet_identity), GitHub REST (60 req/h unauthenticated) or Taostats /api/dev_activity/*.
signals.update_trigger: Per epoch at ages 3 d and 7 d, and at day 60 labelling.

signals.name: enable_event_record (research)
signals.formula: On SubnetEmissionEnabledSet{netuid,enabled}: log spot, T, EMA, bar_ratio, E_shadow_day, tao_in_day, chain_buy_day, rp at blocks e-1..e+7200 (dense +30 blocks). Event study of abnormal return CAR[+3 blocks,+1 d,+3 d] vs predicted dE/T, with n_eff counted in distinct event dates (not subnets). Sample sources: new-launch enables (few) and bulk re-enables of old subnets (47 in block 9,029,889 on 2026-09-09; 2026-09-02 wave) where chain buys dominate.
signals.inputs: SubnetEmissionEnabledSet event, storage reads around e, SubnetEmissionEnabled.
signals.update_trigger: On event; offline backfill from archive.

signals.name: launch_risk_flags (Gatekeeper output API)
signals.formula: flags(netuid) -> set of {UNSTARTED, YOUNG_IMMUNE, EMA_WARMING, GATE_STARVED, DILUTED, OWNER_LIQUID, BURNING, EMISSION_OFF, SEED_ANOMALY, NEAR_IMMUNITY_EXIT, REG_CLOCK_HOT}; exclude(netuid, strategy) default policy: flow/yield family excludes YOUNG_IMMUNE unless svs_struct>=0.25 and phi_7d>0, always excludes UNSTARTED, BURNING, DILUTED; momentum/rotation excludes EMA_WARMING and any generation with age_reg<60 d unless T>=1.5*T0; mean-reversion excludes all YOUNG_IMMUNE; every family truncates lookbacks at NetworkRegisteredAt and drops ranks/shares computed from EMA for EMA_WARMING names (use ema_forecast instead). Provides immunity_exit_calendar and registration hazard p24 to the prune-avoidance layer (hazard=0 for 14,400 blocks after a registration).
signals.inputs: All signals above.
signals.update_trigger: Every block (cached), recomputed at epochs and events.

entry_rules:
DEFAULT: no launch position. Orders are emitted as intents to the execution layer (simulated fills in backtest/paper; live only through the gated Staking-proxy adapter, user-run).

MODE C (LCW, the only mode eligible for live promotion). At each epoch boundary of a WATCH generation, and on a flow/owner/MinerBurned event, evaluate the 10 gates in universe_filter. If all pass:
1. Hotkey = h* from dividend_yield (max marginal net yield, positive realised dI/I for >=2 epochs, stable parent link, not recently raised take). Never default to the owner hotkey unless it is the argmax.
2. Size from sizing (min of cost-optimal, exit-slippage cap, pool cap, participation cap, NAV caps); skip if below min_order.
3. Two tranches: half now, half 360 blocks later if all gates still pass and spot/spot0 <= 1.6; abandon tranche 2 if phi_6h < 0.
4. Order: shielded AddStakeLimit (submit_shielded, Staking proxy) with limit = ceil(spot_rao*(1+2%)) (must be strictly above spot), allow_partial=False, size <= max_buy_to_limit(pool, limit); pre-trade SwapRuntimeApi_sim_swap_tao_for_alpha must be non-zero; re-quote immediately before submit; expect inclusion at N+2..N+4; reconcile via post-state balances, never StakeAdded.
5. Record entry snapshot (all signals) for the kill-switch statistics.
Do NOT enter if: any flag in HARD EXCLUDES; the last block is within 30 blocks of a spec change; head lag vs a second endpoint > 2 blocks; fee buffer on the delegate < 0.05 TAO.

MODE I (ignition upgrade; paper/shadow only until >=8 occurrences and FT4 pass). Conditions: generation started, age_start <= 30 d, spot/spot0 > 1.6 but <= 4.0 and 24 h change <= +150% (no blow-off chase), T in [1,500, 12,000], ignite test true (bar_ratio forecast at 14 d >= 0.9), phi_ewma >= 0.4%/day, MinerBurned <= 0.35, owner gate, hotkey yield >= 0.3 %/day, svs_struct >= 0.25. Size half of Mode C. Exits per exit_rules plus bar_ratio forecast < 0.7.

MODE L2 (start_call snipe; shadow only, deleted unless FT5 passes). On detecting start_call (head >= B): if SEED_ANOMALY absent and T0 >= 600 and spot <= spot0*(1+3%): buy 0.3% of T0 via shielded AddStakeLimit (limit spot0*1.03 marginal). Exit at the first of +6% executable value, -3%, 1,800 blocks. Runs in paper with fills at B+k for k in {2,3,4,6} to measure the edge-vs-latency curve.

NEVER (explicit non-trades): buy WAIT_START (impossible); buy a generation with age_start < 720 blocks outside L2 shadow; enable-event trades on launches; hold through age_reg 100 d; average down; stake to a hotkey without positive realised dividends; use UnstakeAll.
exit_rules:
Evaluated every block for HELD generations (cheap reads) and immediately on triggering events. Priority order:
X1 Regime/safety (immediate full exit if exits are possible): SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(false) after a true on this generation; spec_version != validated spec (exit only if position older than 1 day, else hold and alert); SafeMode.EnteredUntil != 0 (cannot exit, alert); block-time/finality stall (alert, no new entries).
X2 Owner/insider: owner_sell_alpha_24h >= 3x accrual or owner TAO out >= 1% of T in 24 h; owner perpetual->decaying lock switch; SubnetOwnerChanged; any single sell >= 3% of T by a non-protocol coldkey while phi_6h < 0.
X3 Miner/validator quality: MinerBurned > 0.60 for 2 epochs; n_miners < 4; position hotkey loses permit/AlphaDividendsPerSubnet membership (first try move_stake to the next-best hotkey on the same subnet: no swap fee, pays tx fee, only if its marginal net yield >= 0.6 %/day; otherwise exit).
X4 Price stops on executable value (sell-side sim of the whole position incl. accrued dividend alpha): initial stop at -8% vs cost basis; trailing stop 12% from the running maximum of V_exec.
X5 Flow break: phi_6h <= -1.0%/day of T, or phi_ewma < 0 for 2 consecutive epochs after day 5.
X6 Carry failure: realised 2-epoch yield of the held hotkey < 0.25 %/day while mu_hat < 0.
X7 Time: hold >= 14 days (100,800 blocks) from entry; absolute backstop age_reg >= 100 days (720,000 blocks) so no position ever meets immunity expiry.
X8 Cost-aware rebalance: if the position has drifted to > 2x max_frac_pool*T because of price gains, trim to cap only if exit slippage on the excess < 1%.
EXECUTION: full exits via shielded RemoveStakeLimit(hotkey, netuid, all alpha, limit = floor(spot_rao*(1 - exit_slip_budget)), allow_partial=False); if it fails (PriceLimitExceeded/SlippageTooHigh) retry once with allow_partial=True and a second limit at 2x the budget, then tranche over N+2 blocks. Always exit completely (a remainder under 0.02 TAO-equivalent is force-sold at no price limit). Keep a TAO fee buffer on the delegate (alpha-fee trap). Rotate between 2-3 funded delegates if a shielded carrier is missed (nonce lock-out until the era expires).
POST-EXIT: 24 h cool-off on that generation; log realised total return = (V_exec_exit + realised costs)/cost basis - 1, split into price, dividend and cost components.
event_triggers:
REAL-TIME EVENTS AND ACTIONS
1. NetworkRemoved(V) + NetworkRegistrationQueued{...} (same block Q): (a) positions in V are dissolved (remove_stake fails with SubnetNotExists afterwards): mark LOSS, schedule payout reconciliation (free TAO credited to the coldkey over the next ~20 blocks, basket sales first); (b) create QUEUED generation (netuid = V) with lock, p0, owner, identity; compute T0, x0, spot0; (c) reset the registration clock: anchor=Q, L=lock_amount, prune hazard = 0 for 14,400 blocks (tell the risk layer: bottom-3 non-immune holdings are safe for ~2 days); (d) fire identity/registrant checks (serial registrant, github/url present).
2. NetworkAdded(V, mechid) at A (Q+17..25): assert lag and seed state, set state WAIT_START, compute immunity_end = A + NetworkImmunityPeriod, begin per-block polling of FirstEmissionBlockNumber[V]/SubtokenEnabled[V]. Alert if lag > 60 (cleanup backlog).
3. start_call detected (FirstEmissionBlockNumber None->Some(B+1), SubtokenEnabled true; storage-diff detection because no dedicated event is documented [U]): record start_lag; switch recorder to dense mode (every block for 600 blocks, every 10 blocks to 7,200, then epoch cadence); arm L2 shadow with the detection latency (head - B); start the 720-block LCW watch timer.
4. LastEpochBlock[V] changes (epoch drains): read MinerBurned, miner/validator counts, AlphaDividendsPerSubnet keys, hotkey dI/I, owner flows; run lcw_decision and held-position exit checks.
5. SubnetEmissionEnabledSet{V, enabled}: true -> log enable record, recompute projected_emission_split and SVS, re-evaluate eligibility (no trade solely for the event); false after true -> X1 exit for held V and DILUTED flag for all.
6. StakeAdded/StakeRemoved on a WATCH/HELD generation with TAO >= 2% of T: recompute phi, buyer breadth, owner flows immediately; if HELD and sell >= 3% of T from non-protocol coldkey -> evaluate X2/X5 now rather than at the next epoch.
7. SubnetOwnerChanged, StakeLocked/StakeUnlocked/decaying-lock switch by the owner, owner AlphaBurned/AlphaRecycled: update owner_pressure; lock->decaying or owner change on a HELD generation -> X2.
8. spec_version change or SetCode: halt new entries, run FT0 smoke tests (reads, sims, plan()), resume only after the formulas in signals reproduce live values; block+1 alignment for backtest regime splits.
9. block % 360 == 0: refresh theta and the gate vector; recompute bar_ratio and SVS for all WATCH generations.
10. Registration-clock thresholds: p24 > 0.25 or t in [55k, 71k] -> raise watch level (dense recorder pre-armed, heartbeat to a second endpoint); a registration inside the 14,400-block window cannot happen, so alerts are suppressed there.
11. Large aggregate flows / basket claim bursts (E/x drops by >=2% in a block on a WATCH/HELD netuid): treat as sell overhang shock; re-evaluate S_alpha.
12. SafeMode.EnteredUntil != 0, block-time stall > 3x 12 s, finality stall: stop everything, alert; no exits are possible during SafeMode.
sizing:
Pool-relative, with explicit exit-slippage budget; capital is configurable (all caps are fractions of the launch sleeve and of pool TAO).
size = min(
 d_opt = T*(G - f)/4 (cost-optimal, from round trip ~ 2d/T + fees),
 d_exit = T*s/(1-s) with exit slippage budget s = 1.5% (=> 1.52% of T),
 d_pool = max_frac_pool*T with max_frac_pool = 1.0% (searched 0.25-2.0%),
 d_flow = participation_cap*D_day with participation_cap = 0.5 (never more than half of the estimated gross daily organic buying),
 d_nav = min(2.5% of strategy NAV, 5% sleeve cap minus sleeve in use)).
Reference costs of a full round trip: 0.25% of T -> ~0.6%; 0.5% -> ~1.1%; 1.0% -> ~2.1%; 1.5% -> ~3.1% (slippage both legs plus 2x0.0504% swap fee; fixed tx fees add 0.00186 TAO, 0.02% at 10 TAO). Cost-optimal size at T=1,000: ~7 TAO (G=3%), ~12 TAO (G=5%), ~20 TAO (G=8%); T=1,500: 11/18/30 TAO.
Maximum concurrent launch positions: 2. Two tranches 360 blocks apart. Minimum order 1 TAO (fees <0.1%); orders below 0.002 TAO-out are invalid anyway; always exit fully. Pre-trade: SwapRuntimeApi sim must return non-zero; limit price strictly above spot for buys (else PriceLimitExceeded); size <= max_buy_to_limit. Slippage reservation is symmetrical: the position is sized so that the full exit at the stop price still satisfies the 1.5% budget.
Launch sleeve is a separate sub-account/coldkey/delegate set with only strategy capital; a Staking proxy holding fee TAO; no transfer rights.
L2 shadow size: 0.3% of T0. Mode I: half of Mode C.

parameters.name: min_age_start_blocks
parameters.rationale: Need >=2 epoch drains to observe MinerBurned, dividends and owner flows before any entry; avoids the speed race entirely.

parameters.name: max_entry_age_start_blocks
parameters.rationale: EMA is ~96% warm at d10; window stays in the pre-decay phase (median flat to d14).

parameters.name: max_hold_blocks
parameters.rationale: Cohort C median is flat through d14 and falls from d30; exit before the structural decay.

parameters.name: hard_exit_reg_age_blocks
parameters.rationale: Backstop 20 days before immunity expiry (864,000).

parameters.name: pool_tao_min
parameters.rationale: Below this, exit slippage at any useful size exceeds the edge; seed pools are ~650-1,000.

parameters.name: pool_tao_max

expected_edge:
All figures are model/back-test expectations under stated assumptions, not advice. Where unknown, it says unknown.

1. GATEKEEPER (avoided loss; highest-confidence component). Gate-era bottom-tercile price-only drift is -0.57 to -0.67 %/day [R]; ~14 of ~43 tercile names are younger than 120 days (registered since ~2026-06-10) [D]; cohort-C price drift d0-d90 = ln(0.317)/90 = -1.28 %/day [R, pre-gate sample]. Solving -0.62 = 0.33*(-1.28) + 0.67*d_old gives d_old ~ -0.29 %/day, so excluding young names raises the equal-weight micro-cap sleeve's price-only drift by ~0.33*(1.28-0.29) = +0.33 %/day as an UPPER bound. After subtracting young-name early yield (possibly +0.5 to +1 %/day in the first weeks) and overlap with other families' own filters, the plausible band is +0.1 to +0.3 %/day of the micro-cap sleeve (sign high-confidence, size unknown). Cost: ~zero (read-only). Capacity: n/a.
2. LCW (Mode C). Per trade, gross hold return G over h=10 d = carry + 2*lambda*phi - headwind. Scenarios [U, to be replaced by FT1-FT4]: bear (yield 0.3 %/day, flows revert) G ~ -2%; base (yield 0.8 %/day avg, flows modestly positive, drift ~ -3% to 0) G ~ +4%; bull (yield 1.5 %/day, persistent inflow +1 %/day drift) G ~ +20%. Weights 40/40/20 -> E[G] ~ +4.8% gross; costs at the cost-optimal size ~1-2% are inside the d* formula. Cost-optimal profit T*(G-f)^2/8: T=1,000: G 3% -> 0.105 TAO (size 7.2), 5% -> 0.30 TAO (12.2), 8% -> 0.78 TAO (19.8); T=1,500: 0.16 / 0.45 / 1.17 TAO; T=3,000: 0.32 / 0.90 / 2.34 TAO. With ~53 registrations per year and an estimated 10-20% passing all gates (~5-10 trades/yr, [U]) the expected profit is ~1-4 TAO per year in the base case; the probability that the true mean is <= 0 is at least 40% before testing. Capacity: ~7-30 TAO per trade, <= 2 concurrent (~15-60 TAO of deployed capital). Verdict: the best case is not economically meaningful at scale; the value of building LCW is mostly the instrumentation (registry, recorder, yield and flow measurement), which the Gatekeeper needs anyway.
3. Mode I (ignition): unknown; 2 historical events; sized at half of Mode C; paper-only until >=8 occurrences. Expected contribution ~0.
4. L2 snipe: gross pop capture bounded by the +6-9% median 14-day max run-up (daily resolution) -> G ~ +3% if half captured; minus ~0.7% round trip at 0.3% of T0 -> ~+2%, then minus latency/competition loss (unmeasured). Central estimate 0 +- 3%; max profit at T0=1,000 and G=3% is 0.105 TAO per launch (~5 TAO/yr at most if 100% of launches qualified and the edge existed). Probably killed by FT5.
5. Enable-event trade on launches: mechanical expected bid ~0.2-2 TAO/day for median-priced launches vs ~13-21 TAO/day sell overhang: expected edge 0; not traded.
6. Right-tail picking: break-even requires winner multiple >=12-18x at a 4-5% base rate; not met; no capital allocated.
Costs used throughout: swap fee 0.0504% per leg, tx fee ~0.00103 TAO buy and ~0.00083 TAO sell via Staking proxy + shield, price impact 2d/T per round trip, N+2..N+4 latency, 5.3-5.4% daily cross-sectional volatility as noise scale.
Key assumptions: A1 seed price 0.004-0.006 TAO/alpha (read from event); A2 sum of gated shares ~0.8; A3 sells reach the AMM at 60-100% of liquid mint; A4 basket claim rate 0.02/day; A5 flow persistence lambda 0.5; A6 take 0-18% and permit availability.
failure_modes:
- Dividend assumption fails: no hotkey with permit/positive dI/I, take hiked (0->18% in one transaction, once per 216,000 blocks), parent link changed (7,200-block cooldown), Yuma bond-EMA lag, or Null consensus changes who earns (spec 475). Mitigation: realised-yield gate, hotkey rotation via move_stake, kill K5.
- Flow reversal / owner dump / coordinated holders (top-20 holders drive >1/3 of volume on many subnets): stops, X2 exits; residual loss up to the stop plus slippage (cap 8-12% plus 1.5% exit slippage).
- Root discretion: emission switch-off, root_dissolve_network (call 120) on abandoned launches, SafeMode (no staking calls whitelisted, no exits), emission-rule changes (~6 regimes in 11 months): freeze list and halt-on-spec-change.
- Exit liquidity: pools of 600-6,000 TAO; slippage budget binds before edge; partial fills / PriceLimitExceeded paid at full fee; shield miss and nonce lock-out; stale NextKey; delegates rotation.
- Look-ahead and survivorship in backtests: generation splice, right-censoring of late launches, regime pooling, using SubnetTaoFlow across dissolve, using T/A instead of AlphaSqrtPrice^2 for Era-B launches (biased exactly in micro caps), RootProp=0 before block 7,135,420, MinerBurned absent before 8,466,597.
- Data/decoding errors: NetworkRegistrationQueued field layout and median_subnet_alpha_price units are runtime-version dependent; start_call may not emit a dedicated event (storage-diff detection); event ordering within a block; two registrations never occur within 14,400 blocks but cleanup backlogs can stretch Queued->Added.
- Common-shock confounding: all current cohort evidence comes from <=3 regime shocks; the LCW rules may be fitted to noise. Mitigation: parameters frozen a priori, FT4 placebo, strata P1/P2/P3.
- Competition: if other agents run the same dividend/flow logic, early A_earn rises and yield compresses faster than modelled.
- Dissolution/prune of a held launch is not a risk inside immunity but becomes one if hold rules fail (hard exit at age_reg 100 d).
- Operational: alpha-fee trap if fee buffer is empty; leaked zero-delay Staking proxy can force high-slippage round trips; v10/v11 SDK mismatch (live adapter only under WSL/Linux); public RPC throttling (429, -32004, -32029) delaying epoch reads.
- Model risk of the sell-overhang ODE (basket claim rate, f_o, f_m): used only for headwind growth and the SVS class, never as the sole entry trigger.
- Spec 476 pending: re-verify gate, injection cap, dividend and dissolution code paths before any live use.
falsification_tests:
All tests are pre-registered; parameters frozen at defaults before running; report per stratum P1 (Era B, regs 2026-04-25..06-23, n~9), P2 (Era C pre-gate, 06-24..07-26, n~4), P3 (gate-born >= 07-27, n~9-11) and pooled; cohort B (n=30, near-empty pools) is used only for mechanism tests (FT2, FT3), not for return levels; standard errors clustered by launch and by calendar date; cost multipliers 1x, 1.5x, 2x.

FT0 DATA AND MECHANICS INTEGRITY (gate for everything). Pass: (a) Queued->Added lag in [17,25] for the 10 recent events and the new netuid equals the victim's; (b) seed reconstruction SubnetTAO==lock and SubnetAlphaIn==lock/p0 on all cohort-C launches within 1e-6/1e-4; (c) ema_forecast matches the exact per-block recursion within 1e-4 and matches stored SubnetMovingPrice within 1% at 20 random WATCH blocks; (d) the gate/injection pipeline reproduces live SubnetTaoInEmission+SubnetExcessTao within 1e-6 TAO/block on 20 random blocks and SN90 within 15% of 96 TAO/day; (e) generation-keyed panel has zero splices (assert no feature window crosses NetworkRegisteredAt); (f) Era-B fills use AlphaSqrtPrice^2 and virtual reserves, error vs sim_swap <=0.01% where sim exists. Fail any -> fix before proceeding.

FT1 TOTAL-RETURN RESTATEMENT OF LAUNCH PATHS. Recompute cohort B and C paths as P*I net of costs (I from the best available earning hotkey, take-adjusted) from start_call+720 blocks to d7/14/30/60/90. LCW lives only if: median total return at d14 >= +3% (after 1.5x costs at 0.5% of T), share positive >= 55%, and d30 median >= -5%. KILL LCW if the d14 median total return < +1% or the carry contributes < 40% of the d14 median.

FT2 DIVIDEND CARRY EXISTS. For every launch, realised best-hotkey net yield in days 1-14 (dI/I from archive: TotalHotkeyAlpha/TotalHotkeySharesV2 at epoch blocks). Pass: median >= 0.8 %/day, >= 60% of launches have an earning hotkey with >= 0.5 %/day, and realised/ex-ante closed form within a factor of 1.5. KILL the carry thesis (and LCW) if median < 0.5 %/day.

FT3 FLOW PERSISTENCE. In launch days 3-14, corr(phi over [t, t+2 d], phi over [t+3, t+9 d]) with launch-clustered block bootstrap. Pass: point estimate >= 0.2 and 90% CI lower bound > 0. Else set lambda=0; LCW then needs carry alone to clear mu_min, which FT2 will almost certainly not support -> KILL.

FT4 LCW RULE BACK-TEST AND PLACEBO. Run the frozen rules with fills from the era-correct pool model at N+3 latency. Pass ALL: median trade total return >= +1.0% at 1.5x costs; hit rate >= 55%; worst decile >= -15%; positive median in >= 2 of 3 strata; no single launch > 50% of cumulative P&L; leave-one-launch-out mean stays > 0; entry-timing placebo (same launches, random entry ages inside the window, 1,000 draws) beaten by >= 1.0 percentage point at p < 0.10; expected profit at cost-optimal size >= 0.05 TAO/trade (FT10). Number of qualifying trades < 8 over the whole history means NOT TESTABLE: LCW stays paper-only.

FT5 START_CALL SNIPE REPLAY. Block-level replay on cohort B+C (n >= 40) with latency k in {1,2,3,4,6,10}. Pass: median net return of the frozen rule >= +0.5%, 90% bootstrap CI lower bound of the mean > 0, win rate >= 55%, and edge at k=4 still >= 50% of the edge at k=1. KILL L2 otherwise (expected outcome).

FT6 STRUCTURAL SCORE VALIDITY. Panel of launch-days (age_start 3-60 d), regress forward 30-day total return on SVS and phi, clustered by launch; Spearman IC >= +0.15 and top-quartile minus bottom-quartile spread >= +10% per 30 d. If it fails, SVS is demoted to a descriptive flag (DILUTED/EMA_WARMING/BURNING stay because they are mechanical).

FT7 GATEKEEPER UTILITY IN OTHER STRATEGIES. A/B on the micro-cap sleeve of the momentum/flow/mean-reversion backtests, flags strictly ex-ante: pass if excluding flagged generations cuts max drawdown >= 20% relative OR lifts mean daily total return >= +0.05 %/day with date-clustered t >= 2, in >= 2 of 3 regimes. Keep each flag only if it contributes in a leave-one-flag-out test.

FT8 RIGHT-TAIL SCORECARD. Pre-registered 7 binary features, Fisher exact, Bonferroni alpha=0.0071, hit = ignite or rank<=32 at d90 on cohort B+C (n~51; 2 confirmed winners). A feature passes only if it captures all winners with <= 10 selected launches (p~0.0058) AND replicates in a held-out later cohort (next 20 launches, forward-recorded). With 2 winners the test is almost certainly under-powered: expected outcome is 'not testable', in which case no winner-picking is deployed. Mode I stays shadow until >= 8 ignition events exist.

FT9 ENABLE EVENT STUDY. CAR[+3 blocks, +1 d, +3 d] on SubnetEmissionEnabledSet events regressed on predicted dE_day/T; count n_eff in distinct event dates (expect ~3-5, not 47). Pass for ANY trade: slope > 0 with date-clustered t >= 2, CAR[+3 blocks..+1 d] >= 1.5% net of costs at our latency, and the effect not already realised before the event block. Launch-specific trade requires E_shadow_day >= 10% of S_tao_day; otherwise stays 'not traded'.

FT10 ECONOMICS AND CAPACITY GATE. Median expected profit at cost-optimal size over qualifying trades >= 0.05 TAO and >= 20x the per-trade fixed fee (0.00186 TAO); else do not automate beyond paper.

OPERATING KILL SWITCHES (paper and live). K1: after >= 6 completed LCW trades, median net trade return < 0 AND cumulative net < 0 -> disable Mode C. K2: any single trade loss > 25% of position -> pause 30 days and audit fills/stops. K3: any owner-dump exit with realised slippage > 5% -> disable until reviewed. K4: freeze-list parameter or spec change -> pause until FT0 and FT4 are re-run. K5: realised yield < 50% of ex-ante for 3 consecutive trades -> disable carry-based entries. K6: two consecutive shield misses or head-lag >2 blocks on entry -> disable entries for 24 h. PROMOTION: backtest pass (FT0-FT4, FT10) -> >= 8 paper trades with positive median -> user decides on the gated live allow-list (never automatic).
