family: Cross-cutting risk overlay and multi-strategy portfolio allocator (applies to families a-d; produces no alpha of its own)
name: OVERLAY-A1: prune-aware, pool-relative, kill-switched risk overlay with netting multi-sleeve allocator and N+2 limit-order planner
thesis:
For micro-cap dTAO alpha, the largest losses come from protocol mechanics, not market noise. Each loss channel is deterministic or bounded enough to engineer around. All references are to RESEARCH_BRIEF.md.

(1) PRUNE. The victim is a pure function of public state: argmin over non-immune subnets of (SubnetMovingPrice, NetworkRegisteredAt). It matched 52 of 52 historical prunes. A prune happens in the same block as the registration. 6 of the last 10 were MEV-shielded, so there is zero mempool warning. Holders recover only about 0.35-0.65x spot (SN92 computes to 0.37 after the basket sale). Two facts give an engineerable lead time:
 (a) The EMA kinematics. EMA' = a*min(spot,1) + (1-a)*EMA, with a = 0.0003*b/(b+201,600), about 0.000286 on mature subnets. EMA input is post-injection spot fixed before block-N extrinsics. A subnet k can therefore become the target no faster than t* >= ln((E_k - s)/(E_1 - s))/a_k. Worst case (s -> 0) is half-life*log2(E_k/E_1). Examples: about 10 blocks at a 0.3% gap, 86 blocks at 2.5%, 243 blocks at 7.2%, 794 blocks at 25.5%.
 (b) The registration rate limit is network-wide: 14,400 blocks. Registrants historically wait until the lock cost c = max(1, 2L - (L/57,600)*delta) is back near L (median c/L about 1.04). So prune hazard is exactly 0 for 14,400 blocks after each registration, about 6% at window opening (2 of 32 registrations), and peaks at roughly 50% per 24 h around delta 55-65k blocks.
 Every exit is a single shielded order that lands at N+2 (about 9 blocks including 2 retries). A per-block engine can therefore exit every holding whose stressed t* exceeds that unwind time. Rank-1 tenure of victims was at least 24 h in 77% of cases and at least 1 h in 51 of 52.

(2) EMISSION-OFF / GATE STARVATION. Root's SubnetEmissionEnabled=false zeroes tao_in and chain buys while 1 alpha/block keeps minting (18% owner, liquid on about 115 subnets; 41% miners). The Hill gate g = 1/(1+(theta/b)^3) gives a subnet at theta/2 only 11% of its share. This yields a closed-form flow drift: price drift ~ 2*(chain_buys - lambda*liquid_emission - claim_sales)/T per day. Total-return drift is TRD = nominator_yield - 2*D. That makes "starvation" measurable rather than anecdotal. It is also consistent in magnitude with the gate-era small-tercile price-only -0.57 to -0.67%/day.

(3) LIQUIDITY. Pools are near-0.5 Balancer pools (CPMM). Exit shortfall is V/(T+V), so V_max = T*s/(1-s). CPMM path independence implies that splitting an exit into tranches gives exactly the same TAO out unless something refills the pool between tranches. Only chain buys are a mechanism-backed refill; REV < 0 means no mean-reversion refill can be assumed. Tranching is therefore only justified where SubnetExcessTao > 0.

(4) FIXED COSTS. About 0.00103 TAO per buy, 0.00083 per sell, 0.0504% swap fee per leg, and no batching under a Staking proxy. These make small orders and turnover value-destroying, so minimum order and no-trade bands are mechanical.

(5) OPERATIONAL REGIME RISK. About 30 runtime releases in 3 months, roughly 6 emission regimes in 11 months, a 2h34m chain freeze, a 10-day SafeMode with no staking calls whitelisted, owner-wallet drains, and PyPI compromises. Kill switches are needed because model validity, not just price, can change in one block.

(6) NO SHORTING. Every strategy view is long-only. Netting virtual sleeves on one coldkey removes duplicated fees and slippage, and a risk veto can only reduce weight to 0.
evidence_for:
PRUNE MECHANICS [P/R]
- get_network_to_prune reproduces the victim in 52/52 events (brief §4.3). The rule is deterministic and readable every block; SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune returned Some(92).
- Recovery: SubnetTAO/(AlphaOut+AlphaIn) for new-generation subnets and SubnetTAO/AlphaOut for legacy ones, with baskets sold first. SN92 is about 0.41x before and 0.35-0.37x after the basket sale; SN47 is 0.36x. My formula R = x^2/((x+E)(S+P+x)) gives 0.368 for SN92, matching.
- Victim lead time: 40/52 victims were rank 1 for at least 24 h. Only 1 was rank 1 for under 1 h (SN116, 0.3% EMA gap, rank 2 at 300 blocks before). 45/52 had been in the bottom 3 for at least 2 days. EMA gap to rank 2 at P-1 had median 7.2%.
- Registration timing (n=32, Feb-Oct 2026): minimum 14,401 blocks; CDF 31k 9%, 43k 19%, 50k 31%, 55k 50%, 60k 72%, 65k 84%, 71k 94%. My smoothed conditional P(registration within 24 h) is 8% at window opening, 7% at delta 31k, 16% at 43k, 40% at 50k, and about 51-55% at 55-65k.
- Monte Carlo check: 8 h half-life, 7%/day vol, 2%/day -40% jumps. At peak hazard P(prune within 24 h) is about 50% for the target, about 1.2% for rank 2 at a 7.2% gap, about 2% if that subnet's spot is already 20% below its EMA, and about 0.14% at a 25.5% gap. Risk is therefore concentrated within about 10% of the bottom EMA, which is where Tier A/B thresholds sit.

EMISSION / GATE [P]
- Disabled subnets keep alpha_out and lose tao_in and chain buys (run_coinbase.rs).
- 10 subnets switched off in late June were pruned 1-15 weeks later.
- Gate keeps 50% of share at theta, 11% at theta/2, 3.6% at theta/3. The bottom pool tercile gets a median of 0 TAO/day.
- Typical micro-cap miner share alone is 0.4-1.2% of pool per day of potential sells.

LIQUIDITY / EXECUTION [P]
- V_max = T*s/(1-s) is exact at w=0.5. CPMM path independence of split sells is an algebraic identity: y*a/(x+a) whether sold in one or two pieces.
- Measured shielded outcomes: 98.9% of carriers decrypt and execute at N+2. add_stake_limit fails 1.6% with SlippageTooHigh and 1.2% with PriceLimitExceeded; remove_stake_limit 0.7% / 0.9%; remove_stake_full_limit 3.0% SlippageTooHigh. Unshielded add_stake_limit failed 11.9% PLE / 6.7% STH, so re-quoting discipline matters.
- Fees: Proxy(add_stake_limit) 933,081 rao, Proxy(remove_stake_limit) about 742,666 rao, carrier about 94,560 rao.
- A crossed limit fails even with allow_partial=True. Nominator remainders below 0.02 TAO are force-sold with no limit.

OPERATIONAL PRECEDENTS [P/S]
- 2025-05-20 freeze of 2h34m; July 2024 SafeMode of 10 days with no staking calls whitelisted.
- About 30 runtime releases between 2026-06-29 and 10-08, including several hotfixes changing staking bookkeeping.
- Staking proxy (ProxyType 8) cannot transfer funds, but a leaked one can force bad swaps, so unexplained stake deltas and delegate nonce jumps are meaningful compromise signals.
- SDK v11 execute() never shields; v11 default AddStake fails above 2.47% of T.

STRATEGY CONTEXT [R]
- Price-only micro-cap long is about -0.5%/day in the gate era.
- Seeded launches: 0/11 positive by day 90.
- Small-tercile capacity is tiny (Maymin: net SMB turns -5.48%/day at $100K). Pool-relative caps and impact-aware sizing are therefore first-order, not cosmetic.
evidence_against:
1. FAST PRUNES EXIST.
 - SN67 went from rank 49 to 1 within a day; SN90 from rank 7 to 1 within 8 h; SN116 from rank 2 to 1 in under 1 h at a 0.3% gap.
 - My Monte Carlo with 7%/day vol assigns tiny probability to such climbs. Real tails are fatter (owner dumps, coordinated exits, many bots reading the same public ladder and selling together, which is reflexive crowding).
 - The jump parameters are guesses until calibrated (FT1/FT2).

2. THE HAZARD MODEL IS THIN.
 - Only 32 registration intervals under the current 14,400 rate limit.
 - The April-May 2026 demand spike paid 2,632 TAO at the first allowed block, which shows the point mass at window opening is regime-dependent.
 - Spec 475 added "PoW registration" with unverified scope. A SubnetLimit change (a 256 cap was discussed) or a NetworkRateLimit change would invalidate the table.

3. RECOVERY RATIO IS UNCALIBRATED.
 - Spec 468 changed dissolution accounting.
 - Pending-emission handling and basket sale chunking are unmodelled (brief open question 10).

4. UNHEDGEABLE TAILS.
 - SafeMode blocks all exits, and its 7,200+ block duration exceeds any lead time. When it ends, a registrant and every holder race for the first block.
 - root_dissolve_network and emission switch-offs have zero on-chain lead.
 - Only aggregate exposure caps help.

5. EMISSION-OFF AND GATE RULES MAY DESTROY VALUE.
 - Total-return SMB including 0.3-0.6%/day nominator yield has never been computed, and its sign is unknown.
 - An emission-off exit sells into everyone else's exit at the event block. Re-enables happen (47 subnets on 2026-09-09).
 - The gate haircut may cut positions whose yield-inclusive total return is positive. lambda_sell (realised sell-through of liquid emission) is unknown.

6. CAPS AND CASH DRAG.
 - 20% TAO cash, plus gate, escrow and TRD multipliers, plus impact-optimal sizing at 0.5-0.7% of T leave capacity of only about 100-250 TAO in micro caps.
 - Fixed costs and the round trip (about 2V/T + 0.1%) consume much of a 0.4%/day gross signal unless holding periods are at least about 1 week.

7. KILL-SWITCH FALSE POSITIVES. Runtime upgrades every ~3 days, public RPC throttling (-32029/-32004/429) and Taostats quota limits can trigger frequent CAUTION modes. During them, signals decay but prune risk does not.

8. EXECUTION UNKNOWNS.
 - The never-included shielded carrier rate is unmeasurable from chain data.
 - Nonce lockout after a miss is untested.
 - Finality lag above about 5 blocks makes 8-block shielded eras stale. Exits must then fall back to unshielded limits (MEV-exposed).

9. NETTING COUPLES SLEEVES. One coldkey gives netting savings, but key compromise or one sleeve's lock-constrained position affects all sleeves. Per-strategy coldkeys (recommended in brief risk 8) forfeit netting.

10. MODEL DRIFT. Runtime constants (EmissionBarRank, gate exponent, immunity, FeeRate) are root-settable and have changed with little notice. Every calibrated threshold here can silently become stale.
universe_filter:
The overlay filters every sleeve. "Holdable" means the overlay does not force an exit; "enterable" means increases are allowed. All values are read live from chain state at the decision block.

A. HARD ELIGIBILITY (enter and hold)
- netuid != 0.
- netuid in NetworksAdded.
- Generation key (netuid, NetworkRegisteredAt) equals the key stored on the position. A changed key means our position was dissolved: book it as liquidated.
- SubtokenEnabled[n] = true (buys need it; sells do not).
- FirstEmissionBlockNumber[n] is set, i.e. start_call done (except the launch sleeve; see C).
- NetworkRegistrationAllowed[n] = true. If false the EMA is frozen and the prune model breaks.

B. LIQUIDITY BAND (enter)
- SubnetTAO[n] >= T_MIN_POOL = 200 TAO.
- SubnetTAO above 3,000 is allowed: the micro-cap focus is a strategy choice, not an overlay rule.
- Swap.SwapBalancer quote weight in [0.30, 0.70]. Outside it the simulator assumptions are flagged and need runtime sim_swap only.
- Swap.FeeRate[n] <= 330 (about 0.5%). The default is 33; any root change triggers re-evaluation.
- Escrow ratio E_n/SubnetAlphaIn[n] <= 0.5, with E from BetaBasketRuntimeApi.get_all_validator_baskets.

C. EMISSION
- Enter only if SubnetEmissionEnabled[n] = true.
- Exception: the launch sleeve may enter emission-disabled new subnets. These are prune-immune for 864,000 blocks. The launch sleeve's cap is 0.5x normal, it is limited to the launch budget, and it is subject to ENABLE_WAIT_MAX = 21 days after start_call.
- Re-enabled subnets (SubnetEmissionEnabledSet true) become enterable after one full tempo (360 blocks).
- Hold: forced exit on a true -> false transition while held (see exit rules).

D. PRUNE (enter only if all hold)
- If non-immune (now >= NetworkRegisteredAt + NetworkImmunityPeriod):
  - prune_rank >= K_ENTRY_HARD + 1 = 6, AND
  - EMA_n >= EMA_target*(1 + G_ENTRY), with G_ENTRY = 0.5, AND
  - P_prune_7d(n)*(1 - R_n) <= PI_ENTRY_7D = 1%.
- If immune: block entry when immunity ends within 7 days AND the projected rank at expiry is <= 5.
- Always: block entry if prune_possible and n is within the Tier A/B exit zone.
- prune_possible means: count(non-root subnets) + len(DissolveCleanupQueue) >= SubnetLimit. Otherwise registrations do not prune and prune hazard is 0.

E. FLOW / GATE (enter)
- Block if TRD_n < TRD_BAN = -0.75%/day, unless the sleeve declares bid_independent=True and supplies its own dilution model.
- g_n and TRD_n set the cap multipliers in sizing.

F. VALIDATOR
- At least one hotkey must pass the selection filters: in AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,.) for the last 3 epochs, take <= 5%, our stake <= 5% of TotalHotkeyAlpha(h,n), stake rank <= 0.8*MaxAllowedValidators.
- Without one, stake earns no yield: no entry.

G. COOLDOWNS (enter blocked)
- Abnormal-fill cooldown: 7,200 blocks.
- Owner-event cooldown: 7,200 blocks after a perpetual -> decaying lock switch, SubnetOwnerChanged, or an owner-coldkey unstake above 2% of SubnetTAO.
- Data for n stale beyond limits.
- Subnet in a failed-order burst (3 failures in 600 blocks).

H. AGGREGATE EXPOSURE CAPS (portfolio)
- Ladder bucket (non-immune prune_rank <= 15): <= 15% of NAV_liq.
- Owner-coldkey cluster (SubnetOwner coldkey): <= 20%. Covenant had 3 subnets.
- Young bucket (under 30 days since start_call): <= 10%.
- Sum of per-position expected exit cost: <= 2% of NAV_liq.

signals.name: prune_target
signals.formula: argmin over C(t) of (SubnetMovingPrice[n], NetworkRegisteredAt[n]), where C(t) = {n in NetworksAdded, n != 0, t >= NetworkRegisteredAt[n] + NetworkImmunityPeriod}. prune_rank(n) is n's 1-based position in that ordering. Cross-check each block against SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune(). A mismatch triggers a data alarm, and the runtime value wins.
signals.inputs: SubtensorModule.NetworksAdded, SubnetMovingPrice (I96F32 raw/2^32), NetworkRegisteredAt, NetworkImmunityPeriod (live 864,000); runtime SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_subnet_to_prune
signals.update_trigger: Every new head (block N post-state). Also immediately on NetworkRemoved, NetworkAdded and NetworkRegistrationQueued events, and at any precomputed immunity-expiry block.

signals.name: t_star (stressed time-to-target per holding)
signals.formula: EMA projection with spot held constant: E_j(t) = s_j + (E_j - s_j)*(1-a_j)^t, where a_j = SubnetMovingAlpha*b_j/(b_j + EMAPriceHalvingBlocks[j]) and b_j = t_abs - (FirstEmissionBlockNumber[j] - 1). Inputs are clamped with s_j = min(spot_j, 1.0). t*_k = the smallest t on a 10-block grid at which k is in C(now+t) and (E_k(t), reg_k) < (E_j(t), reg_j) for every other j in the ladder set (including subnets whose immunity ends before now+t). Stress: s_k = spot_k*(1 - D_STRESS); other subnets at current spot. Closed form when the target EMA is flat: t* = ln((E_k - s)/(E_1 - s))/a_k. When both move with equal a: t* = ln((E_k - E_1 + s_1 - s_k)/(s_1 - s_k))/a, and k never crosses if s_k >= s_1. The worst case uses s = 0.
signals.inputs: SubnetMovingPrice, current spot ((w_base/w_quote)*SubnetTAO/SubnetAlphaIn, or SwapRuntimeApi_current_alpha_price_all), SubnetMovingAlpha (live 0.0003), EMAPriceHalvingBlocks (201,600), FirstEmissionBlockNumber, NetworkRegisteredAt, NetworkImmunityPeriod
signals.update_trigger: Every new head for each holding; horizon = U_k + M_A

signals.name: registration window and hazard P_reg
signals.formula:
Definitions:
- last = LastRateLimitedBlock(RateLimitKey 0x02); W_open = last + NetworkRateLimit; delta = now - last.
- I_eff = NetworkLockReductionInterval*block_emission/1e9 (57,600 now).
- Cost ratio r(delta) = max(NetworkMinLockCost/NetworkLastLockCost, 2 - delta/I_eff), so r = 1.75 at window open.

Empirical CDF indexed by r (robust to I_eff changes):
- r>1.75 (closed): 0
- at opening: P_OPEN = 0.0625
- r 1.462: 0.09
- 1.253: 0.19
- 1.132: 0.31
- 1.045: 0.50
- 0.958: 0.72
- 0.872: 0.84
- 0.767: 0.94
- 0.266: 1.0
Interpolation is piecewise-linear.

Smoothing: F = (32*F_emp + N0*F_prior)/(32 + N0), with N0 = 4 and F_prior = 1 - exp(-(delta - 14,400)/43,200).

Conservative tail: once r <= 1.045, the per-block hazard is floored at LAMBDA_FLOOR = ln2/7200.

Hot market: if the last 2 registrations paid r >= 1.4, use P_OPEN = 0.5.

Output: P_reg(t0,t1) = 1 - S(t1)/S(t0), with S = 1 - F. P_reg = 0 if delta < NetworkRateLimit or not prune_possible.

Reference values: P_reg(24h) = 8.3% at opening, 7.3% at delta 31k, 15.7% at 43k, 39.6% at 50k, 51% at 55k, 55% at 65k.
signals.inputs: LastRateLimitedBlock(0x02), NetworkRateLimit (14,400), NetworkLastLockCost, NetworkMinLockCost, NetworkLockReductionInterval, block emission (get_block_emission_for_issuance(TotalIssuance) or SubnetInfoRuntimeApi_get_block_emission), SubnetRegistrationRuntimeApi_get_network_registration_cost (cross-check), SubnetLimit, DissolveCleanupQueue length, count of NetworksAdded
signals.update_trigger: Every new head (cheap table lookup). Window reset on NetworkRegistrationQueued or NetworkAdded. Table refit weekly and after every registration.

signals.name: P_prune Monte Carlo (24h and 7d)
signals.formula:
Ladder set: bottom-20 non-immune by EMA, plus holdings, plus subnets whose immunity ends within H with EMA <= 2x the target EMA.
Per path:
- ln s_j steps every 60 blocks: sigma_j*sqrt(60/7200)*(sqrt(rho)*Zc + sqrt(1-rho)*Zj) + J_j.
- J_j = ln(1 + JUMP_SIZE) with probability JUMP_P*60/7200.
- sigma_j = max(SIGMA_FLOOR, realized daily vol of ln spot over 3 days, sampled every 60 blocks).
- E_j <- s_j + (E_j - s_j)*(1 - a_j)^60.
- Candidates are admitted at their immunity-expiry block.
- Per step, a registration is drawn with P_reg(step).
- On a registration the path's target is removed. If it is k, k is pruned (absorbing). The window then closes for NetworkRateLimit blocks.
P_prune_H(k) = fraction of paths in which k is pruned by H. Use 2,000 paths and H in {7,200 (24h), 50,400 (7d)}.
signals.inputs: Same as t_star plus P_reg; spot history (from the per-block stream or 60-block snapshots)
signals.update_trigger: Every 60 blocks. Immediately on: NetworkRemoved/Added/RegistrationQueued, an |Δln spot| > 5% in one block on a held or ladder subnet, an immunity expiry within 600 blocks, or SubnetEmissionEnabledSet.

signals.name: recovery_ratio R_k (dissolution payout / spot)
signals.formula:
Inputs: x = SubnetAlphaIn, T = SubnetTAO, E = escrow alpha on k, S = TotalAlphaStaked[k], P = SubnetProtocolAlpha[k].
T_after = T*(x/(x+E))^(w_base/w_quote); with w = 0.5 this is T*x/(x+E), because baskets are sold first.
denominator = (S - E) + P + (x + E if NetworkRegisteredAt[k] > TaoInRefundDeploymentBlock (8,334,450) else 0).
R_k = clamp((T_after/denominator)/spot_k, 0, 1).
Fallback R_DEFAULT = 0.35. SN92 check: 0.368.
signals.inputs: SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, SubnetAlphaOut, SubnetProtocolAlpha, TotalAlphaStaked (spec 448+; else sum of TotalHotkeyAlpha over the subnet), BetaBasketRuntimeApi_get_all_validator_baskets, NetworkRegisteredAt, TaoInRefundDeploymentBlock, SwapBalancer
signals.update_trigger: Every 60 blocks for the ladder set and holdings; escrow refreshed every 360 blocks

signals.name: gate share g_n and emission state
signals.formula:
Eligible set: FirstEmissionBlockNumber set, SubtokenEnabled, NetworkRegistrationAllowed, non-root.
s_i = EMA_i/sum(EMA).
b_i = s_i*(1 - min(MinerBurned_i, 1)), renormalised.
g_i = 1/(1 + (theta/b_i)^h), with theta = EmissionGateBar (U64F64/2^64) and h = EmissionGateExponent (or 3); g_i = 0 if b_i = 0.
Predicted TAO emission share: e_i = b_i*g_i/sum(b*g) over enabled subnets.
emission_on = SubnetEmissionEnabled (an absent key means true).
Parity check: e_i*0.5 TAO vs SubnetTaoInEmission + SubnetExcessTao within 1e-4.
signals.inputs: SubnetMovingPrice, MinerBurned (U96F32), EmissionGateBar, EmissionGateExponent, EmissionBarRank, SubnetEmissionEnabled, SubnetTaoInEmission, SubnetExcessTao
signals.update_trigger: Block % 360 == 0 (theta recompute), on any SubnetEmissionEnabledSet event, and every 60 blocks for b_i drift

signals.name: flow drift D_n and total-return drift TRD_n
signals.formula:
liquid_alpha_day = 7200*alpha_out_per_block*[0.18*(1 - OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled) + 0.41*(1 - min(MinerBurned, 1))].
chain_buy_day = 7200*SubnetExcessTao (TAO).
claim_day = C_CLAIM*E_n*spot.
D_n = (LAMBDA_SELL*liquid_alpha_day*spot + claim_day - chain_buy_day)/SubnetTAO, as a fraction of pool per day.
nominator yield y_n = realized median of Δln I per epoch of the chosen hotkey * 7200/tempo; fallback 7200*alpha_out*0.41*(1 - rp)/A_earn*(1 - take).
TRD_n = y_n - 2*D_n, since a CPMM price moves about 2x the net TAO flow/T.
Gate drop-out event: g fell from >= 0.5 to < 0.1 within 3 theta updates.
signals.inputs: SubnetAlphaOutEmission, OwnerCutAutoLockEnabled, MinerBurned, SubnetExcessTao, escrow E (basket API), SubnetTAO, RootProp, TotalHotkeyAlpha, TotalHotkeySharesV2 (SafeFloat m*10^e), AlphaDividendsPerSubnet, Delegates, Tempo, LastEpochBlock
signals.update_trigger: Every 360 blocks, and at each LastEpochBlock change for held or candidate subnets (yield update)

signals.name: position cap V_cap_n and exit shortfall ES_n
signals.formula:
T_st = min(SubnetTAO_now, min over 3 days of SubnetTAO)*(1 - D_T).
base = T_st*s/(1-s) with s = S_EXIT_ENTRY (= 1.52% of T_st at s = 1.5%). If |w_quote - 0.5| > 0.01, solve shortfall(a) = s by bisection on simulate_sell.
V_cap = min(base*m_gate*m_esc*m_trd, NU_MAX*NAV_liq), where:
- m_gate = 1 if g >= 0.5, 0.5 if 0.1 <= g < 0.5, else 0.25
- m_esc = clamp(1 - E/x, 0.5, 1)
- m_trd = 0.5 if TRD < -0.25%/day else 1
Held-position shortfall: ES_n = 1 - (simulate_sell(pool, alpha_held).tao_out - 0.00084)/(alpha_held*spot).
Trim to the S_EXIT_ENTRY size if ES_n > S_EXIT_HOLD_MAX.
signals.inputs: SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, Swap.SwapBalancer, Swap.FeeRate, escrow E, g_n, TRD_n, NAV_liq; runtime sim_swap_alpha_for_tao for cross-checks
signals.update_trigger: Every head for holdings (ES); at each allocator cycle (every 60 blocks or on a sleeve target change) for candidates

signals.name: impact-optimal size V*_n
signals.formula:
Maximise alpha_h*V - 2V^2/T - 2fV - fees, where alpha_h is the sleeve's expected gross return over its holding horizon, including yield, and round-trip impact is about 2V/T at w = 0.5.
V* = T*(alpha_h - 2f)/4. Net at the optimum is T*(alpha_h - 2f)^2/8.
Examples: alpha_h = 2% gives V* = 0.475% of T; 3% gives 0.725%; 5% gives 1.225%.
Target = min(V_cap, V*) whenever the sleeve supplies alpha_h.
signals.inputs: Sleeve-supplied alpha_h and horizon, SubnetTAO, FeeRate
signals.update_trigger: Each allocator cycle

signals.name: NAV_liq and drawdowns
signals.formula:
NAV_liq = free_TAO(real) - MIN_FREE_REAL + sum over n of [simulate_sell(pool_n, alpha_n).tao_out - 0.00084]. This is a one-shot exit value, not spot.
DD30 = 1 - NAV_liq/max(NAV_liq over the last 30 days), adjusted for deposits and withdrawals.
Daily loss = NAV_liq change over 7,200 blocks, ex-flows.
Per-sleeve virtual NAV_liq comes from the virtual ledgers.
signals.inputs: System.Account(real).free, our stake per (hotkey, netuid) (StakeInfoRuntimeApi_get_stake_info_for_coldkey or share-pool reads), pool states
signals.update_trigger: Every 10 blocks; drawdown checks every head when a fill occurred

signals.name: N+2 drift buffer beta_n
signals.formula:
r2 = |ln p_t - ln p_(t-2)| over the last 1,800 blocks, excluding blocks containing our own fills.
beta_entry = clamp(q95(r2), 0.001, BETA_MAX_ENTRY = 0.02).
beta_exit = clamp(q99(r2), 0.0025, 0.05).
The deterministic chain-buy drift over 2 blocks, (1 + 2e/y)^(1/w_base) - 1, is about 1e-6 and is ignored but logged.
signals.inputs: Per-block spot of the subnet (head stream), our fill log
signals.update_trigger: Every head for held and candidate subnets

signals.name: validator score Y_h,n
signals.formula:
I_h,n = TotalHotkeyAlpha(h,n)/TotalHotkeySharesV2(h,n).
Y = median over the last K_EPOCHS = 20 epochs of Δln I (each Δ measured between consecutive LastEpochBlock values), times 7200/Tempo, as a daily rate.
Filters: h in AlphaDividendsPerSubnet(n,.) for 3 consecutive epochs; Delegates[h]/65535 <= TAKE_MAX; no take increase in the last 216,000 blocks; our_alpha/TotalHotkeyAlpha(h,n) <= Q_MAX; stake rank <= 0.8*MaxAllowedValidators[n]; ChildkeyTake of h's children stable.
signals.inputs: TotalHotkeyAlpha, TotalHotkeySharesV2 (legacy TotalHotkeyShares before v473), AlphaDividendsPerSubnet, Delegates, ChildkeyTake, ParentKeys/ChildKeys, MaxAllowedValidators, LastEpochBlock, Tempo
signals.update_trigger: At each LastEpochBlock change of held or candidate subnets; a full rescan daily

signals.name: chain/infra health vector
signals.formula:
secs_since_block from Timestamp.Now and the local clock.
finality_lag = best - finalized.
Per-endpoint health over a rolling 100 calls: error rate (429, -32029, -32004, timeouts), p95 latency, and head lag versus the max observed head.
spec = state_getRuntimeVersion().specVersion; also transactionVersion.
safe_mode = SafeMode.EnteredUntil is Some(b) with b >= now.
prune_input_age = blocks since the last successful ladder read.
Per-input staleness in blocks.
signals.inputs: chain_getHeader, chain_getFinalizedHead, state_getRuntimeVersion / state_subscribeRuntimeVersion, System.Events (System.CodeUpdated), SafeMode.EnteredUntil, Timestamp.Now, endpoint call logs
signals.update_trigger: Every head, plus a 5-second timer for stall detection

signals.name: stake/key reconciliation residual
signals.formula:
For each (hotkey, netuid): residual = onchain_alpha - expected_alpha.
expected = book + own fills (matched by our inner extrinsic hash and Proxy.ProxyExecuted Ok) + epoch accrual at LastEpochBlock(n).
Alarm if residual < -max(2 rao, 1e-6*position) or > 3*expected_epoch_yield.
Also alarm on: delegate nonce != expected; Proxy.Proxies(real) or Proxy.Announcements changed; coldkey-swap scheduled; real free balance falling beyond our own buys; any StakeMoved, StakeTransferred or StakeSwapped involving our coldkey that is not ours; TransactionFeePaidWithAlpha for our coldkey.
signals.inputs: Share-pool stake reads, System.Account(delegate_i).nonce and .free, Proxy.Proxies(real), Proxy.Announcements(real), coldkey-swap storage and events, System.Events
signals.update_trigger: Every head

entry_rules:
The overlay never originates entries; sleeves do. This is the pre-trade gate every increase passes through, in order. A failure blocks the increase but never forces a sale; forced sales are in exit_rules.

1. MODE. Global mode must be NORMAL. CAUTION, EXITS_ONLY and FROZEN block all increases. The sleeve must be ACTIVE or REDUCED (REDUCED gets budget x0.5); SUSPENDED and RETIRED sleeves cannot increase.

2. UNIVERSE. The subnet passes universe_filter sections A-G, evaluated on the same head block whose state is used for pricing.

3. PRUNE GATE.
 - prune_possible = false, OR all of:
   - the subnet is immune, with no expiry inside 7 days at projected rank <= 5; or prune_rank >= 6;
   - EMA_n >= 1.5x EMA_target;
   - P_prune_7d(n)*(1 - R_n) <= 1%;
   - n is not inside the Tier A or Tier B exit zone.
 - Also, no increases into any subnet with prune_rank <= 15 while the ladder bucket is at or above 15% of NAV_liq.

4. EMISSION/FLOW GATE.
 - SubnetEmissionEnabled = true (launch-sleeve exception per universe C).
 - TRD_n >= -0.75%/day unless the sleeve is bid_independent.
 - Not within 360 blocks of a re-enable.

5. SIZE.
 - New aggregate target_n <= V_cap_n, and <= V*_n when the sleeve provides alpha_h.
 - Per subnet <= NU_MAX*NAV_liq.
 - Gross alpha <= G_MAX_EFF*NAV_liq.
 - Position count <= N_eff = min(N_MAX, floor(G_MAX_EFF*NAV_liq/(4*V_MIN))).
 - Owner-cluster, ladder and young buckets, and the portfolio exit budget (sum of ES_n*V_n <= 2% of NAV_liq) must all hold.

6. TRADE WORTHINESS.
 - |Δ_n| >= max(V_MIN = 0.5 TAO, BAND*max(target_n, held_n)) with BAND = 0.20.
 - Expected benefit alpha_h*|Δ| >= cost(|Δ|) = |Δ|*(|Δ|/T + f) + 0.00103.
 - Post-fee net input >= 0.002 TAO (chain DefaultMinStake).

7. CASH AND FEES.
 - free_TAO(real) - MIN_FREE_REAL (0.05 TAO) >= order amount. Never use amount 'all' for buys: the SDK's 500k-rao headroom is below the about 850k-rao fee.
 - The fee-paying delegate's balance must be >= B_DEL_CAUTION (0.15 TAO).

8. EXECUTION READINESS.
 - The submit node is at the network head (head lag 0 versus the best of >= 2 endpoints).
 - finality_lag <= 5 for shielded submission.
 - No other in-flight order on the same netuid.
 - A free delegate (not nonce-locked) is available.
 - Runtime sim_swap at the head block returns non-zero and matches the local simulator within 1e-5.

9. ORDER FORM. add_stake_limit with allow_partial=True and limit = p_marg(Δ)*(1 + beta_entry), submitted shielded (see pseudocode plan_entry). Chasing is capped at K_CHASE = 2 re-quotes and CHI_MAX = 1.5% cumulative drift from the decision spot.

10. VALIDATOR. Stake to choose_hotkey(n). Never split one subnet across hotkeys: each (coldkey, hotkey) position is dust-checked separately.
exit_rules:
Forced exits override every sleeve. They apply to the whole physical position across all sleeves. Priority order is EMERGENCY > URGENT > NORMAL; within a tier, order by expected-loss rate = P*(1-R)*V/blocks_to_deadline. They are executed even in EXITS_ONLY mode. In FROZEN mode they are queued and become the first submissions when FROZEN ends.

PRUNE TIER A (EMERGENCY; hard, deterministic)
- Applies if prune_possible AND now + U_k + M_A >= W_open (window open or opening within the margin), AND either:
  - k == prune_target(now), OR
  - t*_k(stress s_k = 0.5*spot_k) <= U_k + M_A.
- U_k = 9 blocks (L_EXEC 3 blocks x (1 + 2 retries)); M_A = 150 blocks. This zone covers gaps of about 4% at a 50% crash and about 6% at a zero-price crash.
- Also fires when a held immune subnet's immunity ends inside U_k + M_A and it would be the target.
- Execution: single shot (no tranches; our own tranches would lower our EMA). remove_stake_limit(amount = full alpha, allow_partial=True), with marginal limit p0*(1 - s_emerg)^2 and s_emerg = clamp(0.5*(1 - R_k), 0.05, 0.25). Re-quote every block until flat.

PRUNE TIER B (URGENT; probabilistic)
- Applies if prune_possible AND now + H_B (7,200) >= W_open AND P_prune_24h(k)*(1 - R_k) >= PI_B = 0.75% of position.
- Execution: single shot, allow_partial, average-slippage budget S_URGENT = 3%, re-quote every block, widening x1.5 up to s_emerg.

PRUNE BACKSTOP (URGENT; model-free, from brief §9)
- prune_possible AND non-immune prune_rank <= K_BOTTOM = 3 AND r(now) = c/L <= 1.2, i.e. delta >= about 46,080 blocks.
- Example: from about block 9,256,690 this exits SN47 and SN72 (ranks 2-3) if still bottom-3.

DISSOLVED
- NetworkRemoved(k), or a changed (netuid, NetworkRegisteredAt) generation key, while held.
- Cancel all orders on k. Book the position as liquidating. Reconcile free-TAO credits over the following on_idle blocks, then record the realized R to calibrate the formula.

EMISSION OFF (URGENT)
- SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(k, false) event, or a storage read of false on a subnet that was true at entry.
- Exit at S_URGENT = 3% in a single shot: a disabled subnet has no chain buys, so tranching is useless.
- k joins the entry ban until re-enabled + 360 blocks. Downgrade per FT3 if the event study shows holding wins.

LAUNCH NEVER ENABLED (NORMAL)
- Launch-sleeve positions entered while disabled are exited if not enabled within ENABLE_WAIT_MAX = 21 days of start_call.
- Hard time stop of 90 days in any case: day-90 evidence is -68% median, 0/11 positive.

GATE DROP-OUT (NORMAL)
- For sleeves that declared requires_bid=True: g_k fell from >= 0.5 to < 0.1 within 3 theta updates (1,080 blocks).
- Exit that sleeve's share at S_EXIT_ENTRY with tranches only if chain-buy refill exists.

LIQUIDITY DRIFT (NORMAL; trim, not full exit)
- ES_k(held) > S_EXIT_HOLD_MAX = 2.5%: trim to the V_cap computed with T_now.
- Portfolio sum of ES*V > 2% of NAV_liq: trim the largest-ES positions first.

DUST RULE
- If any sell would leave a remainder below REMAINDER_MIN = max(0.05 TAO-equivalent, V_MIN), convert it to a full exit (remove_stake_full_limit).
- Never leave a nominator position under 0.02 TAO; the chain force-sells it with no limit.

KILL-SWITCH-DRIVEN EXITS
- Portfolio DD30 >= 20%: G_MAX_EFF = 0.25*G_MAX; excess is unwound over <= 3 days in NORMAL mode, largest ES first.
- Sleeve SUSPENDED: its virtual holdings go to 0 over <= 3 days, netted against other sleeves first.
- Key-compromise alarm: FROZEN, no exits. A thief with the Staking proxy profits from our forced trades. The user revokes the proxy from the coldkey and decides manually.
- Spec change with failed validation: only Tier A, Tier B and emission-off exits are allowed. They use runtime-API state (get_subnet_to_prune, current_alpha_price_all, sim_swap) and fill-or-kill limits derived from sim_swap.

SAFEMODE END
- At SafeMode.EnteredUntil + 1, re-run Tier A/B on post-SafeMode state and submit those exits first: a registrant can prune in that same block.

VALIDATOR EXITS (not a sale)
- Move stake to the next-best hotkey if: take rises > 5 percentage points; the hotkey is absent from AlphaDividendsPerSubnet for 2 consecutive epochs; or permit risk (rank > 0.8*MaxAllowedValidators).
- Use move_stake on the same subnet with alpha_amount = u64::MAX: no swap fee, about 0.001 TAO tx fee.
event_triggers:
EVERY NEW HEAD (12 s; driven by subscription, with a 5 s timer as backup)
1. Health: stall timer, finality lag, endpoint head lag, spec_version and transactionVersion, SafeMode.EnteredUntil.
2. One state_queryStorageAt for the ladder state (about 700 keys): SubnetMovingPrice, SubnetTAO, SubnetAlphaIn, NetworkRegisteredAt and SubnetEmissionEnabled for all netuids, plus globals and LastRateLimitedBlock(0x02). Then pool weights and fees for held and candidate subnets.
3. prune_target, t*_k for holdings, and Tier A checks.
4. Reconcile stakes, delegate nonce/balance and proxies.
5. Settle in-flight orders: carrier at N+2, inner at carrier index+1, Proxy.ProxyExecuted result. Never size from StakeAdded.
6. Update NAV_liq every 10 blocks.
7. Execute queued EMERGENCY/URGENT exits.

System.CodeUpdated, or specVersion != validated_spec
- Immediately set mode CAUTION (no increases) in the same block and start validation suite V1-V7:
  - V1 decode parity vs get_dynamic_info
  - V2 local swap sim vs SwapRuntimeApi_sim_swap_* within 1e-6 for 3 subnets x 2 sizes
  - V3 prune_target == get_subnet_to_prune
  - V4 emission-share reproduction within 1e-4 TAO
  - V5 fee parity via query_call_info within 20%
  - V6 call indices 88/89/103/85/149/90 and ProxyType::Staking (8) allow-list unchanged
  - V7 diff of governance constants
- All pass: paper resumes automatically; live resumes only after the user re-arms live.armed_spec.
- Any fail: EXITS_ONLY via runtime APIs. A transactionVersion change makes live FROZEN.

SafeMode Entered, or EnteredUntil >= now
- FROZEN (staking calls are not whitelisted).
- Precompute the post-SafeMode Tier A/B plan.
- On Exited, or at EnteredUntil+1: reconcile, then submit risk exits first.

NetworkRegistrationQueued, NetworkRemoved(n), NetworkAdded(n)
- Window reset: hazard is 0 for NetworkRateLimit blocks.
- Refresh the ladder and Monte Carlo.
- If n is held: mark DISSOLVED and reconcile the payout over the on_idle blocks.
- Refit the hazard table.

SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(n, false)
- Held: URGENT exit. Add n to the entry ban. Add a prune-hazard flag (leading indicator). Refresh the Monte Carlo.

SubnetEmissionEnabledSet(n, true)
- Lift the ban after 360 blocks. Notify sleeves (flow, yield and launch families consume it as a signal).

Precomputed immunity-expiry blocks (NetworkRegisteredAt + NetworkImmunityPeriod) of any subnet whose EMA <= 2x the target
- Refresh the ladder and Monte Carlo 600 blocks before and at expiry. Examples: SN16 at 9,324,646; SN99 at 9,436,056; SN86 at 9,557,284.

block % 360 == 0
- theta update: recompute g, m_gate and D/TRD; detect gate drop-outs.

LastEpochBlock(n) change for held or candidate n
- Update the share-price index, validator scores and filters; check take changes and AlphaDividendsPerSubnet membership; run validator switch logic.

Every 60 blocks
- Monte Carlo P_prune (24 h and 7 d), R_k, V_cap/V*, allocator cycle (also immediately on any sleeve target change), β refresh.

Single-block |Δ ln spot| > 5% on a held or ladder subnet
- Immediate t* recompute and Monte Carlo refresh; abnormal-fill check if it is our own fill.

Our order outcomes
- Carrier missing at N+2: MISSED is final. Nonce-lock that delegate until era expiry, about 8-10 blocks; re-plan on another delegate.
- PriceLimitExceeded / SlippageTooHigh / partial: re-quote per policy.
- SubnetNotExists: DISSOLVED.
- 3 failures on one netuid in 600 blocks: 7,200-block subnet cooldown.
- 5 failures portfolio-wide in 600 blocks: CAUTION for 300 blocks.

Unexplained events
- Stake delta, delegate nonce jump, Proxy.ProxyAdded/Removed on the real account, coldkey-swap scheduled, foreign StakeMoved/Transferred/Swapped on our coldkey, TransactionFeePaidWithAlpha: FROZEN plus alert to revoke the proxy from the coldkey (the bot cannot revoke).

Owner events
- StakeLocked/Unlocked showing a perpetual -> decaying switch, SubnetOwnerChanged, or an owner coldkey unstake above 2% of SubnetTAO: 7,200-block entry cooldown and cap x0.5 for 1 day.

Delegate fee balance
- Below 0.25 TAO: alert. Below 0.15: CAUTION. Below 0.05: EXITS_ONLY. The bot cannot top itself up; a Staking proxy cannot transfer.

Daily (block % 7200 == 0)
- Sleeve kill-switch evaluation, budget recompute (fixed / inverse-vol), HWM update, hazard table refit, Taostats cross-checks if a key is available.
sizing:
All in TAO, relative to live pool state; capital is configurable and every limit scales with NAV_liq. NAV_liq is liquidation-marked: one-shot sim_sell of each position minus exit fees, plus free TAO.

1. POOL-RELATIVE CAP (exit-slippage budget)
- V_cap_n = min(T_st*s/(1-s)*m_gate*m_esc*m_trd, NU_MAX*NAV_liq), with T_st = min(T_now, T_min_3d)*(1 - D_T).
- Defaults: s = S_EXIT_ENTRY = 1.5% (1.52% of T_st), D_T = 0.20, NU_MAX = 15%.
- Reference V_max/T: 0.5% -> 0.50%, 1% -> 1.01%, 1.5% -> 1.52%, 2% -> 2.04%, 5% -> 5.26%.
- Multipliers: m_gate 1 / 0.5 / 0.25 at g >= 0.5 / >= 0.1 / below; m_esc = clamp(1 - E/x, 0.5, 1); m_trd = 0.5 if TRD < -0.25%/day.
- For |w_quote - 0.5| > 0.01, solve by bisection with simulate_sell.

2. IMPACT-OPTIMAL TARGET
- When the sleeve supplies alpha_h, target_n = min(V_cap_n, V*_n) with V*_n = T(alpha_h - 2f)/4.
- At T = 1,650 TAO: alpha_h = 2% gives 7.8 TAO and 0.07 TAO net per round trip; 3% gives 12.0 TAO and 0.17 TAO.

3. HOLD BUDGET
- Trim when the expected one-shot exit shortfall ES_n > 2.5%.
- Portfolio sum of ES_n*V_n <= 2% of NAV_liq.

4. EMERGENCY BUDGET (prune exits only)
- s_emerg = clamp(0.5*(1 - R_k), 0.05, 0.25). With R = 0.37 that is 25%, still about 2.5x better than holding through dissolution.

5. PORTFOLIO LIMITS
- G_MAX = 80% of NAV_liq in alpha, so at least 20% is TAO cash.
- G_MAX_EFF = G_MAX x 0.5 when DD30 >= 10%, x 0.25 when DD30 >= 20%.
- Per subnet <= 15%. Ladder bucket (prune_rank <= 15) <= 15%. Owner-coldkey cluster <= 20%. Young (<30 days since start_call) <= 10%. Launch sleeve budget <= 5% (0 live until FT pass).
- N_eff = min(N_MAX = 12, floor(G_MAX_EFF*NAV_liq/(4*V_MIN))). Each position is >= 4 minimum orders so it can be trimmed in quarters. Example: NAV 10 TAO gives 4 positions; NAV 100 TAO gives 12.

6. MINIMUM ORDER VS FEES
- All-in production fees: buy about 0.00103 TAO (Proxy(add_stake_limit) 933k rao + carrier 94.6k); sell about 0.00084 TAO.
- With fee drag capped at 0.25%: V_min_buy = 0.41 and V_min_sell = 0.34. Default V_MIN = 0.5 TAO (buy drag 0.21%).
- Chain floors: gross >= 0.002 TAO + fee; post-fee >= 0.002; partial-sell TAO out >= 0.002.
- Nominator remainder >= 0.02 TAO at spot, else force-sold. Policy REMAINDER_MIN = max(0.05, V_MIN).
- No-trade band: max(V_MIN, 20% of target), and the benefit/cost test alpha_h*|Δ| >= |Δ|(|Δ|/T + f) + fee.

7. TAO CASH AND FEE BUFFERS
- Real coldkey keeps MIN_FREE_REAL = 0.05 TAO, never staked.
- Fee-paying delegate(s) (the default; or the real account if set_real_pays_fee is configured) hold B_DEL = orders_per_day_max(50)*days_autonomy(7)*0.00103 + N_eff*3*0.00084, about 0.39 TAO total across 3 delegates. Alert at 0.25, CAUTION at 0.15, EXITS_ONLY at 0.05.
- The buffer prevents the alpha-fee trap (fee taken in alpha; all alpha withdrawn if insufficient).

8. TRANCHES
- Only normal exits with chain-buy refill: V_tr = T*S_TR/(1-S_TR) with S_TR = 1%; n = ceil(V/V_tr); spacing w = clamp(ceil(V_tr/SubnetExcessTao), 10, 600) blocks.
- Otherwise single shot. CPMM path independence makes refill-free tranching strictly worse: same TAO out, extra fees and time risk.
- Unwind time U = n*(3 + w) + 6 blocks; single shot U = 9.

9. CAPACITY
- Micro caps (~32 pools under 3,000 TAO, ~20 eligible after prune/emission filters): sum of V_cap ≈ 130-260 TAO; practical at V* ≈ 100-150 TAO gross.
- Excess NAV stays in TAO and is reported as capacity utilisation.

10. CONCURRENCY
- One in-flight order per netuid; one per delegate (shielded uses nonces N and N+1). N_DELEGATES = 3 Staking proxies with delay 0.
- Verify each on chain via Proxy.Proxies(real): type must be Staking (8). Refuse to run live with Any or NonTransfer.

parameters.name: S_EXIT_ENTRY
parameters.rationale: Brief recommends 1-2% of pool. V_max = T*s/(1-s). Trade-off between capacity and exit cost; FT6 validates realized exit slippage.

parameters.name: S_EXIT_HOLD_MAX
parameters.rationale: Hysteresis between entry cap and forced trim when pool TAO shrinks (liquidity drift).

parameters.name: D_T (pool stress haircut)
parameters.rationale: Pools shrink when others exit simultaneously (emission-off waves, prune ladder crowding). Cap uses min(T_now, T_min_3d)*(1-D_T).

parameters.name: NU_MAX / G_MAX / N_MAX
parameters.rationale: Concentration, TAO cash buffer and position count. N_eff is also bounded by NAV/(4*V_MIN) so fixed fees stay below 0.25%.

parameters.name: V_MIN (min order)
parameters.rationale: All-in fee 0.00103 buy / 0.00084 sell: 0.21% drag at 0.5 TAO, 0.10% at 1 TAO. Also well above the chain 0.002 TAO and nominator 0.02 TAO floors.

parameters.name: REMAINDER_MIN
parameters.rationale: Remainders below NominatorMinRequiredStake (0.02 TAO at spot) are force-sold with no limit. 2.5x safety factor.

parameters.name: BAND (no-trade band)
parameters.rationale: Suppresses fee- and impact-dominated rebalances, combined with the alpha_h*|Δ| >= cost test.

parameters.name: M_A (Tier A margin)
parameters.rationale: Covers RPC hiccups and re-quotes beyond U = 9 blocks. With D_STRESS = 0.5 the danger zone is about a 4% EMA gap (about 6% at zero price).

parameters.name: D_STRESS
parameters.rationale: Instant spot crash assumed for t*. SN67 49->1 and SN90 7->1 within hours show crash-driven climbs. Calibrate so FT1 recall is >= 96%.

parameters.name: H_B / PI_B
parameters.rationale: Exit when expected 24 h prune loss P*(1-R) exceeds about half a typical exit cost. At peak hazard this exits subnets within about 10% of the bottom EMA (MC: rank 2 at 7.2% gap gives P about 1.2%, so expected loss 0.7%).

parameters.name: K_BOTTOM / R_BACKSTOP
parameters.rationale: Model-free backstop from brief §9 (bottom 3 non-immune and lock cost <= 1.2x last lock, i.e. delta >= about 46k blocks). FT1 ablation decides whether to keep it.

parameters.name: K_ENTRY_HARD / G_ENTRY / PI_ENTRY_7D
parameters.rationale: Entry ban by rank, EMA ratio to target, and 7-day expected prune loss. The ladder ranks 4-15 sit at 1.53-1.70x the bottom, so the ratio test matters more than rank.

parameters.name: Hazard table: P_OPEN / N0 / LAMBDA_FLOOR / hot-market P_OPEN
parameters.rationale: Empirical delta-reg CDF (n=32) indexed by lock-cost ratio r. Point mass at window opening (2/32 at 14,401). Monotone conservative tail after the median. Hot market when the last 2 registrations paid r >= 1.4.

parameters.name: MC: N_PATHS / SIGMA_FLOOR / RHO / JUMP_P / JUMP_SIZE
parameters.rationale: Bottom-tercile ratio vol is about 135%/yr (about 7%/day). Calibration target: the model must reproduce that about 13% (7/52) of victims were outside the bottom 3 two days before the prune, and 2/52 outside the bottom 7 within 1 day.

parameters.name: R_DEFAULT
parameters.rationale: Fallback recovery when the formula inputs are missing. Historical range 0.35-0.65; current candidates sit low.

parameters.name: s_emerg
parameters.rationale: Accept up to half the dissolution loss as slippage to guarantee the fill before the prune.

parameters.name: S_URGENT
parameters.rationale: Average-slippage budget for emission-off, Tier B and backstop exits.

parameters.name: G_FULL / G_LOW and m_gate
parameters.rationale: Gate keeps 50% of share at theta and 11% at theta/2. FT4 decides whether these haircuts add value (set to 1 if not).

parameters.name: LAMBDA_SELL / C_CLAIM
parameters.rationale: Unknown sell-through of liquid owner/miner emission. Basket claim release about 2%/day ±30%. Calibrate LAMBDA_SELL so that 2*D reproduces the gate-era micro-cap price drift.

parameters.name: TRD_HALF / TRD_BAN
parameters.rationale: Total-return drift = yield - 2*D. Halve the cap, then ban entries for bid-dependent sleeves.

parameters.name: ENABLE_WAIT_MAX / launch hard stop
parameters.rationale: New subnets start disabled. SN36 was disabled about 49 days. Day-90 cohort evidence is -68% median, 0/11 positive.

parameters.name: S_AVG_ENTRY / S_AVG_EXIT / S_TR
parameters.rationale: Per-order average-slippage caps. The marginal limit is about (1+s)^2 - 1 for CPMM.

parameters.name: BETA_ENTRY / BETA_EXIT (N+2 drift buffer)
parameters.rationale: Orders execute at N+2 after chain buys and others' trades in N+1/N+2. A crossed limit fails outright (PriceLimitExceeded, fee paid). Target fill rate >= 97%.

parameters.name: K_CHASE / CHI_MAX
parameters.rationale: Bounds paying up when price runs away on entries. Exits always re-quote.

parameters.name: N_DELEGATES
parameters.rationale: Nonce lockout after a missed carrier (about 6-10 blocks) and one in-flight shielded order per signer. Each needs its own fee buffer and proxy deposit (0.033 TAO).

parameters.name: STALL_WARN / STALL_HALT
parameters.rationale: 3 missed slots trigger CAUTION; 10 trigger EXITS_ONLY. The 2025-05-20 freeze lasted 2h34m.

parameters.name: FINALITY_SHIELD_PAUSE / FINALITY_CAUTION
parameters.rationale: The SDK anchors the 8-block shield era at the finalized head; measured era-to-inclusion is up to 5 blocks. Beyond that lag, carriers go stale, so exits fall back to unshielded tight limits.

parameters.name: RPC health thresholds
parameters.default: error rate 5% / p95 1.5 s / head lag 2 blocks; >= 2 healthy endpoints
parameters.rationale: Public endpoints throttle (429/-32029/-32004). NextKey and pricing must come from a head-synced node.

parameters.name: STALE_PRUNE
parameters.rationale: Prune inputs older than 5 minutes leave the Tier A check blind, so the overlay goes to CAUTION.

parameters.name: DD_SOFT / DD_HARD / DAILY_LOSS
parameters.rationale: Portfolio drawdown governors on liquidation-marked NAV. Bottom-tercile ratio vol is about 135-173%/yr, so the thresholds must not trip on normal noise (calibrate by bootstrap).

parameters.name: FILL_EXCESS / failure bursts
parameters.default: max(0.3%, 3*sigma_2blk); 3 fails per netuid per 600 blocks gives a 7,200-block cooldown; 5 portfolio-wide gives 300-block CAUTION
parameters.rationale: Measured shielded failure base rate is 1-3% per order. Bursts indicate adversarial flow or a model error.

parameters.name: Strategy kill: KS_REDUCE_DD / KS_SUSPEND_DD / boot pctl / cost ratio / turnover
parameters.default: 0.08 / 0.15 / 5th percentile of 45-day block-bootstrap of backtest / 1.5 (reduce), 2.5 (suspend) / 2x backtest
parameters.rationale: Paper or live behaviour inconsistent with the backtest falsifies the strategy. FT8 calibrates false-kill <= 5%.

parameters.name: ALLOC_MODE / SHRINK / B_MIN / B_MAX / B_MAX_LAUNCH
parameters.default: fixed equal budgets until >= 60 paper days, then inverse-vol shrunk 50% to fixed / 0.5 / 0.05 / 0.40 / 0.05 (live 0 until FT pass)
parameters.rationale: Too little sleeve history for covariance estimates at first. The launch family has strongly negative evidence.

parameters.name: Validator: TAKE_MAX / K_EPOCHS / switch hysteresis / Q_MAX / PERMIT_RANK_FRAC
parameters.default: 0.05 / 20 / max(0.02%/day, 10% relative) for 2 epochs and 30-day gain > 3x move fee / 0.05 / 0.8
parameters.rationale: Default take is 18% for unset hotkeys; take can jump 0 to 18% once per 216,000 blocks. Bond-EMA lag means a large own share dilutes the index. Permit loss stops dividends.

parameters.name: T_MIN_POOL / escrow max / fee max
parameters.rationale: The smallest live pool is 241 TAO. Escrow overhang is up to 43% on SN58. Root can raise FeeRate up to 15.26%.

expected_edge:
GROSS ALPHA
- 0 by construction. The overlay generates no return signal. Its value is the difference in net TAO return and max drawdown versus the same strategies with the overlay off (FT5).
- Assumptions: w ≈ 0.5 pools; f = 33/65535; all-in fees 0.00103 buy / 0.00084 sell; 52 prunes in about 351 days (0.148 per day, assumed stationary); R ≈ 0.37 (formula) to 0.65; EMA half-life about 8 h.

1) PRUNE AVOIDANCE (largest and most certain component)
- Holding V through a prune returns R*V. Exiting in Tier A costs about V/(T+V) + 0.05% + 0.00084, i.e. about 1-2% at <= 1.5% of T (emergency worst case up to s_emerg).
- Saving per avoided event ≈ (1 - R - c_exit)*V ≈ 0.33-0.62*V.
- Expected saving per day = 0.148 * P(book holds the victim) * w_victim * ~0.58:
 (a) Equal-weight bottom-quartile basket, about 32 names, holds every victim: 0.148 * (1/32) * 0.58 ≈ 0.27%/day of NAV. That is about half of the -0.5%/day price-only SMB, and an open question for that replication.
 (b) 12-name mean-reversion or yield book holding the victim 15% of the time at 1/12 weight: ≈ 0.11%/day.
 (c) Momentum book holding it 2% of the time: ≈ 0.014%/day.

2) OVERLAY COSTS
 (i) False-alarm forced exits. About 0.5-1 per week on ladder-exposed 12-name books, at about 1.5% exit cost plus re-entry costs, times 1/12 weight: about 0.01-0.04%/day. Possibly much more if the backstop rule is too eager (FT1 ablation).
 (ii) Cash drag. 20% TAO cash times the sleeve edge, e.g. 0.06%/day if sleeves earn 0.3%/day net.
 (iii) Gate, escrow and TRD haircuts and V* sizing mainly cut capacity, not return per TAO.
 (iv) Spec-change halts. About 1 upgrade per 3 days times 10 minutes of validation is about 0.2% of time, which is negligible unless validation fails.
 (v) Shield carriers at 0.0000946 per order, and failed orders (1-3% of orders) at about 0.001 each: negligible.

3) EMISSION-OFF AND GATE RULES
- Sign UNKNOWN until FT3 and FT4. The mechanism suggests a loss of the bid plus continued dilution, i.e. TRD of about -0.5%/day on SN92-like subnets (2*D ≈ 0.98%/day at LAMBDA_SELL = 0.5 against 0.45%/day yield). But re-enable waves and yield can reverse it.

4) ORDER PLANNER
- Value lies in exit reliability (PriceLimitExceeded/SlippageTooHigh at measured 1-3% shielded versus 7-19% for unshielded naive orders) and in avoiding v11 default-size failures. Direct edge ≈ 0.

NET
- Positive and material, about +0.05 to +0.25%/day of NAV, for books with prune-ladder exposure (mean reversion, flow/yield on micro caps).
- About 0 for momentum.
- Must be confirmed by FT1 and FT5 on out-of-sample prunes 27-52.

CAPACITY (TAO)
- Per position: V_cap = 1.52% * T_st * multipliers.
- Impact-optimal V* = T(alpha_h - 2f)/4 = 0.47% of T at alpha_h = 2% and 0.72% at 3%. Net per round trip at the optimum is 0.07 TAO (T = 1,650, alpha_h = 2%) to 0.31 TAO (T = 3,000, alpha_h = 3%).
- Micro-cap universe: about 32 pools under 3,000 TAO, sum of T about 45-50k TAO, about 20 eligible after filters. Sum of V_cap ≈ 130-260 TAO; practical gross at V* ≈ 100-150 TAO (about $27k-40k at $268).
- Above about 250 TAO of NAV, the overlay keeps the surplus in TAO unless sleeves extend into small and mid caps (pool > 3,000 TAO).
failure_modes:
1. Crash-driven ladder jump faster than M_A.
 - Example: an owner dump or coordinated exit takes a subnet with a >10% EMA gap to target within minutes, a registration lands in the same window (shielded, no warning), and the holding is pruned at about 0.37x.
 - Mitigation: D_STRESS, ladder bucket cap of 15%, Monte Carlo jumps. Residual risk accepted.

2. Crowding / reflexivity.
 - Every bot reads the same public ladder; when a subnet nears rank 1 holders exit together.
 - Realised exit slippage exceeds S_URGENT and the EMA falls faster than modelled.
 - FT6 measures this; D_T and s_emerg absorb part of it.

3. Hazard regime shift.
 - A demand spike makes registrants pay 1.75L at window opening (2,632 TAO at 14,401 in May 2026).
 - Or governance changes NetworkRateLimit, SubnetLimit (256 cap), lock math or spec-475 PoW registration.
 - The table becomes miscalibrated. Mitigations: hot-market switch, the prune_possible gate on SubnetLimit, and the V7 constant diff that triggers a refit.

4. Recovery formula wrong.
 - Spec 468 dissolution change, pending emission, basket chunking. Tier B decisions are then mis-weighted.
 - Mitigation: FT10 replay, and R floors at R_DEFAULT.

5. SafeMode or chain halt longer than lead time.
 - No exits are possible. A post-SafeMode first-block race against a registrant is unhedgeable beyond exposure caps.

6. Root actions with zero lead: root_dissolve_network, emission switch-off waves, FeeRate hikes, or gate parameter changes (EmissionBarRank/exponent). These create gap losses before any rule fires.

7. Shield pipeline failures.
 - Finality lag above 5 blocks makes carriers stale.
 - A missed carrier locks the nonce for about 6-10 blocks.
 - An Aura slot skip means the carrier is included but cannot be decrypted (fee paid, nothing executed).
 - Mitigations: 3 delegates, an unshielded fallback for risk exits, and a head-synced NextKey check.

8. Limit misuse. A limit already crossed at N+2 means a full PriceLimitExceeded failure with fee. The β quantile is underestimated in jumpy micro caps. Repeated failures on a risk exit cost time. Mitigation: exits widen every block and the fail-burst monitor.

9. Data or RPC degradation.
 - Public endpoints throttle (1 req/s documented, -32029 bursts) and the 700-key per-block read is lost, so the prune engine goes blind (STALE_PRUNE leads to CAUTION, but holdings remain exposed).
 - Mitigations: own lite node and keyed provider (user's future key), 2+ endpoints.

10. Decoding drift after a runtime upgrade: storage type changes such as TotalHotkeyShares to V2, or SafeFloat. Wrong NAV, caps or reconciliation lead to false key alarms or missed exits. Mitigation: V1-V7 suite and runtime-API fallbacks.

11. False key-compromise alarm, e.g. a 1-rao share-pool truncation (the StakeAdded off-by-one) or an epoch accrual misattributed. FROZEN at the wrong time during prune risk. Mitigation: tolerances (2 rao, 1e-6), expected-epoch-yield bounds, and manual override by the user only.

12. True compromise. A leaked zero-delay Staking proxy forces high-slippage trades into thin pools pre-bought by the attacker. The bot can only stop submitting; the user must revoke the proxy from the cold signer. Per-strategy coldkeys would limit the blast radius but forfeit netting.

13. Over-conservative overlay. The backstop, gate and TRD haircuts plus the 20% cash buffer remove most micro-cap exposure. Sleeves become untestable or capacity-starved, and net returns fall below overlay-off (FT5 ablation would show this).

14. Sleeve-netting artefacts. Virtual crossing at spot hides real impact from sleeve P&L, so a sleeve that would be unprofitable stand-alone looks fine. Mitigation: also report stand-alone (un-netted) sleeve P&L for kill-switch evaluation.

15. Validator traps. Take hikes from 0 to 18% within one transaction, permit loss, or childkey take changes. Yield stops while price exposure remains. Bond-EMA lag dilutes the index when our stake is large relative to the hotkey.

16. Dust and lock edge cases.
 - A partial-fill remainder below 0.02 TAO is force-sold with no limit.
 - Lock-constrained alpha (StakeUnavailable) blocks exits.
 - Never use UnstakeAll: it fails if any position is locked, and skips positions silently.

17. Paper/live divergence. The paper engine cannot observe intra-block ordering or never-included carriers. Paper fill rates are therefore optimistic; calibrate against the user's live logs (shield miss rate is unmeasurable from chain).
falsification_tests:
FT1 PRUNE-ENGINE REPLAY (blocking test)
- Events: 52 prunes from brief §4.4. In-sample is events 1-26 (2025-10-19 to 2026-04-14); out-of-sample is 27-52 (2026-04-22 to 2026-10-04).
- Data: rebuild per-block EMA for the bottom-20 ladder over the 14,400 blocks before each prune, from 60-block snapshots plus the verified recurrence. Validate the rebuild against true per-block archive reads on the last 10 prunes; EMA error must be < 0.1%.
- Synthetic holding: the victim at 0.5%, 1% and 1.5% of T.
- Recall: Tier A, Tier B or the backstop fired at least U+M_A = 159 blocks before the prune block. PASS: >= 25/26 out-of-sample. KILL / redesign: < 23/26.
- Precision: for every forced exit on a non-victim, cost = round trip 2*(V/T + f) + fees + 7-day forgone return of the subnet. PASS: (sum of avoided losses (1 - R - c_exit)*V) / (sum of false-alarm costs) >= 3 at 1% sizing. FAIL: < 1.5.
- Ablation: re-run without the backstop and without Tier B. Keep a tier only if it raises the ratio, or recall, in the out-of-sample half.

FT2 HAZARD CALIBRATION
- Walk-forward over the 32 registration intervals since Feb 2026. Evaluate the 2025 intervals under the 28,800 rate limit separately, as a regime-shift test.
- Daily forecasts of P_reg(24h) versus outcomes. PASS: Brier skill >= +10% versus a constant hazard of 1/6.6 per day outside the window, and lower log-loss. FAIL: use constant hazard plus the hard window rule.
- Monte Carlo jump calibration: the model must reproduce, within ±5 percentage points, that 7/52 victims were outside the bottom 3 two days before the prune and 12/52 were rank 1 for under 24 h.

FT3 EMISSION-OFF EVENT STUDY
- Events: 2026-06-22 (block 8,463,544, 54 subnets, plus about 10 in the next day), 2026-09-02, and individual flips. Find exact flip blocks by binary search on SubnetEmissionEnabled.
- Compare exiting at event block +2 (N+2 latency, with simultaneous-exit stress: pool drawdown observed in the first 300 blocks) against holding for 1, 7 and 30 days, on total return (P*I, including dissolution payouts at realized R).
- PASS (keep hard exit): median exit advantage >= 2% and >= 60% of events favour exit at 7 and 30 days. Otherwise downgrade to 'freeze entries + cap 0.25'.

FT4 GATE / TRD MODEL
- Gate era (block >= 8,765,684), weekly cross-section: rank IC of TRD_n against the next 7-day total return (P*I).
- PASS: mean IC >= 0.05 with Newey-West t >= 2 and monotone tercile spreads, robust to LAMBDA_SELL in [0.3, 0.7]. FAIL: set m_gate = m_trd = 1 and drop TRD_BAN.
- Also test the gate-dropout exit against holding over 7 days.

FT5 OVERLAY ON vs OFF, per strategy family a-d
- Regimes: Taoflow (2025-11-05 to 2026-06-22), price-EMA without gate (2026-06-23 to 07-27), gate era (2026-07-28 to now).
- Costs at x1, x2 fees, and x1.5 slippage. Generation-keyed assets, era-correct prices, dissolution payouts included.
- PASS: the overlay improves net TAO return, OR cuts max drawdown by >= 30% at <= 10% relative return cost, in >= 2 of 3 regimes at x1 and in the gate era at x2 fees.
- Component ablation: any component whose removal improves net return in all 3 regimes is deleted.

FT6 CAP / EXIT-BUDGET REALISM
- For every simulated exit, replay the actual next-block flows: per-block archive in stress windows, 60-block snapshots elsewhere.
- PASS: >= 95% of normal exits within S_EXIT_HOLD_MAX, and >= 80% of urgent/emergency exits within S_URGENT / s_emerg.
- FAIL: raise D_T, lower S_EXIT_ENTRY, and repeat.
- Also verify that tranching without chain-buy refill never beats single shot (CPMM identity sanity check).

FT7 ORDER PLANNER (paper on the live head stream with true N+2 replay)
- PASS: entry fill (full, or >= 80% partial) >= 97%; PriceLimitExceeded <= 2%; SlippageTooHigh <= 2% on fill-or-kill orders; |realized - predicted| shortfall <= 0.1% + 25% of predicted; risk exits fully completed within U+M_A in >= 99% of drills.
- FAIL: refit the β quantiles and K_CHASE.

FT8 ALLOCATOR AND KILL SWITCHES
- Compare fixed vs inverse-vol vs ERC budgets on >= 60 paper days plus backtests. Adopt inverse-vol only if Sharpe improves >= 0.2 with drawdown no worse.
- Kill-switch false-kill rate: on 1,000 block-bootstrapped (7-day blocks) paths of each sleeve's own backtest, SUSPEND must fire on <= 5%.
- True-kill rate: on paths with mean shifted to -cost, it must fire on >= 80% within 45 days.
- Netting: realized fee and impact savings versus un-netted execution must be >= 0. Otherwise disable crossing.

FT9 VALIDATOR POLICY
- Monthly. PASS: the chosen hotkey's next-30-day realized Δln I is >= the median eligible hotkey in >= 60% of subnet-months, and switches net positive after fees.
- FAIL: static rule (take 0, largest stake).

FT10 RECOVERY RATIO
- Replay dissolutions of SN116 (9,210,610), SN82 (9,155,237), SN108 (9,111,229), SN35 (9,046,671).
- PASS: |predicted R - realized payout/spot at P-1| <= 0.05 on each.
- FAIL: replace with R = min(formula, 0.35).

FT11 KILL-SWITCH DRILLS (paper, blocking for live arming)
- Inject: a spec change, SafeMode, a 2-minute stall, finality lag 10, RPC errors at 30%, stale ladder data, an unexplained stake delta, a delegate nonce jump.
- PASS: the correct mode within 1 block, and the correct queued-exit behaviour on recovery. Any miss blocks live arming.
